keys: Pauses this event until every signal in the list has fired at least once, or until the give-up time passes. It connects them ALL up front, one-shot, so nothing can fire into the gap between two waits - the bug a hand-written chain of awaits always has. An empty list succeeds at once.
zh_CN: 暂停这个事件，直到列表里的每个信号都至少触发过一次，或者放弃时间到了。它会预先把它们全部一次性连接好，所以没有任何信号会掉进两次等待之间的缝隙里 - 手写的 await 链总会有的那个 bug。空列表会立刻成功。

keys: wait [b]{wait_name}[/b] for ALL of [b]{signals}[/b], give up after [b]{seconds}[/b]s
zh_CN: 等待 [b]{wait_name}[/b] 直到 [b]{signals}[/b] 全部触发，[b]{seconds}[/b] 秒后放弃

keys: The signals to join, as a list: [$Door.opened, $Camera.arrived].
zh_CN: 要一起等待的信号，写成列表：[$Door.opened, $Camera.arrived]。

keys: Pauses this event until the first of several signals fires, then carries on - a race, or a sudden-death timer. Read which one won with First To Finish, naming this wait: it answers "Node.signal", so racing $Player.died against $Boss.died still tells you which one it was. Every signal is connected one-shot up front, so the winner is whichever really fired first, and the losers are disconnected when the race ends.
zh_CN: 暂停这个事件，直到几个信号中的第一个触发，然后继续 - 一场竞速，或者一个突然死亡计时。用“最先完成”并写上这次等待的名字来读取谁赢了：它回答的是 "Node.signal"，所以让 $Player.died 和 $Boss.died 赛跑时，你依然知道是哪一个。每个信号都预先一次性连接，所以赢家是真正最先触发的那个，竞速结束时输家会被断开。
等待 [b]{wait_name}[/b] 直到 [b]{signals}[/b] 中任一触发

keys: A name for this wait, so First To Finish and the outcome conditions can say which one they mean.
zh_CN: 给这次等待起个名字，好让“最先完成”和结果条件说清楚它们指的是哪一次。

keys: The signals to race, as a list: [$Player.died, $Boss.died].
zh_CN: 要赛跑的信号，写成列表：[$Player.died, $Boss.died]。

keys: True when the named wait ended because what it was waiting for happened. A wait that has never run is neither succeeded nor timed out, so nothing fires before the wait does.
zh_CN: 当指定名字的等待是因为等到了它要等的东西而结束时为真。从未运行过的等待既不算成功也不算超时，所以在等待发生之前不会有任何东西触发。

keys: The name the wait row used.
zh_CN: 那一行等待所使用的名字。

keys: True when the named wait gave up instead of finishing - the recovery branch for a load that never reported in. The same timeout also reports on verb_failed, so another event can handle it as On Failure Of.
zh_CN: 当指定名字的等待是放弃而不是完成时为真 - 一次永远没有回报的加载的恢复分支。同一次超时也会在 verb_failed 上报告，所以另一个事件可以用“当动作失败时”来处理它。

keys: Which signal a Wait For Any Of was watching finished first, written as "Node.signal" (the node's name, a dot, the signal's name), or empty text when it timed out. The node is part of the answer on purpose: a race between $Player.died and $Boss.died is two signals with the same name, and only the owner tells them apart. Compare it in a condition cell to branch on the winner.
zh_CN: 一个“等待任一”所监视的信号中哪一个最先完成，写作 "Node.signal"（节点名、一个点、信号名），超时时则为空文本。节点是答案的一部分，这是有意的：$Player.died 和 $Boss.died 之间的竞速是两个同名信号，只有拥有者才能把它们区分开。在条件单元格里比较它，就能按赢家分支。

keys: The name the Wait For Any Of row used.
zh_CN: 那一行“等待任一”所使用的名字。

keys: Runs this event's actions over and over, up to a number of attempts, so a nested Stop Retrying can end it the moment the thing works. With no waiting inside it stays instant, which makes it the procedural-placement loop as much as the disk retry. Read the try number with Retry Attempt Number.
zh_CN: 反复运行这个事件的动作，最多若干次尝试，于是嵌套在里面的“停止重试”能在事情一成功就结束它。里面没有等待时它是瞬间完成的，所以它既是磁盘重试循环，也同样是程序化摆放的循环。用“重试次数”读取这是第几次。

keys: A name for this retry, matching its Stop Retrying and Retries Exhausted rows.
zh_CN: 给这次重试起个名字，与它的“停止重试”和“重试次数用尽”行相匹配。
放弃前最多尝试多少次。

keys: Which try this is, counting from 1 - the number you put in the log line or the HUD. Only readable inside a Retry Up To N Times loop, and it reads that loop's own variable, so change the cell if you renamed it.
zh_CN: 这是第几次尝试，从 1 开始数 - 你写进日志行或 HUD 的那个数字。只有在“最多重试 N 次”循环内部才能读取，而且它读的是那个循环自己的变量，所以你改了名字就要改这个单元格。

keys: The retry loop's own variable. Leave it as attempt unless you renamed the loop variable on the Retry Up To N Times row.
zh_CN: 重试循环自己的变量。除非你在“最多重试 N 次”行上改过循环变量名，否则保持 attempt 不动。

keys: Ends the retry loop right now because the attempt worked, and records that it worked so Retries Exhausted below stays false. Put it under the condition that means success.
zh_CN: 因为这次尝试成功了，立刻结束重试循环，并记下它成功了，于是下面的“重试次数用尽”保持为假。把它放在表示成功的那个条件下面。

keys: The name the Retry Up To N Times row uses.
zh_CN: 上面那行“最多重试 N 次”所使用的名字。

keys: True when the retry loop above ran out of tries without a Stop Retrying - the give-up branch. Put it in a sibling row directly beneath the retry loop, using the same name; a retry that has never run is not exhausted, so nothing fires before the loop does. Reading it clears the record, so the next run starts clean. When the retry WAITS between tries (Wait Before Next Try) the loop is still running while the rows beneath it are reached, so report that give-up with Report Failure on the last attempt and handle it in an On Failure Of event instead.
zh_CN: 当上面的重试循环用完了所有次数却没有遇到“停止重试”时为真 - 放弃分支。把它放在重试循环正下方的同级行里，用同一个名字；从未运行过的重试不算用尽，所以循环发生之前不会有东西触发。读取它会清掉这条记录，于是下一次运行从干净的状态开始。当重试在两次尝试之间等待（“下次尝试前等待”）时，下面的行被走到时循环仍在运行，所以请在最后一次尝试上用“报告失败”来报告这次放弃，并改在“当动作失败时”事件里处理它。

keys: Pauses before the next attempt, waiting longer each time when you set a growth above 1 - the polite way to retry a disk or a slow source. It suspends this event like Wait does, so pair the retry with Once At A Time when the trigger can fire again mid-retry.
zh_CN: 在下一次尝试前暂停，当你把增长设为大于 1 时每次等得更久 - 重试磁盘或慢速数据源时礼貌的做法。它像“等待”一样挂起这个事件，所以当触发器可能在重试中途再次触发时，请给重试搭配“同一时间只运行一次”。
第 [b]{attempt}[/b] 次尝试前等待 [b]{delay}[/b] 秒（每次 x[b]{growth}[/b] 增长）

keys: Wait after the first failed try.
zh_CN: 第一次失败后等待多久。

keys: 1 = the same wait every time, 2 = doubling backoff.
zh_CN: 1 = 每次等待相同，2 = 等待时间翻倍。

keys: Which try this is - put Retry Attempt Number here.
zh_CN: 这是第几次尝试 - 把“重试次数”放在这里。

keys: Records a value into a named rolling history you can dump, chart, or check when something goes wrong.
zh_CN: 把一个值记录进一条命名的滚动历史，出问题时你可以把它导出、绘图或检查。
把 [b]{value}[/b] 记入轨迹 [b]{trail}[/b]，保留 [b]{keep}[/b] 条

keys: The value to record this tick - a number, a vector, anything printable.
zh_CN: 这一刻要记录的值 - 数字、向量，任何可打印的东西。

keys: Trail name - any label you also use in the trail expressions.
zh_CN: 轨迹名称 - 任何你在轨迹表达式里同样使用的标签。

keys: How many recent values to hold (older ones drop off the front).
zh_CN: 保留最近多少个值（更早的会从前面掉出去）。

keys: Returns the whole trail as an array, oldest first - feed it to a chart, a table, or an array action.
zh_CN: 把整条轨迹作为数组返回，最旧的在前 - 喂给图表、表格或数组动作。

keys: Trail name, matching a Remember In Trail action.
zh_CN: 轨迹名称，与某个“记入轨迹”动作相匹配。

keys: The smallest value recorded in a trail, which is the spike a per-frame watch blinked past. An empty trail reads as INF.
zh_CN: 一条轨迹中记录到的最小值，也就是逐帧观察一眨眼就错过的那个尖峰。空轨迹读作 INF。

keys: The largest value recorded in a trail. An empty trail reads as -INF.
zh_CN: 一条轨迹中记录到的最大值。空轨迹读作 -INF。

keys: The mean of every number recorded in a trail - a rolling average that is as useful in gameplay as in debugging. An empty trail reads as 0.
zh_CN: 一条轨迹里所有数字的平均值 - 一个在玩法里和在调试里同样有用的滚动平均。空轨迹读作 0。

keys: The most recently recorded value in a trail, or 0 when nothing has been recorded yet.
zh_CN: 一条轨迹中最近记录的那个值，还没记录过任何东西时为 0。

keys: How many values a trail is currently holding, which tops out at the Keep you gave it.
zh_CN: 一条轨迹当前保存了多少个值，上限就是你给它的“保留”条数。

keys: Prints the whole trail to the Output console, so the seconds before a bug arrive with the bug.
zh_CN: 把整条轨迹打印到输出控制台，于是 bug 出现时，它之前那几秒也一起到场。

keys: Writes a trail to a two-column CSV file you can open in a spreadsheet and plot.
zh_CN: 把一条轨迹写成两列的 CSV 文件，你可以用电子表格打开并绘图。

keys: Where to write the file. Use user:// so it works in an exported game.
zh_CN: 文件写到哪里。请用 user:// 以便在导出的游戏里也能用。

keys: Forgets everything a trail recorded, so the next run starts from nothing.
zh_CN: 忘掉一条轨迹记录的一切，于是下一次运行从零开始。

keys: True on a frame that took longer than your budget, which is the hitch caught as it happens. Needs a per-frame trigger.
zh_CN: 在一帧耗时超过你的预算时为真，也就是当场抓住的那次卡顿。需要一个逐帧触发器。

keys: The budget. 16.6 is one frame at 60 FPS.
zh_CN: 预算值。16.6 是 60 FPS 下的一帧。

keys: True once the framerate has stayed under your floor for the whole stretch you name, which tells a real performance drop apart from one stuttery frame. Needs a per-frame trigger.
zh_CN: 当帧率在你指定的整段时间里一直低于你的下限时为真，这能把真正的性能下降和偶尔一帧的卡顿区分开。需要一个逐帧触发器。
FPS 低于 [b]{fps}[/b] 持续 [b]{seconds}[/b] 秒

keys: The framerate floor. Below this counts as a drop.
zh_CN: 帧率下限。低于这个就算下降。

keys: How long the drop must last before this is true.
zh_CN: 下降必须持续多久，这一条才成立。

keys: Starts a named stopwatch. Pair it with Stop Measuring around the work you suspect.
zh_CN: 启动一个命名的秒表。把它和“停止计时”一起夹在你怀疑的那段工作两边。

keys: The name this measurement is reported under.
zh_CN: 这次测量以什么名字报告。

keys: Stops a named stopwatch and files the result, keeping the last, the average and the worst reading for that name.
zh_CN: 停止一个命名的秒表并归档结果，为该名字保留最近一次、平均值和最差值。

keys: The name you gave Start Measuring.
zh_CN: 你给“开始计时”的那个名字。

keys: How many milliseconds the most recent run of a named measurement took.
zh_CN: 某个命名测量最近一次运行花了多少毫秒。
[b]{named}[/b] 最近一次测量的毫秒数

keys: The mean cost in milliseconds across every run of a named measurement, which is the number to quote when you claim an optimization worked.
zh_CN: 某个命名测量在所有运行中的平均耗时（毫秒），也就是你声称优化奏效时该引用的那个数字。

keys: The worst run of a named measurement in milliseconds, which is usually the one the player felt.
zh_CN: 某个命名测量最差的那一次运行，以毫秒计，通常也就是玩家真正感觉到的那一次。

keys: Prints every named measurement taken so far with its last, average and peak cost - the report you paste into a bug or a devlog.
zh_CN: 打印到目前为止每个命名测量的最近一次、平均和峰值耗时 - 你可以粘进 bug 报告或开发日志的那份报告。

keys: Throws away every measurement recorded so far, so a fresh run starts from a clean slate.
zh_CN: 丢掉到目前为止记录的每一项测量，于是新的一轮从干净的状态开始。

keys: Publishes this node under a short name anything can ask for, so no other row needs a path to it. Run it under On Ready. Registering the same name again replaces it, and a freed node answers as nothing at all, so a scene reload leaves no dangling reference behind.
zh_CN: 把这个节点以一个简短的名字发布出去，任何东西都能索取它，于是别的行都不需要知道它的路径。请在“当就绪时”下面运行。用同一个名字再次注册会替换掉它，被释放的节点会返回“什么也没有”，所以重新加载场景不会留下悬空引用。

keys: A role, not a class - "player", "audio_director", "wallet". Registering the same name again replaces it.
zh_CN: 一个角色，而不是一个类 - "player"、"audio_director"、"wallet"。用同一个名字再次注册会替换掉它。

keys: The node published under a name, or nothing at all when nobody registered it or it has been freed. Drop it wherever a node is asked for - it never crashes and never needs a path.
zh_CN: 以某个名字发布的那个节点，没人注册过或它已被释放时则为“什么也没有”。凡是需要节点的地方都能放 - 它绝不崩溃，也不需要路径。

keys: The name the node registered itself under.
zh_CN: 节点注册自己时所使用的名字。

keys: True when a node is registered under this name and is still alive. Guard an optional system with it - a missing audio director then costs you a skipped row instead of a crash.
zh_CN: 当有节点以这个名字注册且仍然存活时为真。用它来守卫一个可选系统 - 缺失的音频总监于是只让你少跑一行，而不是崩溃。

keys: The service name to test for.

zh_CN: 遍历每个能响应的节点

keys: Runs this event's actions once per node ANYWHERE in the tree that answers to a method name - the save sweep, the pause sweep, the shutdown sweep, with no list to keep in step. It walks the whole tree, so run it on an event, not every frame. Read the current one as `node`.
zh_CN: 对树中任何位置、能响应某个方法名的每个节点各运行一次本事件的动作 - 存档扫描、暂停扫描、关闭扫描，不用维护任何列表。它会遍历整棵树，所以请在事件里运行它，不要每帧运行。用 `node` 读取当前这一个。
遍历每个能 [b]{method_name}[/b] 的节点

keys: The method name a node must have to be picked up, e.g. save_state or on_game_paused.
zh_CN: 节点必须具备哪个方法名才会被选中，例如 save_state 或 on_game_paused。

keys: Runs one action once the frame's physics and signal storm has finished, which is the only safe moment to add, free or reparent nodes. The number one crash a beginner hits is doing that from inside a collision callback; this is the fix, and the rows below it still run immediately.
zh_CN: 在本帧的物理和信号风暴结束之后运行一个动作，那是添加、释放或重新挂载节点唯一安全的时刻。新手遇到的头号崩溃就是在碰撞回调里做这些事；这就是解法，而它下面的行仍然会立刻运行。

keys: The action to run once this frame's work is finished - the only safe moment to add, free or reparent a node.
zh_CN: 本帧的工作结束后要运行的动作 - 添加、释放或重新挂载节点唯一安全的时刻。

keys: Runs one action after a delay, with no Timer node and WITHOUT suspending - the rows below it keep running. The connection is one-shot, so a delayed beat can neither leak nor fire twice. The readable form of the small follow-up: eject the shell, close the door, play the second thud.
zh_CN: 在一段延迟之后运行一个动作，不需要 Timer 节点，而且不会挂起 - 它下面的行照常运行。连接是一次性的，所以延迟的小动作既不会泄漏也不会触发两次。它是那种小后续动作的可读写法：弹壳退出、门关上、第二声闷响。

keys: Seconds to wait before the action runs.
zh_CN: 动作运行前要等待的秒数。

keys: The action to run when the delay is up.
zh_CN: 延迟结束时要运行的动作。

keys: Sets a property at the end of the frame instead of right now. The one Godot insists on for collision shapes and monitoring: flipping those mid-physics is the error every beginner meets, and deferring is the documented answer.
zh_CN: 在本帧末尾而不是此刻设置一个属性。碰撞形状和监测开关，Godot 坚持要用这种方式：在物理过程中翻转它们是每个新手都会遇到的报错，而延迟设置就是官方给出的答案。

keys: set [b]{property}[/b] of [i]{target}[/i] to [b]{value}[/b] after this frame
zh_CN: 本帧之后把 [i]{target}[/i] 的 [b]{property}[/b] 设为 [b]{value}[/b]

keys: Name of the property to set.
The value to set it to.

True the FIRST time it is reached in a frame under this name, and false for every other time that frame - counting a physics tick as its own frame, so a row under On Physics Process is not folded in with the drawn frame around it. Fifty inventory changes then rebuild the panel once instead of fifty times. Give two rows the same name and they share one run per frame.
zh_CN: 在一帧中以这个名字第一次走到它时为真，这一帧其余每次都为假 - 物理刻会被当作它自己的一帧，所以“当物理帧处理时”下面的行不会和外面绘制的那一帧混在一起。于是五十次物品栏变化只会重建一次面板，而不是五十次。给两行相同的名字，它们就共享每帧一次的机会。

keys: The gate's name. Every row using the same name folds into one run per frame.
zh_CN: 这个闸门的名字。使用同一名字的每一行都会合并成每帧一次。

keys: Spawns a scene under a name, sets a record of values on it before it enters the tree, and remembers it under that name so every later row can say The Spawned. If the sheet declares a scene_spawned(spawn_name, node) signal, this fires it with both, so another event can react to the new node without ever asking what was spawned last.
zh_CN: 以一个名字生成场景，在它进入树之前把一组值设到它身上，并以那个名字记住它，于是之后每一行都能说“已生成的”。如果事件表声明了 scene_spawned(spawn_name, node) 信号，这会带上两者一起触发它，于是另一个事件无需追问“最后生成的是什么”就能对新节点做出反应。

keys: A name for this spawn, so later rows can say The Spawned "boss".
zh_CN: 给这次生成起个名字，于是之后的行可以说“已生成的 boss”。

keys: Values to set as it arrives, as a record: {"max_health": 200, "tier": 3}. Names the scene does not have are set anyway, so keep to its own fields.
zh_CN: 到达时要设置的值，写成记录：{"max_health": 200, "tier": 3}。场景没有的名字也照样会被设置，所以请只写它自己的字段。

keys: The node to add it under. Leave as nothing to add it under this one.
zh_CN: 把它添加到哪个节点下。留空则添加到这一个下面。

keys: The node a Spawn Scene As row made under this name, or nothing at all when it was never spawned or has since been freed - so a row that reaches for a dead boss gets nothing instead of a crash.
zh_CN: 某一行“生成场景为”以这个名字造出的节点，从未生成过或此后已被释放时则为“什么也没有” - 于是伸手去够一个已死 boss 的行拿到的是空，而不是崩溃。

keys: The name a Spawn Scene As row used.
zh_CN: 某一行“生成场景为”所使用的名字。

keys: True while the node spawned under this name still exists - the guard to put in front of any row that talks to a named spawn, and the honest way to ask 'is the boss still up?'.
zh_CN: 当以这个名字生成的节点仍然存在时为真 - 任何要和某个命名生成物打交道的行前面都该放的守卫，也是“boss 还站着吗”最诚实的问法。

keys: Runs when a Spawn Scene As row spawns something. The name and the new node arrive on the row as spawn_name and node, so a reaction can configure or announce the node without asking what was spawned last - correct even when one loop spawns six things in a frame. Needs a Signal row for scene_spawned(spawn_name: String, node: Node) - without one the sheet still compiles, but nothing connects this event, so it never runs. The Project Doctor flags that.
zh_CN: 当一行“生成场景为”生成了东西时运行。名字和新节点会以 spawn_name 和 node 的形式送到这一行上，于是反应无需追问最后生成的是什么就能配置或宣告这个节点 - 即使一个循环在一帧里生成了六个东西也依然正确。需要一行 scene_spawned(spawn_name: String, node: Node) 的信号行 - 没有它事件表仍能编译，但没有任何东西连接这个事件，所以它永远不会运行。项目 Doctor 会标记这一点。

keys: The name the Spawn Scene As row gave this spawn.
zh_CN: 那一行“生成场景为”给这次生成起的名字。

keys: The node that was just spawned, carried by the signal itself.
zh_CN: 刚刚生成的那个节点，由信号本身携带。

keys: Runs when an action reports that it refused. The action's name and the reason arrive on the row as verb_id and reason, so recovery lives in its own event - add a condition under it to handle one action only. Needs a Declare Signal row for verb_failed(verb_id: String, reason: String) - without one the sheet still compiles, but nothing connects this event, so it never runs. The Project Doctor flags that.
zh_CN: 当一个动作报告它拒绝执行时运行。动作名和原因会以 verb_id 和 reason 的形式送到这一行上，于是恢复逻辑住在它自己的事件里 - 在它下面加一个条件就能只处理某一个动作。需要一行 verb_failed(verb_id: String, reason: String) 的“声明信号”行 - 没有它事件表仍能编译，但没有任何东西连接这个事件，所以它永远不会运行。项目 Doctor 会标记这一点。

keys: Which action refused - the name the Report Failure row used.
zh_CN: 哪个动作拒绝了 - “报告失败”行所使用的那个名字。

keys: Why it refused, carried by the signal itself.
zh_CN: 它为什么拒绝，由信号本身携带。

keys: Runs when an action reports that it finished. The action's name arrives on the row as verb_id. Needs a Declare Signal row for verb_succeeded(verb_id: String) - without one the sheet still compiles, but nothing connects this event, so it never runs. The Project Doctor flags that.
zh_CN: 当一个动作报告它完成时运行。动作名会以 verb_id 的形式送到这一行上。需要一行 verb_succeeded(verb_id: String) 的“声明信号”行 - 没有它事件表仍能编译，但没有任何东西连接这个事件，所以它永远不会运行。项目 Doctor 会标记这一点。

keys: Which action finished - the name the Report Success row used.
zh_CN: 哪个动作完成了 - “报告成功”行所使用的那个名字。

keys: Announces that an action refused, so every On Failure Of event for that action runs. Use it inside an action you publish yourself, or after a check that found a null resource or an empty result.
zh_CN: 宣告一个动作拒绝了执行，于是针对那个动作的每个“当动作失败时”事件都会运行。在你自己发布的动作内部使用它，或者在一次发现了空资源、空结果的检查之后使用。

keys: Name of the action that refused - the same name the On Failure Of row picks.
zh_CN: 拒绝执行的那个动作的名字 - 与“当动作失败时”行所选的名字相同。

keys: Plain words a player or a log line can read.
zh_CN: 玩家或日志行读得懂的大白话。

keys: Announces that an action finished, so every On Success Of event for that action runs. The confirmation twin of Report Failure.
zh_CN: 宣告一个动作完成了，于是针对那个动作的每个“当动作成功时”事件都会运行。“报告失败”的确认版孪生兄弟。

keys: Name of the action that finished - the same name the On Success Of row picks.
zh_CN: 完成了的那个动作的名字 - 与“当动作成功时”行所选的名字相同。

keys: Lets this event run at most once every so many seconds, however often it is reached. The rate limit for a search box, an expensive readout, or forty hit sounds landing in one frame.
zh_CN: 不论被走到多少次，都让这个事件最多每隔若干秒运行一次。搜索框、昂贵的读数，或者一帧里落下的四十个命中音效的限流器。

keys: Shortest gap between two runs of this event.
zh_CN: 这个事件两次运行之间的最短间隔。

keys: Marks that something just happened, by name. Poke on every keystroke or every change, then let Has Been Quiet For notice when it stops.
zh_CN: 按名字标记某件事刚刚发生过。每次按键或每次变化都戳一下，然后让“已安静达”来发现它停下来了。

keys: Poke name - any label you also use in Has Been Quiet For.
zh_CN: 戳的名字 - 任何你在“已安静达”里同样使用的标签。

keys: Forgets a poke so Has Been Quiet For stops firing. Clear it right after acting on the quiet, the same way you consume a buffered press.
zh_CN: 忘掉一次戳记，于是“已安静达”不再触发。在对安静做出反应之后立刻清除它，就像你消费一次缓冲按键那样。

keys: Poke name, matching a Poke action.
zh_CN: 戳的名字，与某个“戳一下”动作相匹配。

keys: True once a poked name has stopped being poked for this long - the settle-down check. Autosave after the player stops editing, search after they stop typing. Needs a per-frame trigger, and stays true until you Clear Poke.
zh_CN: 当一个被戳的名字停止被戳达到这么久时为真 - 安定下来的判断。玩家停止编辑后自动保存，停止输入后再搜索。需要一个逐帧触发器，而且在你“清除戳记”之前会一直为真。

keys: How long the quiet has to last.

True the first time this row is reached for each node, and never again for that node. The initialiser you want when the row sits inside a For Each over spawned things; the memory lives on the node, so Forget Once For clears it.
zh_CN: 对每个节点，这一行第一次被走到时为真，之后对那个节点永远不再为真。当这一行位于对生成物的“遍历每个”内部时，你想要的就是这个初始化判断；这份记忆存在节点上，所以“清除只一次记忆”可以清掉它。

keys: The node the memory belongs to - inside a For Each, the loop item.
zh_CN: 这份记忆所属的节点 - 在“遍历每个”内部就是循环项。

keys: Name the memory so one node can hold several.
zh_CN: 给这份记忆起个名字，于是一个节点可以持有好几份。

keys: True the first time this row is reached for each name, and never again for that name. One discovery line per item type, one loot roll per chest id - with no flag variable each. Kept on this node, so Forget Once For clears it.
zh_CN: 对每个名字，这一行第一次被走到时为真，之后对那个名字永远不再为真。每种物品一句发现台词，每个箱子 id 一次掉落判定 - 不用为每个都建一个标记变量。记忆保存在这个节点上，所以“清除只一次记忆”可以清掉它。

keys: The memory's name - one true per name on this node.
zh_CN: 这份记忆的名字 - 在这个节点上每个名字只为真一次。

keys: True the first time this row is reached for each name in this scene load, and again after the scene is reloaded or changed. The welcome line, the per-level check - forgotten on Restart Scene rather than remembered forever.
zh_CN: 在本次场景加载中，对每个名字这一行第一次被走到时为真，场景重新加载或切换之后会再次为真。欢迎语、每关一次的检查 - 在“重启场景”时被忘掉，而不是永远记住。

keys: The memory's name - one true per name until the scene reloads.
zh_CN: 这份记忆的名字 - 每个名字在场景重新加载前只为真一次。

keys: Clears an Only Once Per Node / Per Name memory so the row fires again for that node. Drop it in an Object Pool's reset seam and a recycled instance initialises like a fresh one.
zh_CN: 清掉一份“每个节点只一次 / 每个名字只一次”的记忆，于是这一行对那个节点会再次触发。把它放进对象池的重置接口，回收的实例就会像新的一样初始化。

keys: The Only Once Per Node / Per Name memory to clear.
zh_CN: 要清除的那份“每个节点只一次 / 每个名字只一次”记忆。

keys: Drops a 3D node straight down onto whatever is under it - the snap-to-floor every spawn, item drop and building placement ends with. Leaves it where it is when nothing is within reach.

keys: How far down to look for ground, in units. Nothing moves when there is none within reach.
zh_CN: 向下寻找地面的距离 (单位)。范围内没有地面时不会移动任何东西。

zh_CN: 用角度和距离算出点，环形与螺旋就是这样画出来的

zh_CN: 在 {near} 到 {far} 之间可见

keys: Orbiting - a camera or an object going round a centre
zh_CN: 环绕 - 摄像机或物体绕着一个中心转

keys: UI that lives in the world
Places an object on a circle around another one, on the ground plane. Advance the angle every tick and it orbits.
zh_CN: 把一个对象放到围绕另一个对象的圆周上，位于地平面内。每个 tick 递增角度，它就会环绕运动。

keys: How far out the circle is.
Where on the circle this object is, in radians. Add to it every tick to make it go round.
zh_CN: 该对象位于圆周上的位置，单位为弧度。每个 tick 累加即可让它转起来。

keys: Sets how far back a third-person camera sits. The arm pulls the camera in by itself when a wall is in the way.
zh_CN: 设置第三人称摄像机后退多远。当有墙挡住时，摇臂会自动把摄像机拉近。

keys: How far the camera sits from what the arm is mounted on.
zh_CN: 摄像机与摇臂所挂载对象之间的距离。

keys: Steers a body the way the camera is facing: pushing forward walks away from the camera, whichever way it has been turned. Flattened to the ground, so looking down does not drive the body into the floor. Follow it with Move And Slide.
zh_CN: 按摄像机的朝向操控物体：向前推就是远离摄像机走，无论摄像机转到哪个方向。方向会被压平到地面，所以向下看不会把物体推进地板。随后接一行 Move And Slide。

keys: The camera the directions are measured from - forward means the way this camera faces. The default is whichever camera is looking at the scene right now.
zh_CN: 作为方向基准的摄像机 - 向前是指这台摄像机所面向的方向。默认使用当前正在拍摄场景的摄像机。

keys: The two numbers of steering input, from an Input Vector.
zh_CN: 转向输入的两个数值，来自 Input Vector。

keys: How fast to move, in units per second.
zh_CN: 移动速度，单位为每秒单位数。

keys: Draws something only while the camera is inside a distance band - the cheapest way to stop drawing detail nobody can see.
zh_CN: 只有当摄像机处于某个距离区间内时才绘制该对象 - 这是停止绘制没人看得见的细节的最省事做法。

keys: How close the camera has to be before this is drawn. 0 means always.
zh_CN: 摄像机要多近才会绘制它。0 表示始终绘制。

keys: How far away the camera may get before this stops being drawn. 0 means never stop.
zh_CN: 摄像机可以离多远才停止绘制它。0 表示永不停止。

keys: Fades a 3D object out without hiding it - what a wall between the camera and the player does.
zh_CN: 让 3D 对象淡出而不隐藏 - 就像挡在摄像机和玩家之间的墙那样。

keys: 0 is solid, 1 is invisible. The row shows the fraction as a percentage.
zh_CN: 0 为不透明，1 为完全看不见。行中会把这个比例显示为百分数。

keys: Stops a 3D object casting a shadow. The object is still drawn - only its shadow goes.
zh_CN: 让 3D 对象不再投下阴影。对象本身仍会绘制 - 只是阴影没了。

keys: Makes a 3D object cast a shadow again after Set Shadows Off.
zh_CN: 在关闭阴影之后，让 3D 对象重新投下阴影。

keys: Turns a label or a sprite to face the camera wherever the camera goes - what a name tag over a head needs.
zh_CN: 让标签或精灵始终朝向摄像机，无论摄像机移动到哪里 - 头顶上的名牌就需要这个。

keys: The world-space label or sprite to turn.
zh_CN: 要转向的世界空间标签或精灵。
设置始终面向摄像机（保持竖直）

keys: Turns a label or a sprite to face the camera sideways only, so it stays upright when the camera looks down at it.
zh_CN: 只在左右方向上让标签或精灵朝向摄像机，这样摄像机俯视时它仍保持竖直。

keys: Draws a world-space label or icon over whatever is in front of it - what an objective marker needs.
zh_CN: 把世界空间的标签或图标画在挡在它前面的任何东西之上 - 目标标记就需要这个。

keys: The world-space label or sprite to change.
zh_CN: 要修改的世界空间标签或精灵。

keys: Sets how big a world-space label or sprite is, measured in world units per pixel.
zh_CN: 设置世界空间标签或精灵的大小，单位为每像素对应的世界单位。

keys: The world-space label or sprite to resize.
zh_CN: 要调整大小的世界空间标签或精灵。

keys: How many world units one pixel of the label or sprite is. Smaller means smaller.
zh_CN: 标签或精灵的一个像素相当于多少世界单位。数值越小，显示越小。

keys: Cuts a sprite off at a width - how a health bar over a head is driven from a number.
zh_CN: 按给定宽度裁切精灵 - 头顶血条就是这样由一个数值驱动的。

keys: The world-space sprite the bar is drawn on.
zh_CN: 绘制该条的世界空间精灵。

keys: How wide the visible slice of the image is, in pixels.
zh_CN: 图像可见部分的宽度，单位为像素。

keys: Hands a click or a key to the UI a SubViewport is painting onto a surface, so an in-world screen can be used.
zh_CN: 把点击或按键交给 SubViewport 绘制在表面上的界面，这样世界中的屏幕就能操作了。

keys: The input to hand to the UI painted on the surface.
zh_CN: 要交给绘制在表面上的界面的输入。

keys: Decides how often an in-world screen is redrawn. Only when seen is the cheap setting and the right default.
zh_CN: 决定世界中的屏幕多久重绘一次。仅在可见时是最省性能的设置，也是合适的默认值。

keys: How often the surface is redrawn.
Switches the world's fog on or off - the one row that turns a clear day into a misty one.
zh_CN: 打开或关闭世界的雾 - 一行就能把晴天变成雾天。

keys: The environment whose look is being changed.
Whether the world has fog at all.
Sets how thick the world's fog is. Ramp it up over time for a storm rolling in.
zh_CN: 设置世界中雾的浓稠程度。随时间逐渐调高，就像风暴正在逼近。

keys: How thick the fog is. Small numbers: 0.01 is a haze, 0.1 is a wall.
zh_CN: 雾有多浓。数值很小：0.01 是薄雾，0.1 就像一堵墙。

keys: Sets the colour of the world's fog - dusk purple, underwater green, dust orange.
zh_CN: 设置世界中雾的颜色 - 黄昏的紫、水下的绿、扬尘的橙。

keys: The colour the fog picks up from the light.
zh_CN: 雾从光线中获得的颜色。

keys: Switches the world's glow on or off - what makes neon, fire and magic read as bright.
zh_CN: 打开或关闭世界的辉光 - 霓虹、火焰和魔法之所以显得明亮，靠的就是它。

keys: Whether bright things bleed light into what is around them.
zh_CN: 明亮的物体是否会向周围溢出光晕。

keys: Sets how strongly bright things glow. Push it up for a boss room, back down when the fight ends.
zh_CN: 设置明亮物体发光的强度。进入 Boss 房时调高，战斗结束后再调回来。

keys: How much bright things bleed. Around 1 is strong.
zh_CN: 明亮物体溢出光晕的程度。1 左右已经很强了。

keys: Darkens the corners and creases of a 3D scene, which is what makes it look solid. Costs frames - turn it off on weak machines.
zh_CN: 让 3D 场景的角落和褶皱变暗，画面因此显得厚实。会消耗帧数 - 在配置较弱的机器上把它关掉。

keys: Whether corners and creases are darkened.
zh_CN: 是否让角落和褶皱变暗。

keys: Turns the sky. Advance it slowly every tick and the clouds drift.
zh_CN: 旋转天空。每个 tick 缓慢递增，云就会飘动起来。

keys: How the sky is turned, in radians on each axis.
zh_CN: 天空的旋转方式，各轴均以弧度表示。

keys: Fires a one-shot animation on a blend tree - a shot, a hit reaction, a wave - over whatever the character is already doing.
zh_CN: 在混合树上触发一次性动画 - 开枪、受击反应、挥手 - 叠加在角色当前正在做的动作之上。

keys: True while a blend tree's state machine is in the named state - what a landing recovery or an attack window branches on.
zh_CN: 当混合树的状态机处于指定状态时为真 - 落地硬直或攻击判定窗口就以此分支。

keys: Sets how far a 3D positional sound carries. Past this distance it is silent.
zh_CN: 设置 3D 位置音效能传多远。超过这个距离就完全听不见了。

keys: How far away the sound can still be heard at all. 0 means no limit.
zh_CN: 声音在多远之外仍然能被听到。0 表示没有限制。

keys: Sets how quickly a 3D positional sound fades as the listener moves away.
zh_CN: 设置当听者远离时，3D 位置音效衰减得有多快。

keys: How far the sound stays at full loudness before it starts fading. Bigger carries further.
zh_CN: 声音在多远之内保持满音量，之后才开始衰减。数值越大传得越远。

keys: keeping its place in the layout
zh_CN: 保持其在布局中的位置

keys: places this object copies onto others
zh_CN: 此对象复制到其他对象的位置

keys: copies its place to nothing yet
drag an object here = Add child · drag a child out to unparent · right-click: flags…, Remove from parent, Select in scene
zh_CN: 把对象拖到这里 = 添加子节点 · 把子节点拖出去以解除父子关系 · 右键：标志…、从父节点移出、在场景中选中

keys: All four on is a plain Godot child, and writes one line. Switching a transform off adds the node that drives the child instead; switching all three off is Ignore parent's movement. Unticking keeping its place snaps the child to its new parent.
zh_CN: 四项全开就是普通的 Godot 子节点，只写一行。关掉某一项变换会改为添加驱动该子节点的节点；三项全关就是忽略父节点的移动。取消“保持原位”会让子节点吸附到新的父节点上。

keys: a counter fed by every miss raises the odds until a cap guarantees the win, and the win resets it
zh_CN: 每次落空都会累加的计数器不断抬高概率，达到上限即必中，中奖后计数器归零

keys: a meter fills while the target is seen and drains while it is not, and a threshold starts the hunt
zh_CN: 看得见目标时槽位持续上升，看不见时下降，越过阈值便开始追捕

keys: health thresholds move a fight through numbered phases, each one entered exactly once
zh_CN: 生命值阈值推动战斗进入编号阶段，每个阶段恰好进入一次

keys: a clock counts a mission down, shows the time left, and fails when it reaches zero
zh_CN: 时钟为任务倒数、显示剩余时间，归零即失败

keys: hold the device how you want "flat" to feel
zh_CN: 以你希望作为「水平」的姿势握持设备

keys: yaw on the body, pitch on the camera
zh_CN: 左右转身体，上下转相机

keys: on the engine clock, which keeps running while paused
zh_CN: 按引擎时钟计时（暂停时仍在走）
倾斜转向与陀螺仪瞄准

keys: Raises a number at a steady rate per second and stops it at a limit - a suspicion meter filling while a guard sees you, a bar charging, stamina coming back.
zh_CN: 以每秒固定的速度抬高一个数值，到上限就停住 - 守卫看着你时上涨的警戒条、正在蓄力的进度条、慢慢回来的体力。

keys: How much it gains each second.
Lowers a number at a steady rate per second and stops it at a floor - suspicion cooling off, a shield decaying, a charge bleeding away.
zh_CN: 以每秒固定的速度压低一个数值，到下限就停住 - 慢慢冷却的警戒、逐渐衰减的护盾、一点点漏掉的充能。

keys: How much it loses each second.
Tells everything in the listening group that a noise happened at a place, but only the ones close enough to hear it. Footsteps, a door, a thrown bottle.
zh_CN: 告诉侦听组里的所有对象：某个位置发出了声响 - 但只有离得够近、听得见的才会收到。脚步声、一扇门、一只扔出去的瓶子。
在 [b]{at}[/b] 发出声响，[b]{radius}[/b] 以内能听见

keys: Where the noise happened (a position expression).
zh_CN: 声响发生的位置（一个位置表达式）。

keys: The group whose members can hear - each one needs an On Noise Heard event.
zh_CN: 由哪个组的成员来听 - 每个成员都需要一个「当听见声响时」事件。

keys: Runs when a Make Noise action happens close enough for this object to hear it, with the place it came from. Put this object in the listening group first (Add To Group, on created).
zh_CN: 当「发出声响」动作发生在这个对象听得见的范围内时执行，并带上声音传来的位置。先把这个对象放进侦听组（创建时「加入组」）。

keys: True the one time health first falls past a share of its maximum while the fight is in an earlier phase. The phase guard is what makes it happen once: set the phase variable in the actions under this condition.
zh_CN: 在战斗还处于更早阶段时，生命值第一次跌破最大值的某个比例，那一次为真。让它只发生一次的正是阶段判断：请在这个条件下面的动作里设置阶段变量。
阶段 [b]{phase}[/b] 开始（[b]{hp}[/b] <= [b]{max_hp}[/b] 的 [b]{share}[/b]，仅一次）

keys: The phase number that starts here.
zh_CN: 从这里开始的阶段编号。

keys: The health share it starts at - 0.6 is 60%.
zh_CN: 从哪个生命值比例开始 - 0.6 就是 60 %。
存放当前生命值的变量。

keys: The variable holding which phase the fight is in - set it in the actions below.
zh_CN: 存放战斗处于哪个阶段的变量 - 请在下面的动作里设置它。

keys: Turns a flag on, waits, and turns it back off - the invulnerability window after a hit, written once instead of as a flag and a timer that can drift apart.
zh_CN: 打开一个标志，等待，再把它关掉 - 受击后的无敌时间，一行写完，不必拆成容易走偏的标志加计时器。

keys: The boolean that says nothing lands.
zh_CN: 表示「什么都打不中」的布尔值。

keys: Puts a number of seconds on the mission clock. Type the time the way a player reads it - 3:00 - and the row stores the seconds.
zh_CN: 给任务时钟放上一段秒数。按玩家读到的样子填写时间 - 3:00 - 这一行会把它存成秒。

keys: The variable holding the seconds left.
How long the mission runs - type it as minutes:seconds.
zh_CN: 任务持续多久 - 按 分:秒 填写。

keys: Puts time back on the mission clock - the pickup that buys you another half minute.
zh_CN: 把时间加回任务时钟 - 就是那种能再买你半分钟的拾取物。

keys: How much time to add - type it as minutes:seconds.
zh_CN: 要加多少时间 - 按 分:秒 填写。

keys: Gives the time left as text a player can read - "2:41" - ready to drop into a HUD label.
zh_CN: 把剩余时间给成玩家能读的文本 - "2:41" - 直接放进 HUD 标签即可。

keys: One of the editor's own icons, so a tool's buttons and docks look like the editor around them instead of shipping their own art. The field draws the icon it names as you pick it.
zh_CN: 编辑器自带的图标之一，让工具的按钮和面板看起来像周围的编辑器，而不必自带一套美术。选择时该字段会把它所命名的图标画出来。
编辑器工具：面板与菜单

keys: The editor icon's name - usually a class name like Node2D, Script or Folder.
zh_CN: 编辑器图标的名称 - 通常是 Node2D、Script 或 Folder 这样的类名。

keys: One value out of the user's own Editor Settings - their theme colour, grid step, font size. Read it so a tool matches the editor the person in front of it actually set up.
zh_CN: 用户自己的编辑器设置中的一个值 - 主题颜色、网格步长、字号。读它，工具就能与眼前这个人实际配置的编辑器保持一致。
编辑器工具：项目与偏好设置

keys: The Editor Settings path, as it reads in Editor > Editor Settings.
zh_CN: 编辑器设置中的路径，按 编辑器 > 编辑器设置 里显示的写法填写。

keys: One value out of this project's own settings. Unlike a preference, it is saved with the project, so every person opening it sees the same answer.
zh_CN: 本项目自身设置中的一个值。与编辑器偏好不同，它随项目一起保存，所以每个打开项目的人看到的答案都一样。

keys: The Project Settings path, as it reads in Project > Project Settings.
zh_CN: 项目设置中的路径，按 项目 > 项目设置 里显示的写法填写。

keys: The big area the 2D, 3D and Script tabs share. A workspace plugin adds its own screen as a child of this.
zh_CN: 2D、3D 和 Script 标签页共用的大块区域。工作区插件会把自己的界面作为它的子节点添加进来。

keys: Writes one project setting. It lives in memory until Save settings runs, so a tool that changes several settings writes them all and saves once.
zh_CN: 写入一项项目设置。在执行 保存设置 之前它只存在于内存中，所以要改多项设置的工具应先全部写入，最后保存一次。

keys: The Project Settings path to write.
zh_CN: 要写入的项目设置路径。

keys: Writes the project settings back to project.godot. Without this, everything Set setting changed is lost when the editor closes.
zh_CN: 把项目设置写回 project.godot。没有这一步，写入设置 改过的一切都会在编辑器关闭时丢失。

keys: Brings one of the editor's top tabs to the front - the same click as pressing 2D or Script yourself.
zh_CN: 把编辑器顶部的某个标签页切到前面 - 和你自己点 2D 或 Script 是一回事。

keys: Which of the editor's top tabs to bring forward.
zh_CN: 要把编辑器顶部的哪个标签页切到前面。

keys: Reveals a folder or file in the editor's project file list and selects it - what a tool does after it writes something, so the reader can see what just landed.
zh_CN: 在编辑器的项目文件列表中定位并选中某个文件夹或文件 - 工具写出东西之后就该这么做，好让人看到刚刚生成了什么。

keys: The folder or file to reveal, as a res:// path.
zh_CN: 要定位的文件夹或文件，使用 res:// 路径。

keys: Jumps the script editor to a line of the script it already has open - how a tool points at the thing it is complaining about.
zh_CN: 让脚本编辑器跳到已打开脚本的某一行 - 工具就是这样指出它所抱怨的那个地方。

keys: The line to jump to, counted from zero.
zh_CN: 要跳转到的行，从 0 开始计数。

keys: Puts a window or dialog under the editor's own root, which is what makes it show up with the editor's theme and stay on top of it. Free it again when the plugin is disabled.
zh_CN: 把窗口或对话框挂到编辑器自己的根节点下，这样它才会带着编辑器的主题显示并浮在编辑器之上。插件被禁用时记得释放它。

keys: Add window {window} to the editor's root
zh_CN: 将窗口 {window} 添加到编辑器根节点

keys: The window or dialog to hang on the editor.
zh_CN: 要挂到编辑器上的窗口或对话框。

keys: Adds one entry to the editor's command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P), so a tool is reachable without a menu of its own.
zh_CN: 向编辑器的命令面板（Ctrl+Shift+P）添加一个条目，这样不用自建菜单也能用到该工具。

keys: The words the command palette shows.
zh_CN: 命令面板上显示的文字。

keys: The unique key the palette files it under.
zh_CN: 命令面板用来登记它的唯一键。

keys: The function to run when the command is chosen.
zh_CN: 选中该命令时要运行的函数。

keys: Adds a tab to the row Output and Debugger share, at the bottom of the editor. Remove it on plugin disabled or the row keeps a tab nobody owns.
zh_CN: 在编辑器底部“输出”和“调试器”共用的那一行里添加一个标签页。插件禁用时要移除，否则那一行会留下一个没人认领的标签页。

keys: The Control to show in the bottom row.
zh_CN: 要在底部这一行里显示的 Control。

keys: The words on its tab, beside Output and Debugger.
zh_CN: 它的标签页上的文字，就挨着“输出”和“调试器”。

keys: Takes the plugin's tab back out of the bottom row.
zh_CN: 把插件的标签页从底部那一行里撤回来。

keys: The Control that was added to the bottom row.
zh_CN: 之前添加到底部那一行的 Control。

keys: Runs whenever the project's files change on disk - something was imported, moved, deleted or added. The place to rescan whatever a tool keeps a list of.
zh_CN: 每当项目文件在磁盘上发生变化时运行 - 有东西被导入、移动、删除或添加。工具在这里重新扫描它所维护的那份清单。
编辑器偏好设置变化时

keys: Runs when the user changes anything in Editor Settings. Re-read the preferences a tool draws with, so it follows the theme instead of keeping the old one.
zh_CN: 当用户在编辑器设置里改动任何内容时运行。重新读取工具绘制时所用的偏好设置，让它跟上主题，而不是抱着旧值不放。
编辑器偏好设置变化时

keys: Moves a 3D node along one of its own directions - forward, back, right, left, up or down - at a speed a second.
zh_CN: 让一个 3D 节点沿它自身的某个方向移动 - 前、后、右、左、上或下 - 速度按每秒计。

keys: Which of its own six directions to move along.
zh_CN: 沿它自身六个方向中的哪一个移动。

keys: Turns a 3D node about its up axis - the yaw a character or a turret turns with.
zh_CN: 让一个 3D 节点绕它自身的向上轴转动 - 角色或炮塔转身用的偏航。

keys: Degrees a second, turning clockwise seen from above; a negative number turns the other way.
zh_CN: 每秒多少度，从上方看是顺时针；填负数则朝反方向转。

keys: Tilts a 3D node's nose up or down - the pitch a plane or a camera arm moves with.
zh_CN: 让一个 3D 节点的机头朝上或朝下倾斜 - 飞机或摄像机臂运动时的俯仰。

keys: Degrees a second; a negative number tilts the other way.
zh_CN: 每秒多少度；填负数则朝反方向倾斜。

keys: Rolls a 3D node about the way it faces - the bank a plane or a ship leans with.
zh_CN: 让一个 3D 节点绕它面朝的方向翻滚 - 飞机或船倾斜时的侧倾。

keys: Degrees a second; a negative number rolls the other way.
zh_CN: 每秒多少度；填负数则朝反方向横滚。

keys: Turns a 3D node smoothly toward a facing instead of snapping to it - the way a turret leads its target.
zh_CN: 让一个 3D 节点平滑地转向某个朝向，而不是直接对齐过去 - 就像炮塔跟着目标转。

keys: The facing to turn toward - Facing Along a direction gives you one.
zh_CN: 要转向的那个朝向 - 用「沿方向的朝向」就能得到一个。

keys: How fast it closes the gap, per second. Bigger turns harder.
zh_CN: 每秒把差距收拢多快。数值越大转得越猛。

keys: The facing that looks along a direction - what Rotate Toward Facing turns toward.
zh_CN: 沿着某个方向看去的朝向 - 也就是「转向朝向」要转到的目标。
把位置设为另一个对象的位置

keys: Puts a 3D node exactly where another one is - how a spawn point, a socket or a respawn marker is used.
zh_CN: 把一个 3D 节点放到另一个节点所在的位置 - 出生点、挂点或复活标记就是这么用的。

keys: The object to stand where - a spawn marker, a socket, another character.
zh_CN: 要站到它位置上的那个对象 - 出生点标记、挂点，或另一个角色。

keys: Tilts a 3D node so its up points the way the ground does - the line that makes a dropped crate sit flat on a hill.
zh_CN: 把一个 3D 节点倾斜，让它的向上方向对齐地面的朝向 - 让掉落的木箱平贴在斜坡上的就是这一行。

keys: The way the surface faces - a ray hit gives you one as its `normal`.
zh_CN: 表面朝向的方向 - 射线命中结果的 `normal` 就是一个。

keys: Asks whether something is inside the cone this object is looking down - a vision cone, a backstab check, an aim assist.
zh_CN: 询问某个东西是否落在这个对象所看的锥形范围内 - 视野锥、背刺判定、瞄准辅助。
在朝向 [i]{direction}[/i] 的 [b]{angle}[/b]° 范围内

keys: The way this object faces. Its own forward, unless you say otherwise.
zh_CN: 这个对象面朝的方向。除非另行指定，否则就是它自身的前方。

keys: The direction to the thing being looked for - Direction To gives you one.
zh_CN: 指向要找的那个东西的方向 - 用「到…的方向」就能得到一个。

keys: Half the width of the cone, in degrees. 45 is a 90-degree field of view.
zh_CN: 锥形宽度的一半，以度为单位。填 45 就是 90 度的视野。

keys: Asks whether a place is behind this object - the backstab half of a facing test.
zh_CN: 询问某个位置是否在这个对象的后方 - 朝向判定里负责背刺的那一半。

keys: Asks whether a place is in front of this object, whichever way it happens to be turned.
zh_CN: 询问某个位置是否在这个对象的前方，无论它此刻转向哪边。

keys: Asks whether a place is off this object's right side - which way to lean, dodge or steer.
zh_CN: 询问某个位置是否在这个对象的右侧 - 决定往哪边倾、往哪边闪、往哪边打方向。

keys: Asks whether a place is off this object's left side - the twin of Is To The Right Of.
zh_CN: 询问某个位置是否在这个对象的左侧 - 「在右侧」的孪生兄弟。

keys: The point an angle and a distance name. Add it to a centre for a place on a circle; grow the distance every tick and it draws a spiral.
zh_CN: 由一个角度和一段距离确定的点。把它加到某个中心上，就得到圆周上的位置；每一拍都把距离加大，它就画出一条螺旋。

keys: Places a number of copies evenly around a circle - the bullet-hell ring, the radial menu, the circle of pillars.
zh_CN: 把若干份副本沿一个圆周均匀摆开 - 弹幕环、径向菜单、一圈立柱。

keys: Create [b]{count}[/b] of {scene} evenly around a circle of [i]{radius}[/i]
zh_CN: 在半径 [i]{radius}[/i] 的圆周上均匀生成 [b]{count}[/b] 个 {scene}

keys: How far out from the centre they sit.
Reads a place back the other way - as the angle from one point to another and how far apart they are, both named in one drop.
zh_CN: 把一个位置反着读出来 - 从一个点到另一个点的角度，以及两者相距多远，一次就给两者都起好名字。
把 [i]{from}[/i] 到 [i]{to}[/i] 存为 [b]{angle_name}[/b] 和 [b]{distance_name}[/b]
给这个角度起什么名字。
给这段距离起什么名字。

keys: True while the mouse is pointing at this object in the 3D world - hover highlights, tooltips and "what am I about to click" all start here. Needs an active Camera3D.
zh_CN: 当鼠标在 3D 世界中指向该对象时为真 - 悬停高亮、提示气泡和"我马上要点到什么"都从这里开始。需要一个启用的 Camera3D。

keys: The object the cursor has to be over for this to be true.
zh_CN: 光标必须位于其上方，此条件才成立的对象。

keys: Which collision layers the ray may see, by the names this project gave them.
zh_CN: 射线可以看见哪些碰撞层，按本项目为它们起的名字选择。

keys: How far into the scene the ray reaches, in metres.
zh_CN: 射线伸入场景多远，以米为单位。

keys: Fires when a mouse button goes down over this object in the 3D world - click-to-select, click-to-attack, click-to-open. Lives in an input event, beside the other On ... pressed rows.
zh_CN: 在 3D 世界中，鼠标按键在该对象上按下时触发 - 点击选中、点击攻击、点击打开。它放在输入事件里，与其他"当按下 ... 时"的行并列。

keys: The object the click has to land on.
zh_CN: 点击必须落在哪个对象上。

keys: The world point on the floor the cursor is aiming at - where to drop a build ghost, a move-order marker or a decal.
zh_CN: 光标瞄准的地面世界坐标 - 建造预览、移动指令标记或贴花该放的位置。

keys: The world point on the floor the cursor is aiming at - where to drop a build ghost, a move-order marker or a decal. Aimed through a crosshair object rather than the OS pointer.
zh_CN: 光标瞄准的地面世界坐标 - 建造预览、移动指令标记或贴花该放的位置。 通过准星对象瞄准，而不是系统指针。
通过 {target} 瞄准的地面位置

keys: The crosshair or virtual cursor to aim through. Its position ON THE CANVAS is what aims the ray, so a gamepad or touch cursor works exactly like the pointer.
zh_CN: 用来瞄准的准星或虚拟光标。决定射线方向的是它在画布上的位置，所以手柄或触摸光标与指针的效果完全一样。

keys: The floor object the cursor is aiming at, or nothing when the cursor is off the floor.
zh_CN: 光标瞄准的地面对象；光标不在地面上时为空。

keys: The floor object the cursor is aiming at, or nothing when the cursor is off the floor. Aimed through a crosshair object rather than the OS pointer.
zh_CN: 光标瞄准的地面对象；光标不在地面上时为空。 通过准星对象瞄准，而不是系统指针。
通过 {target} 瞄准的地面对象

keys: Which way the floor faces under the cursor - hand it to Align To The Ground's Slope, or ask Slope Steeper Than whether it is buildable.
zh_CN: 光标下方地面朝向哪个方向 - 把它交给"贴合地面"的坡度，或用"坡度陡于"问问那里能不能建造。

keys: Which way the floor faces under the cursor - hand it to Align To The Ground's Slope, or ask Slope Steeper Than whether it is buildable. Aimed through a crosshair object rather than the OS pointer.
zh_CN: 光标下方地面朝向哪个方向 - 把它交给"贴合地面"的坡度，或用"坡度陡于"问问那里能不能建造。 通过准星对象瞄准，而不是系统指针。
通过 {target} 瞄准的地面坡度

keys: True when the ground faces further than this from straight up - the buildable test a placement preview tints itself with.
zh_CN: 当地面朝向偏离正上方超过这个角度时为真 - 放置预览用来给自己上色的"能否建造"判定。

keys: Which way the ground faces - the floor slope expressions answer exactly this.
zh_CN: 地面朝向哪个方向 - 地面坡度表达式返回的正是这个。

keys: How far from flat counts as too steep.
zh_CN: 偏离水平多少就算太陡。

keys: Where this object is ON THE CANVAS, in pixels. Camera zoom and canvas layers are already in the answer, which is exactly what plain position arithmetic gets wrong.
zh_CN: 该对象在画布上的位置，以像素计。相机缩放和画布图层已经算进去了，而这正是直接拿位置做算术会弄错的地方。

keys: The object being asked where it is on screen.
zh_CN: 被询问其屏幕位置的对象。

keys: Where this 3D object lands ON THE CANVAS, in pixels - the number a health bar over its head, an off-screen arrow or an aim assist is positioned by.
zh_CN: 该 3D 对象落在画布上的什么位置，以像素计 - 头顶血条、屏幕外指示箭头或辅助瞄准都按这个数值定位。

keys: The 3D object being asked where it is on screen.
zh_CN: 被询问其屏幕位置的 3D 对象。

keys: The middle of what the player can see, in pixels - where a crosshair sits.
zh_CN: 玩家可见范围的正中，以像素计 - 准星就在这里。
选取最接近画布点的一个

keys: Walks the instances and keeps whichever is closest to a point ON THE CANVAS - aim assist, snap-to-target crosshairs and "whichever one I am nearly pointing at". Measured in pixels, so camera zoom is honoured; anything behind the camera is skipped.
zh_CN: 遍历实例，只保留离画布上某个点最近的那一个 - 辅助瞄准、吸附目标的准星，以及"我差不多正指着的那个"。以像素度量，所以相机缩放会被计入；相机背后的一律跳过。

keys: pick nearest of [i]{list}[/i] to canvas point {from} -> [b]{name}[/b]
zh_CN: 从 [i]{list}[/i] 中选取最接近画布点 {from} 的一个 -> [b]{name}[/b]

keys: The name the one it picks goes by in the rows below. Nothing is picked when the list is empty or everything is off screen, so check the name exists first.
zh_CN: 被选中的那个在下面几行里使用的名字。列表为空或全部在屏幕外时不会选中任何东西，所以请先检查这个名字是否存在。

keys: The instances to pick from - usually a group, which is how a project spells "every one of this kind".
zh_CN: 供选取的实例 - 通常是一个组，这就是项目里"这一类的全部"的写法。

keys: The canvas point distances are measured from, in pixels. The canvas centre is the crosshair.
zh_CN: 测量距离的起点画布点，以像素计。画布中心就是准星。

keys: How far from that point, in PIXELS, still counts. Nothing beyond it is picked.
zh_CN: 距离该点多远（以像素计）仍然算数。超出的一律不选。

keys: Detaches a child node from this one without deleting it, so you can reattach it later.
zh_CN: 把一个子节点从本节点上摘下来，但不删除它，以后还可以重新挂上。

keys: Child to detach (by index here - no hardcoded name; pick one or use a scene-unique node). Not freed.
zh_CN: 要摘下的子节点（这里按索引 - 不写死名字；挑一个，或使用场景内唯一的节点）。不会被释放。

keys: Moves a node that is already in the layout under a new parent - picking an item up into a hand, mounting a rider on a saddle, holstering a weapon on a back. Keeping its place leaves it exactly where it looks; snapping to it puts it at the parent's own spot.
zh_CN: 把已经在布局中的节点移到新的父节点下 - 把物品拿到手上、把骑手放上马鞍、把武器背到背上。"保持原位"让它停在看起来的那个位置；"贴合"则把它放到父节点自身所在的位置。

keys: The node that becomes a child. It keeps everything it is - only its parent changes.
zh_CN: 将要成为子节点的节点。它本身的一切都不变 - 只是父节点换了。
它将被挂到哪个节点下。

keys: Whether the child stays where it is in the world, or snaps to its new parent.
zh_CN: 子节点是留在世界中原来的位置，还是贴到新的父节点上。

keys: Takes a node off whatever it is under and puts it back at the top of the layout, keeping the place it has in the world - dropping a carried item, dismounting a rider. The node is not freed and nothing else about it changes.
zh_CN: 把节点从它当前所属的父节点上摘下来，放回布局的最顶层，并保留它在世界中的位置 - 放下携带的物品、让骑手下马。节点不会被释放，其他一切都不变。
把 [i]{child}[/i] 从其父节点移除

keys: The node to take off its parent. It stays in the layout, at the top level.
zh_CN: 要从父节点上摘下的节点。它仍留在布局中，处于最顶层。

keys: Stops a child moving, turning and scaling with its parent while leaving it a child in every other way - it is still freed with the parent and still picked as one of its children. The answer for a muzzle flash that should not swing with the gun, or a health bar that should not tilt with the enemy.
zh_CN: 让子节点不再随父节点移动、旋转和缩放，但在其他方面仍然是子节点 - 依旧随父节点一起释放，也依旧算作它的子节点。适合不该随枪摆动的枪口火光，或不该随敌人倾斜的血条。
把 [i]{target}[/i] 的忽略父节点移动设为 [b]{ignore}[/b]

keys: The child that should stop (or start) following its parent.
zh_CN: 要停止（或开始）跟随父节点的那个子节点。

keys: On: the child stays where it is when the parent moves.
zh_CN: 开：父节点移动时，子节点留在原处。

keys: Points a RemoteTransform at the node it should drive, so that node follows this one without being its child at all. Which parts follow - position, angle, size - are the RemoteTransform's own switches.
zh_CN: 让 RemoteTransform 指向它该驱动的节点，那个节点便会跟随本节点，而完全不必成为它的子节点。哪些部分跟随（位置、角度、大小）由 RemoteTransform 自己的开关决定。

keys: The RemoteTransform2D / RemoteTransform3D doing the copying.
Path to the node its place is copied onto.
zh_CN: 位置将被复制到哪个节点的路径。

keys: Clears a RemoteTransform's target, so whatever it was driving stops following immediately. The node it drove keeps the place it had.
zh_CN: 清空 RemoteTransform 的目标，它原本驱动的节点立刻停止跟随，并保留当时的位置。

keys: The RemoteTransform2D / RemoteTransform3D to switch off.

Runs this event's actions once per direct child of a node - healing a squad, totting up an inventory, checking every socket. Read the current one as `child`. Children added while it runs are not visited by this pass.
zh_CN: 把本事件的动作对某个节点的每个直接子节点各执行一次 - 治疗一个小队、清点背包、检查每个插槽。当前的那个用 `child` 读取。运行期间新加的子节点，本轮不会访问。

keys: The node whose children the actions run once for.
zh_CN: 要遍历其子节点、对每个子节点执行一次动作的节点。
把子节点移到指定索引

keys: Reorders a child to a new sibling index, changing its draw and process order.
zh_CN: 把子节点重排到新的同级索引，从而改变它的绘制顺序和处理顺序。

keys: Child to reorder (by index here - no hardcoded name; pick one or use a scene-unique node).
zh_CN: 要重排的子节点（这里按索引 - 不写死名字；挑一个，或使用场景内唯一的节点）。
新的同级索引（绘制 / 处理顺序）。

keys: Safely deletes a node at the end of the frame, e.g. removing a dead enemy.
zh_CN: 在帧结束时安全地删除节点，例如清掉一个已死的敌人。

keys: Node to free at the end of the frame.
zh_CN: 在帧结束时要释放的节点。
信号 / 场景 / 输入

keys: Runs when a child node is added beneath this one, e.g. reacting to spawned items.
zh_CN: 当有子节点被添加到该节点之下时执行，例如用来响应刚生成的物品。
当子节点 [i]{node}[/i] 被添加时

keys: Runs just before a child node leaves this one - while it is still there to be read, so a count, a total or a panel can be brought up to date with it.
zh_CN: 在子节点离开该节点之前执行 - 此时它还在、仍可读取，于是计数、总和或某块面板都能据此更新。

keys: Puts one item in a menu. The id is how the menu says which item was picked, so On Item Chosen answers the same number this row was given.
zh_CN: 在菜单中放入一个项目。id 是菜单用来说明选中了哪个项目的编号，因此“当选择项目时”响应的正是这一行给出的编号。
当选择 {menu} 的项目 {item} 时

keys: Runs when the user picks the item with this id out of the menu. Every item of one menu shares a single handler, so all of them stay together in the emitted file.
zh_CN: 当用户从菜单中选择具有该 id 的项目时运行。同一个菜单的所有项目共用一个处理函数，因此它们在生成的文件中始终排在一起。

keys: The menus a tool puts on screen: the items that go in one, and the event that runs when the user picks one of them.
zh_CN: 工具放到屏幕上的菜单：其中包含的项目，以及用户选择其中一项时运行的事件。

keys: The menu variable this row acts on - the one the menu was made into.
zh_CN: 这一行作用的菜单变量 - 也就是创建菜单时所用的那个变量。

keys: The words the item shows in the menu.
zh_CN: 该项目在菜单中显示的文字。

keys: The number this item sends when it is chosen. Give every item its own - two items sharing one id means the second one can never run.
zh_CN: 该项目被选中时发送的编号。请给每个项目各自的编号 - 两个项目共用一个 id 时，第二个永远不会运行。

keys: The id of the item this event answers - the same number Add Item gave it.
zh_CN: 该事件所响应的项目 id - 与“添加项目”给它的编号相同。

keys: Which 2D body or area the mouse is over, or nothing when it is over empty space - click-to-select, hover highlights and "what am I about to pick up". Asked as a point query, so overlapping shapes answer with the one on top.
zh_CN: 鼠标下方的 2D 物体或区域；指向空白处时为空 - 点击选择、悬停高亮，以及“我马上要捡起什么”。以点查询的方式提问，因此重叠的形状由最上层的作答。

keys: Which collision layers the query may see, by the names this project gave them.
zh_CN: 该查询可以看到哪些碰撞层，使用本项目为它们起的名称。

keys: Which cell of a tilemap layer the mouse is over, as map coordinates - the number Set Tile At, Erase Tile At and Cell Is Empty all take. Tile painting, build grids and "which square did I click" start here.
zh_CN: 鼠标位于图块地图层的哪个单元格上，以地图坐标给出 - 这正是“设置图块”、“擦除图块”和“单元格为空”都接受的数值。刷图块、建造网格，以及“我点了哪一格”都从这里开始。

keys: The tilemap layer the cell is looked up in. Its own transform is what turns the pointer into a cell, so a scrolled or zoomed map answers correctly.
zh_CN: 用于查找单元格的图块地图层。把指针换算成单元格的正是该图层自身的变换，因此即使地图滚动或缩放也能答对。

keys: Dropping it on the canvas offers the secrets counter.
zh_CN: 将它拖放到画布上时会提示添加秘密计数事件。

keys: %s is marked a secret. Add the event that counts it the first time the player walks in?
zh_CN: %s 已标记为秘密。是否添加在玩家首次进入时计数的事件？

keys: Show the control's key on a label while the window is open
zh_CN: 窗口打开期间，在标签上显示该操作的按键

keys: Clear the prompt off its label as the window shuts
zh_CN: 窗口关闭时，把提示从标签上清除

keys: The label that shows the prompt, as a node path - $PromptLabel.
zh_CN: 显示提示的标签，用节点路径填写 - $PromptLabel。

keys: Every colour set this palette asset carries, side by side.
zh_CN: 该调色板资源包含的所有配色，并排显示。

keys: Which way something faces. Mirror or flip a sprite, a whole object with its hitbox and its ray, a 3D model, a UI panel, the camera's view, one tile, or a path - each host in its own honest terms.
zh_CN: 某个东西朝向哪边。镜像或翻转一个精灵、连同碰撞区与射线的整个对象、一个 3D 模型、一个界面面板、相机画面、一格瓦片或一条路径 - 每种宿主都用它自己诚实的说法。
将 {coords} 处的瓦片镜像设为 {mirrored}

keys: Mirror it horizontally (facing left), or put it back the way it was.
zh_CN: 将它水平镜像 (朝左) 或还原为原来的方向。

keys: Turn it upside down, or put it back the right way up.
zh_CN: 把它上下颠倒，或还原为正立。

keys: Act on another node instead of this one. Leave blank for this node, pick a node, or address one without a tree path - e.g. get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player").
zh_CN: 作用于另一个节点而不是当前节点。留空表示当前节点，可以选择一个节点，也可以不用树路径来指定 - 例如 get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player")。

keys: The value holding how fast this object is moving.
zh_CN: 保存这个对象移动速度的值。

keys: The child that must stay readable - a name plate, a health bar, a damage number.
zh_CN: 必须保持可读的子节点 - 名牌、血条、伤害数字。

keys: Mirrors this node's picture left-to-right - the way a 2D character faces.
zh_CN: 把这个节点的图像左右镜像 - 2D 角色就是这样朝向一边的。

keys: Turns this node's picture upside down, or puts it back the right way up.
zh_CN: 把这个节点的图像上下颠倒，或还原为正立。

keys: True while this node's picture is mirrored - which way the character is facing.
zh_CN: 当这个节点的图像处于镜像状态时为真 - 也就是角色的朝向。

keys: True while this node's picture is upside down.
zh_CN: 当这个节点的图像上下颠倒时为真。

keys: Mirrors this object AND everything under it - the picture, the hitbox, the muzzle point and the ray all face the same way.
zh_CN: 把这个对象连同它下面的一切一起镜像 - 图像、碰撞区、枪口点和射线都朝同一个方向。

keys: True while this object is mirrored, read off its own X scale.
zh_CN: 当这个对象处于镜像状态时为真，取自它自己的 X 缩放。

keys: Mirrors a 3D object along X. Worth knowing: a negative scale flips the mesh's winding, so lighting and backface culling see it inside out - Turn Around is usually what you want instead.
zh_CN: 沿 X 轴镜像一个 3D 对象。需要知道：负缩放会翻转网格的面朝向，于是光照和背面剔除会把它看成里外颠倒 - 通常你想要的其实是「转身」。

keys: Mirrors a 3D label along X - readable backwards, which is the point when it is a decal or a sign seen from behind.
zh_CN: 沿 X 轴镜像一个 3D 标签 - 会变成反着读，而当它是贴花或从背面看到的招牌时，这正是你要的。

keys: True while this 3D object is mirrored along X.
zh_CN: 当这个 3D 对象沿 X 轴处于镜像状态时为真。

keys: Turns a 3D object to face the other way - half a turn about its up axis. The honest 3D answer to mirroring: nothing is inside out afterwards.
zh_CN: 把一个 3D 对象转向另一边 - 绕它的上方向轴转半圈。这是 3D 对镜像的诚实答案：之后没有任何东西是里外颠倒的。

keys: Faces the way this object is moving, and leaves it facing that way when it stops - the one line every platformer writes by hand.
zh_CN: 面向这个对象正在移动的方向，停下来时也保持这个朝向 - 每个平台游戏都手写的那一行。

keys: Turns this object to face another one - an enemy looking at the player, a shopkeeper looking at whoever walked in.
zh_CN: 让这个对象转向另一个对象 - 看向玩家的敌人，看向进门者的店主。

keys: Re-negates a child's X scale so it does NOT come along when this object mirrors - what keeps a name plate readable instead of writing it backwards.
zh_CN: 把子节点的 X 缩放再取一次反，让它不要跟着这个对象一起镜像 - 名牌因此保持可读，而不会写成反的。

keys: Mirrors a UI element in place. The pivot is moved to its middle first, which is the half everyone forgets - without it the panel mirrors AND jumps sideways.
zh_CN: 就地镜像一个界面元素。先把轴心移到它的中间，这是所有人都会忘掉的那一半 - 没有它，面板会一边镜像一边往旁边跳。

keys: True while this UI element is mirrored.
zh_CN: 当这个界面元素处于镜像状态时为真。

keys: Mirrors everything this camera sees - a mirror world, a reflection, a level played backwards.
zh_CN: 镜像这台相机看到的一切 - 镜像世界、倒影、反着玩的关卡。

keys: Mirrors what a sub-viewport shows - the rear-view mirror, the security monitor, the reflection in the water.
zh_CN: 镜像子视口所显示的内容 - 后视镜、监控画面、水中的倒影。

keys: Mirrors the tile already sitting at a cell, keeping its tileset and its tile - how one wall art asset covers both sides of a corridor.
zh_CN: 镜像已经放在某格上的瓦片，保留它的图块集和图块 - 一张墙面素材就能覆盖走廊的两边。

keys: Mirrors every point of this path about x = 0 - the second half of a symmetric level, or a patrol route reused facing the other way.
zh_CN: 把这条路径的每个点沿 x = 0 镜像 - 对称关卡的后半段，或反向复用的巡逻路线。

keys: an object is mirrored to face the way it moves, and its ray, its spawn points and its particles turn with it
zh_CN: 对象被镜像以面向它移动的方向，它的射线、生成点和粒子也一起转过来
按 {value} 镜像 {coords} 处的瓦片

keys: Name the key and dropping it on the canvas offers the door event. Leave it blank for a door that is not locked.
zh_CN: 为钥匙命名后，将其拖到画布上时会提议门的事件。若门未上锁，请留空。

keys: %s wants the %s key. Add the event that tries it when the player walks in?
zh_CN: %s 需要 %s 钥匙。是否添加玩家走入时尝试开门的事件？

keys: Trying %s when the player walks in.
steers the run in the air, keeps the rest
zh_CN: 在空中改变奔跑方向，其余保持不变

keys: a sine wave, as you move
zh_CN: 随移动而起伏的正弦波

keys: Keys and the doors that want them
Enemies noticing you, and each other
zh_CN: 敌人注意到你，也注意到彼此
固定到 {owner} 的路径位置
把 X 位置固定到 {anchor}
把 Y 位置固定到 {anchor}

keys: what this object rides, and can let go of
zh_CN: 此对象搭乘的目标，以及它可以放开的目标

keys: A skill tree - prerequisites, points and unlocks
zh_CN: 技能树 - 前置条件、点数与解锁
滑板 ▸ 顺着坡度滑行

keys: Skateboard ▸ Push toward max speed by {amount}
zh_CN: 滑板 ▸ 蹬地 {amount} 接近最高速度

keys: Skateboard ▸ Spin one turn per second
zh_CN: 滑板 ▸ 每秒旋转一圈
滑板 ▸ 每秒旋转 {turns} 圈

keys: Skateboard ▸ Flip one turn per second
zh_CN: 滑板 ▸ 每秒翻转一圈
滑板 ▸ 每秒翻转 {turns} 圈
磨杆 ▸ 距离栏杆 {rail} 在 {distance} 以内
磨杆 ▸ 开始在 {rail} 上磨杆
磨杆 ▸ 以 {speed} 沿栏杆磨行

keys: on {rail}, at the point the curve bakes
zh_CN: 在 {rail} 上，曲线给出的那个点

keys: a body snaps to the nearest point on a drawn curve and is walked along it
zh_CN: 物体吸附到所绘曲线上最近的点，并沿着它前进
靠惯性推进的滑板移动

keys: speed is kept rather than chased, and the slope under you is where it comes from
zh_CN: 速度是保住的而不是追出来的，它来自脚下的坡度

keys: Going in and coming out raise and lower a flag the sheet can test.
zh_CN: 进入时标记被置为真，离开时置为假，事件表可以检查它。

keys: %s is marked water. Add the two rows that raise the flag on the way in and lower it on the way out?
zh_CN: %s 已标记为水。是否添加在进入时置真、离开时置假的两行？

keys: True while the play head is inside a slice of one clip - the cancel window a follow-up move is allowed in, the active frames a hit counts on.
zh_CN: 当播放头位于某个片段的一段区间内时为真 - 允许后续招式取消的窗口，或命中生效的活动帧。

keys: Is between {from_time} s and {to_time} s of {animation}
zh_CN: 处于 {animation} 的 {from_time} 秒到 {to_time} 秒之间

keys: The clip whose clock the window lives on.
zh_CN: 该窗口所依据的动画片段。

keys: Seconds into the clip the window opens.
zh_CN: 从片段开头起，窗口在第几秒打开。

keys: Seconds into the clip the window shuts.
zh_CN: 从片段开头起，窗口在第几秒关闭。

keys: Ask another AnimationPlayer instead of this one. Leave blank for this node.
zh_CN: 改为询问另一个 AnimationPlayer。留空表示本节点。

keys: Holds THIS animation still for a moment and then lets it run on - the per-object hit-stop, for when only the two characters trading blows should feel it. The wait ignores the game's time scale, so it un-pauses even during a slow-motion.
zh_CN: 只把这一个动画定住片刻再放行 - 逐对象的打击顿帧，适合只让互殴的两个角色感受到。等待会忽略游戏的时间缩放，因此即使在慢动作中也一定会解除。

keys: How long the animation holds still, in real time.
zh_CN: 动画静止多久（按真实时间计）。

keys: Pause another AnimationPlayer instead of this one. Leave blank for this node.
zh_CN: 改为暂停另一个 AnimationPlayer。留空表示本节点。

keys: Runs the moment a sprite animation reaches one frame of one clip - the hit frame, the footstep, the frame a shell drops on. Applying it adds the clip-and-frame question as a condition you can see and edit.
zh_CN: 在精灵动画到达某个片段的某一帧时立刻执行 - 命中帧、脚步帧、弹壳落地的那一帧。应用它会把「哪个片段、第几帧」作为一条看得见也改得动的条件加进来。
当动画 {animation} 到达第 {frame} 帧

keys: The clip the frame belongs to.
Which frame of that clip to answer.
True when a sprite is showing one particular frame of one particular clip - the question under On Animation Frame, on its own for a per-tick check.
zh_CN: 当精灵正显示某个片段的某一帧时为真 - 就是「当动画到达某帧」下面那条判断，单独拿出来做逐帧检查。

keys: The frame index to ask about.
Ask another AnimatedSprite2D instead of this one. Leave blank for this node.
zh_CN: 改为询问另一个 AnimatedSprite2D。留空表示本节点。

keys: Runs when an animation's method track reaches its key. The track calls a function by name and this event IS that function, so the animation and the sheet meet without a signal in between - name the event here and call the same name from the track.
zh_CN: 当动画的方法轨到达关键帧时执行。方法轨按名字调用一个函数，而这个事件就是那个函数，所以动画和事件表之间不需要任何信号 - 在这里给事件起名，再从轨道上调用同一个名字。

keys: The name the animation's method track calls, in plain words ("hit frame" becomes the function _on_hit_frame).
zh_CN: 动画方法轨要调用的名字，用平常的说法写（"hit frame" 会变成函数 _on_hit_frame）。

keys: Remembers a press for a moment so an input made slightly too early still comes out - the jump pressed just before landing, the punch pressed during the last move. Put it under the control's own pressed event.
zh_CN: 把按键记住片刻，让稍微按早了的输入照样出得来 - 落地前一刻按下的跳跃，上一招还没结束就按下的拳。放在该操作自己的按下事件下面。

keys: The number variable remembering the press. Name it after the input - punch_input, jump_input - and the row reads back with that name in it.
zh_CN: 记住这次按键的数字变量。用输入的名字来命名（punch_input、jump_input），这一行读回来时就会带着那个名字。

keys: How long the press stays remembered. A tenth of a second is about six frames at 60 fps, and stays that long on any machine.
zh_CN: 按键会被记住多长时间。0.1 秒在 60 fps 下约为 6 帧，而且在任何机器上都是这么长。

keys: How many physics frames the press stays remembered for. Physics frames, not drawn ones, so the count does not move with the frame rate - but it is still a different length of TIME on a project with a different physics tick.
zh_CN: 按键会被记住多少个物理帧。是物理帧而非绘制帧，所以这个数不会随帧率变化 - 但在物理步长不同的项目里，它仍然是不同长度的时间。

keys: True while a remembered press is still fresh. Ask it the moment the move becomes legal, and consume it in the same breath so one press cannot come out twice.
zh_CN: 只要记住的按键还新鲜就为真。在招式变得可用的那一刻询问，并在同一处消耗掉，免得一次按键出两下。

keys: The number variable remembering the press.
zh_CN: 记住这次按键的数字变量。

keys: Forgets the remembered press, so the move it let through cannot come out a second time. Put it directly under the move it started.
zh_CN: 忘掉记住的按键，免得它放行的那一招再出一次。放在它启动的那一招正下方。

keys: The frame-counted buffer, for a game tuned against a frame-data table. Everything the seconds row does, measured in physics frames instead. Use the frame-counted condition and consume rows with it - do not mix the two clocks on one variable.
zh_CN: 按帧计数的缓存，适合照着帧数据表调数值的游戏。它做的事和按秒的那一行一样，只是改用物理帧来量。请配合同样按帧计数的条件与消耗行使用 - 不要在同一个变量上混用两种计时。

keys: True while a frame-counted press is still fresh. Pair it with Buffer Input (Frames).
zh_CN: 按帧计数的按键仍然有效时为真。与「缓存输入（帧）」配对使用。

keys: Forgets a frame-counted press. Pair it with Buffer Input (Frames).
zh_CN: 忘掉按帧计数的按键。与「缓存输入（帧）」配对使用。
Combo Box ▸ 当连招 {combo} 成立

zh_CN: 整个游戏在 {scale} 处冻结 - 顿帧

zh_CN: 按真实时间计，所以慢动作中也会解除

zh_CN: 处于当前动画的 {from} 秒到 {to} 秒之间
将动画设为 {name}（从末尾播放）

zh_CN: %d 行，跨 %d 帧。保存为测试表即可保留。

zh_CN: %s 不能留空 - 该行无内容可写。

keys: An Inspector section. Double-click to rename it.
zh_CN: 一个检查器分区。双击可重命名。

keys: As a base class, the including script extends it and its events simply are that script's events. As a helper, the including script keeps one of it and forwards its triggers to it - use this when the script already has a base class it needs.
zh_CN: 作为基类时，引入它的脚本会继承它，它的事件就是该脚本的事件。作为辅助对象时，引入它的脚本会保留一个实例并把触发器转发给它 - 当脚本已经需要别的基类时选这个。

keys: Can be switched at runtime - Set group active / Group is active.
zh_CN: 可在运行时切换 - 设置分组激活 / 分组处于激活状态。
按 F2 可在所有位置重命名此类。

keys: If you meant to join text, Set value can.
zh_CN: 如果你想拼接文本，用“设置值”即可。

keys: Lives inside the event or function it sits in.
zh_CN: 只存在于它所在的事件或函数中。

keys: Only this event reads it, and it keeps its value between runs.
zh_CN: 只有这个事件会读取它，并且它在每次运行之间保留自己的值。

keys: Made %s - include it from any script with Add > Include sheet….
zh_CN: 已创建 %s - 在任意脚本中通过“添加 > 引入事件表…”引入它。

keys: Never changes once the game runs.
Off - this group and its rows compile out.
zh_CN: 关闭 - 该分组及其行不会被编译。

keys: One per object - each copy in the scene has its own.
zh_CN: 每个对象各一份 - 场景中的每个副本都有自己的。

keys: One value shared by every copy of this object.
zh_CN: 该对象所有副本共享的一个值。

keys: One value the whole project shares.
zh_CN: 整个项目共享的一个值。

keys: Project Settings ▸ Autoload is where this name lives - it is not in this file.
zh_CN: 该名称位于“项目设置 ▸ 自动加载”中 - 不在此文件里。
正在录制 - 目前 %d 行。

keys: Replay recording ON - save and run to record a take.
zh_CN: 回放录制已开启 - 保存并运行即可录制一段。

keys: Resolved %s - the markers are gone and the rest of the file is untouched.
zh_CN: 已解决 %s - 标记已移除，文件其余部分原封不动。

keys: Save this sheet and ask the running game to reload it. The rows you changed pulse once so you can see them land.
zh_CN: 保存此事件表，并让运行中的游戏重新加载它。改动过的行会闪烁一次，让你看到它们生效。

keys: Saved %s - run it from Tools > Run Tests…, or headlessly with the rest.
zh_CN: 已保存 %s - 可从“工具 > 运行测试…”运行，或与其余测试一起无头运行。

keys: Saved in every resource made from this - a data field, not a live value.
zh_CN: 会保存在由此创建的每个资源中 - 这是数据字段，不是运行时的值。

keys: Sheet ▸ Sheet Type… ▸ More is where the included sheets are listed.
zh_CN: 引入的事件表列在“事件表 ▸ 事件表类型… ▸ 更多”里。

keys: Shows what this sheet would look like with the shipped behavior doing the work, before changing anything.
zh_CN: 在改动任何内容之前，先展示由内置行为来完成这些工作时，这张事件表会是什么样子。
已按 A-Z 排序变量。

keys: Start a take. Every control the running game sees is recorded with the frame it happened on. Recording a second take throws the first one away.
zh_CN: 开始一段录制。运行中的游戏收到的每一次操作都会连同发生的帧一起记录。录制第二段会丢弃第一段。

keys: Stop recording. The take is kept, so you can still add checkpoints and save it.
zh_CN: 停止录制。这段录制会保留，你仍可添加检查点并保存它。

keys: Stop the game and run it again - the only way to pick this change up.
zh_CN: 停止游戏并重新运行 - 这是让此改动生效的唯一方式。

keys: The class icon. Click to pick another image.
zh_CN: 类图标。点击可另选一张图片。

keys: The line this band stands for. Click to open it in the code panel.
zh_CN: 此栏所代表的代码行。点击可在代码面板中打开。

keys: The line this row writes. Click to open it in the code panel.
zh_CN: 此行写出的代码行。点击可在代码面板中打开。

keys: The variables are already in name order.
There is no node %s in this scene yet - fine if it is spawned at runtime, otherwise check the path.
zh_CN: 此场景中还没有节点 %s - 若它在运行时生成则没问题，否则请检查路径。

keys: There is no node named %s in this scene - right-click it in the scene tree and choose Access as Unique Name, or it may be spawned at runtime.
zh_CN: 此场景中没有名为 %s 的节点 - 在场景树中右键单击它并选择“作为唯一名称访问”，也可能它是在运行时生成的。

keys: This is not an expression this sheet can compile.
zh_CN: 这不是本事件表能编译的表达式。

keys: This sheet no longer runs in the editor.
zh_CN: 此事件表不再在编辑器中运行。

keys: This sheet runs in the editor too.
zh_CN: 此事件表在编辑器中也会运行。

keys: Turns on "Can be switched at runtime" for this group, so this row can reach it.
zh_CN: 为该分组打开“可在运行时切换”，让此行能够操作它。

keys: Write the file back with the markers gone. Every byte outside the conflicted region is left exactly as it is.
zh_CN: 去掉标记后把文件写回。冲突区域之外的每个字节都原样保留。

keys: Write the take as an ordinary Test sheet - readable rows, replayed by the same runner as every other test.
zh_CN: 把这段录制写成一张普通的测试事件表 - 行是可读的，并由运行其他测试的同一个执行器回放。
写出 ## 块 · 回车确认。
暂时没有 - 是在运行时添加的吗？

zh_CN: 不会改动其他地方 - 这个名字尚未在任何地方使用

keys: Couldn't find %s to write this row with.
zh_CN: 找不到 %s 来写这一行。
重命名 %d 处%s 使用，涉及 %d 个%s 表

keys: # no class_name - the name is the autoload entry
zh_CN: # 没有 class_name - 名称来自 autoload 条目

keys: # no class_name - named by its file
zh_CN: # 没有 class_name - 由文件名命名

keys: %s never closes, so it cannot fold. Add %s after the last row you want inside.
zh_CN: %s 从未关闭，因此无法折叠。请在要包含的最后一行之后添加 %s。

keys: %s closes nothing - there is no #region above it. Remove it, or open a region first.
zh_CN: %s 没有关闭任何内容 - 它上面没有 #region。请删除它，或先开启一个区域。

keys: every networking line reads as a row - %d of %d
zh_CN: 每一行网络代码都读作行 - %d / %d

keys: %d of %d networking lines read as rows
%s added - pick a mode to keep a value in step.
zh_CN: 已添加 %s - 请选择一种模式来保持某个值同步。

keys: %s is not in the open scene any more.
%s is not kept in step any more.
%s selected in %s - its panels are the Inspector and Replication.
zh_CN: 已在 %s 中选中 %s - 对应面板是检查器和 Replication。

keys: Open %s to change what it keeps in step.
zh_CN: 打开 %s 以更改保持同步的内容。

keys: The scene is only editable inside the editor.
zh_CN: 场景只能在编辑器内修改。

keys: Every peer runs these events. Right for anything a player sees or hears, and for a game with no networking in it.
zh_CN: 每个对等端都会运行这些事件。适合玩家能看到或听到的一切，也适合不联机的游戏。

keys: Only the peer that called Host a game runs them. Right for anything that decides what is true; the others learn the result through a message or a value kept in step.
zh_CN: 只有调用了主持游戏的对等端会运行它们。适合一切决定真实结果的处理；其他端通过消息或同步的值得知结果。

keys: Only the peer that owns this object runs them. Right for what each player controls about their own character, so nobody moves anybody else's.
zh_CN: 只有拥有该对象的对等端会运行它们。适合每个玩家对自己角色的操作，这样没人能移动别人的角色。

keys: Who runs the events in this group - right-click the head to change it.
zh_CN: 谁来运行该组中的事件 - 右键单击标题可以更改。

keys: %s is not marked as a message yet, so nothing would travel. Right-click its function row and choose Make it a message.
zh_CN: %s 尚未标记为消息，因此不会发送任何内容。右键点击它的函数行并选择"设为消息"。

keys: Any peer may send this message, so a client can ask the host for something. The host has to decide whether to believe it: check Sender before acting on anything a player could have made up.
zh_CN: 任何对等端都可以发送这条消息，因此客户端可以请求主机做某件事。主机必须判断是否相信它：在响应玩家可能伪造的内容之前，先检查发送者。

keys: Only the peer that owns this node may send it - the host, unless the node was given away. A call from anybody else is dropped and logged, which is what makes this the safe answer.
zh_CN: 只有拥有该节点的对等端才能发送它 - 除非节点已被转交，否则就是主机。来自其他人的调用会被丢弃并记录，这正是它成为安全选项的原因。

keys: Every peer that receives it runs the function; the peer that sent it does not. Right when the sender has already done the thing itself and is only telling the others.
zh_CN: 收到它的每个对等端都会运行该函数，发送方不会。适合发送方已经自己做过这件事、只是告知其他人的情形。

keys: On the others, and here too
The sender runs the function as well, so one row is the whole effect. This is why the shot you fired lands for you at the same moment as for everybody else.
zh_CN: 发送方也会运行该函数，因此一行就是全部效果。这就是你打出的那一枪在你这边和在其他人那边同时命中的原因。

keys: Sent again until it arrives, and it arrives in the order it was sent. Right for anything that happens once - a hit, a pickup, a round starting.
zh_CN: 会重发直到送达，并按发送顺序到达。适合只发生一次的事 - 一次命中、一次拾取、一轮开始。

keys: Sent once and never chased. Right for a value replaced a few times a second anyway, where one that goes missing costs nothing because the next is already on its way.
zh_CN: 只发送一次，不会重发。适合本来每秒就更新好几次的值 - 丢掉一个也没有代价，因为下一个已经在路上。

keys: Sent once, and one that arrives after a newer one is thrown away. Right for a stream where only the latest matters - a position, an aim direction.
zh_CN: 只发送一次，比更新的那条晚到的会被丢弃。适合只有最新值才重要的数据流 - 位置、瞄准方向。

keys: Messages on different channels do not queue behind each other. Leave it at 0 unless one big reliable message - a level, a long list - is holding up something small and frequent.
zh_CN: 不同通道上的消息不会互相排队。除非某条大的可靠消息 - 一个关卡、一份长列表 - 正拖住频繁的小消息，否则保持 0。

keys: The function the other peers run. Only a function marked as a message travels, and the list holds the ones this sheet marks.
zh_CN: 其他对等端要运行的函数。只有标记为消息的函数才会传送，列表里是本表标记过的那些。

keys: The id of the peer that runs it - the event's own id, or Sender to answer whoever just sent you a message.
zh_CN: 运行它的对等端 id - 事件自带的 id，或者用发送者来回复刚给你发消息的那一方。

keys: A value to send along. It arrives as this parameter on every peer that runs the message.
zh_CN: 随消息一起发送的值。它会作为这个参数到达运行该消息的每个对等端。

keys: %s is not one of Godot's @rpc options, so this row shows the annotation as it stands.
zh_CN: %s 不是 Godot 的 @rpc 选项之一，因此这一行原样显示该注解。

keys: Every connected peer runs the message, and this peer as well when the message says it also runs here.
zh_CN: 每个已连接的对等端都会运行该消息；如果消息声明本端也执行，则本端也会运行。

keys: Only peer 1 runs it - the one hosting the game. This is how a client asks for something it may not decide by itself.
zh_CN: 只有对等端 1 会运行它 - 也就是主持游戏的那一方。客户端就是这样请求自己无权决定的事情。

keys: Only the peer whose id you give runs it. The event's own id, or Sender to answer whoever just sent you a message.
zh_CN: 只有你指定 id 的那个对等端会运行它。可以用事件自带的 id，或用发送者来回复刚给你发消息的一方。

keys: The line that makes this function a message. Click to open it in the code panel.
zh_CN: 使这个函数成为消息的那一行。点击可在代码面板中打开它。

keys: %s is not in %s's list of scenes it may spawn yet. Pressing OK adds it, as one step of the scene's own undo.
zh_CN: %s 还不在 %s 允许生成的场景列表里。按下确定会把它加进去，作为场景自身撤销记录中的一步。

keys: %s may be watching %d copies at once - its Spawn limit in the Inspector. Past that it refuses to make another until one goes.
zh_CN: %s 最多同时照看 %d 份副本 - 这是检查器里的 Spawn limit。超过之后，它会等到有一份消失才再生成。

keys: Open %s to change what its spawner may spawn.
zh_CN: 打开 %s 才能修改它的生成器可以生成什么。

keys: %s is not a message: nothing will arrive. Mark the function as a message first.
zh_CN: %s 不是消息，什么都不会送达。请先把该函数标记为消息。

keys: %s is changed in a group that runs on the host, but only the host will see the new value. Keep it in step, or send it.
zh_CN: %s 在只由主机运行的分组里被改变，但只有主机会看到新值。让它保持同步，或者把它发出去。

keys: %s runs on every peer, and only the owner of this object should move it. Put the event in a group that runs on the owner.
zh_CN: %s 会在每个对等端运行，但只有这个对象的所有者才应该移动它。把事件放进一个由所有者运行的分组里。

keys: %s may be sent by anyone, and it writes %s without asking who sent it. Any player could send it themselves.
zh_CN: %s 谁都可以发送，而且它在不确认发送者的情况下写入 %s。任何玩家都可以自己发一条。

keys: Couldn't find that event to group.
zh_CN: 找不到要分组的那个事件。

keys: Only the owner of this object runs it now.
zh_CN: 现在只有这个对象的所有者会运行它。

keys: Run two copies of the game at once, tagged %s and %s, and play the scene this sheet is attached to. It sets Godot's own Debug > Run Multiple Instances (2 instances, one feature tag each), so an On ready > Started as host event hosts in one window while the other joins. Untick Enable Multiple Instances in that same dialog to go back to one.
zh_CN: 同时运行游戏的两个副本，分别标记为 %s 和 %s，并播放此表所附加的场景。它设置的是 Godot 自己的调试 > 运行多个实例（2 个实例，各带一个功能标签），因此当就绪 > 启动标签为 的事件会在一个窗口中主持游戏，另一个窗口加入。要恢复为一个，请在同一对话框中取消勾选启用多个实例。

keys: Run Multiple Instances is an editor setting, and there is no editor here.
zh_CN: 运行多个实例是编辑器设置，而这里没有编辑器。

keys: Already set to run %d copies, tagged %s.
zh_CN: 已经设置为运行 %d 个副本，标记为 %s。
已设置为运行 %d 个副本，标记为 %s。

keys: %d occluder blocks the light on this layer
zh_CN: %d 个遮挡器挡住了该层的光

keys: %d occluders block the light on this layer
zh_CN: %d 个遮挡器挡住了该层的光

keys: %s casts shadows and no occluder's mask matches - shadows never appear
zh_CN: %s 会投射阴影，但没有遮挡器的遮罩匹配 - 阴影永远不会出现

zh_CN: 保存在本场景内 - 其他场景看不到改动

keys: %s has no texture, so it lights nothing. Give it one - a soft white circle is the whole of a torch.
zh_CN: %s 没有纹理，因此什么也照不亮。给它一张 - 一个柔和的白色圆形就是一支火把的全部。

keys: Add an occluder, or turn the shadows off and save the draw cost.
zh_CN: 添加一个遮挡体，或者关闭阴影以省下绘制开销。

keys: %s darkens the layer to %s and no light reaches it - the scene is uniformly dark. Add a light, or check the range masks of the ones there are.
zh_CN: %s 将该层压暗到 %s，却没有任何灯光照到它 - 场景会一片漆黑。添加一盏灯，或检查现有灯光的范围遮罩。

keys: %s writes the world's environment, and %s has no WorldEnvironment node - the row does nothing when the game runs. Add one to the scene.
zh_CN: %s 会写入世界的环境，而 %s 里没有 WorldEnvironment 节点 - 游戏运行时这一行什么也不会做。给场景加一个。

keys: %s writes %s, which %s also uses - the change follows the player into those scenes. Give this scene its own copy first.
zh_CN: %s 会写入 %s，而 %s 也在用同一个文件 - 这个改动会跟着玩家进入那些场景。先让这个场景拥有自己的副本。

keys: Make the environment this scene's own
zh_CN: 让环境成为这个场景自己的

keys: Lighting: %d lit scene(s), %d with something that will not show at run time.
zh_CN: 光照：%d 个有光照的场景，其中 %d 个含有运行时看不到的东西。

keys: This sheet already takes its own copy.
zh_CN: 这张事件表已经取了自己的副本。

keys: This scene has its own environment now - the change stops here.
zh_CN: 这个场景现在有了自己的环境 - 改动到此为止。

keys: Runs a message on every peer in the game, including this one when the message says so. The function must be marked as a message first.
zh_CN: 在游戏中的每个对等端上运行一条消息；若消息如此指定，也包括本端。函数必须先被标记为消息。

keys: The function marked as a message. Every peer runs it.
zh_CN: 被标记为消息的函数。每个对等端都会运行它。

keys: Values to send with the message, comma separated.
zh_CN: 随消息一起发送的值，用逗号分隔。

keys: Runs a message on the host only - the peer that decides what is true, so cheats cannot be sent straight to everybody.
zh_CN: 只在主机上运行消息 - 主机是决定什么为真的那一端，所以作弊无法被直接发给所有人。

keys: The function marked as a message. Only the host runs it.
zh_CN: 被标记为消息的函数。只有主机会运行它。
向单个对等端发送消息

keys: Runs a message on one named peer only - a private reply, or a correction sent back to the player it is about.
zh_CN: 只在你指定的那个对等端上运行消息 - 用于私下回复，或把纠正结果发回给相关玩家。

keys: The function marked as a message. Only the peer you name runs it.
zh_CN: 被标记为消息的函数。只有你指定的对等端会运行它。

keys: Who to send it to: the id an event handed you, or Sender to answer whoever asked.
zh_CN: 发送给谁：事件交给你的 id，或用 发送方 回复提出请求的那一端。

keys: True on the peer that is hosting the game. Put everything that decides what is true behind this.
zh_CN: 在托管游戏的那一端为真。凡是决定什么为真的逻辑，都放在这个条件后面。

keys: True when this peer is the one allowed to move and change this object - the player's own character rather than everybody else's copy of it.
zh_CN: 当本端就是可以移动和改动该对象的那一端时为真 - 也就是玩家自己的角色，而不是别人手里的副本。

keys: This peer's own id. The host is always 1; everyone else gets a number when they join.
zh_CN: 本端自己的 id。主机始终是 1，其他人加入时各自拿到一个编号。

keys: Opens this game to other players and makes this peer the host - the one whose answers everybody else takes as true. Nobody is connected yet; On player joined tells you when somebody is.
zh_CN: 把这局游戏对其他玩家开放，并让本端成为主机 - 主机的答案会被所有人当作真的。此时还没有人连上；有人加入时会由「玩家加入时」告诉你。

keys: Host a game on port {port} for up to {max_players} players
zh_CN: 在端口 {port} 上主持一局最多 {max_players} 名玩家的游戏

keys: The port players connect to. Anything from 1024 to 65535 is yours to pick; both sides must use the same number.
zh_CN: 玩家连接的端口。1024 到 65535 之间随你挑，但两边必须用同一个号。

keys: How many peers may connect. The host is not one of them, so 4 here means the host plus four others.
zh_CN: 可以连入的对等端数量。主机不算在内，所以这里填 4 表示主机再加四个人。

keys: How the game talks over the network. ENet unless the game runs in a browser.
zh_CN: 游戏在网络上通信的方式。除非游戏跑在浏览器里，否则用 ENet。

keys: WebSocket - also works in a browser
Asks a host to let this peer in. The answer arrives later as On joined the host or On join failed - nothing is connected the moment this row runs.
zh_CN: 请求主机放本端进去。答复稍后以「加入主机时」或「加入失败时」到来 - 这一行执行的当下还没有任何连接。
加入 {address} 端口 {port} 的游戏

keys: Where the host is. 127.0.0.1 is this same machine; on a home network it is the host's local address, and over the internet it is whatever address the host published.
zh_CN: 主机在哪里。127.0.0.1 就是本机；在家庭网络里是主机的局域网地址，通过互联网则是主机对外公布的地址。

keys: The port the host opened. It has to be the same number the host used.
zh_CN: 主机开放的端口。必须和主机用的号一致。

keys: How the game talks over the network. It has to match what the host is using.
zh_CN: 游戏在网络上通信的方式。必须与主机所用的一致。

keys: Drops this peer's connection and puts the game back to single player. On the host this ends the game for everybody, because there is nobody left to answer them.
zh_CN: 断开本端的连接，把游戏退回单人。若在主机上执行，所有人的游戏都会结束，因为再没有人回应他们了。

keys: Makes one copy of a scene on the host and on every peer at once. Only the host may call it; everybody else receives the copy.
zh_CN: 在主机和每个对等端上同时生成一份场景副本。只有主机可以调用；其他人接收这份副本。

keys: The MultiplayerSpawner that makes the copies. It decides which scene, and where in the tree it goes.
zh_CN: 负责生成副本的 MultiplayerSpawner。由它决定是哪个场景、放在树的什么位置。

keys: What the spawner is told to make. A plain value when the spawner has a spawn function to read it, or nothing at all when its scene list is enough.
zh_CN: 交给生成器去做什么。若生成器有读取它的生成函数，就填一个普通值；若它的场景列表已经够用，就什么都不填。

keys: Drops one player's connection from the host. Only the host may do it - a client that wants somebody kicked sends the host a message and lets it decide.
zh_CN: 由主机断开某位玩家的连接。只有主机可以这么做 - 想踢人的客户端应向主机发消息，由主机决定。

keys: The peer id to drop. On player left then runs on everybody, the dropped peer included.
zh_CN: 要断开的对等端 id。之后「玩家离开时」会在所有人身上运行，包括被踢的那一端。

keys: Closes the lobby without ending the game: everybody already in stays, and nobody else gets in. Run it when the match starts, or when the last seat is taken.
zh_CN: 在不结束游戏的前提下关闭大厅：已经进来的人照旧，其他人再也进不来。比赛开始时，或最后一个位置被占时执行。

keys: Whether the host forwards messages between clients. Off is the safer setting for a game where the host decides what is true, because then no client can talk to another behind its back.
zh_CN: 主机是否在客户端之间转发消息。在由主机决定什么为真的游戏里，关闭更安全 - 这样客户端之间无法背着主机私聊。
将玩家之间的消息转发设为 {on}

keys: On, the host passes a message from one client on to another. Off, a client can only reach the host.
zh_CN: 开启后，主机会把一个客户端的消息转给另一个客户端。关闭时，客户端只能连到主机。
