keys: Finishes the handshake for one peer: it counts as joined, and On player joined runs. A peer that is never accepted or rejected simply waits, so every handshake needs one of the two.
zh_CN: 为某个对等端完成握手：它算作已加入，并触发「玩家加入时」。既没被接纳也没被拒绝的对等端只会一直等着，所以每次握手都需要这两者之一。

keys: The peer whose handshake is finished - the id On player authenticating gave you.
zh_CN: 要完成握手的对等端 - 也就是「玩家验证时」交给你的 id。

keys: Turns away a peer that did not prove who it is. That peer sees On join failed; nobody else in the game hears about it.
zh_CN: 把没能证明自己身份的对等端挡回去。那一端会收到「加入失败时」，游戏里的其他人不会知道。

keys: The peer to turn away. It never counted as joined, so On player left does not run for it.
zh_CN: 要拒绝的对等端。它从未算作加入，所以「玩家离开时」不会为它运行。

keys: Sends the bytes one side of the handshake wants the other to check - a password, a token, a version number. They travel before the peer counts as joined, which is why this is not an ordinary message.
zh_CN: 发送握手一方希望另一方核对的字节 - 密码、令牌、版本号。它们在对等端算作加入之前就已传送，因此这不是普通消息。
将验证数据 {data} 发送给玩家 {id}

keys: Who to send it to. A client answering the host sends to 1.
zh_CN: 发送给谁。回复主机的客户端发给 1。

keys: The bytes to send. var_to_bytes(...) turns a value into them, and bytes_to_var(...) reads them back on the other side.
zh_CN: 要发送的字节。var_to_bytes(...) 把一个值变成字节，另一端用 bytes_to_var(...) 读回来。

keys: Hands one object to one player: from then on that peer is the one allowed to move it, and Owns this object is true only there. Run it on every peer - a host that decides alone leaves the others disagreeing about who owns what.
zh_CN: 把一个对象移交给某位玩家：从此只有那一端可以移动它，「拥有此对象」也只在那里为真。请在每个对等端上执行 - 只由主机自己决定，会让其他人对谁拥有什么各执一词。

keys: The node whose owner changes. Its children follow it unless one was given an owner of its own.
zh_CN: 所有者发生变化的节点。它的子节点会跟着走，除非某个子节点被单独指定了所有者。

keys: The peer that may now move and change it. Everybody else keeps a copy they may only read.
zh_CN: 从现在起可以移动和改动它的那一端。其他人保留一份只能读取的副本。

keys: True once this peer is really in a game - hosting one, or accepted by a host. It stays false while a join is still being answered, which is the moment a lobby screen has to keep waiting.
zh_CN: 一旦本端真的身处一局游戏中就为真 - 自己在主持，或已被主机接纳。加入请求还没有回音时保持为假，而那正是大厅界面该继续等待的时刻。

keys: True when this build carries the named export tag, so one project can host itself, join itself, or run headless as a server. A real server build gets its tag from the Dedicated Server export preset and is run with --headless.
zh_CN: 当这个构建带有指定的导出标签时为真，于是同一个项目既能自己当主机、自己加入，也能作为无界面服务器运行。真正的服务器构建从 Dedicated Server 导出预设拿到标签，并以 --headless 启动。

keys: The feature tag this build was exported with. host and client are tags you add to two presets yourself; dedicated_server is the one Godot's own server preset sets.
zh_CN: 这个构建导出时带的功能标签。host 和 client 是你自己给两个预设加的标签；dedicated_server 由 Godot 自带的服务器预设设置。

keys: The ids of every OTHER peer in the game, as a list. This peer is not in it - My ID is that one.
zh_CN: 游戏中所有其他对等端的 id，返回为一个列表。本端不在其中 - 那是「我的 ID」。

keys: How many other peers are in the game. Add one for this peer when the number a player reads should include them.
zh_CN: 游戏中其他对等端的数量。若玩家看到的数字应把自己算上，请再加一。

keys: Inside a message, the id of the peer that sent it - the one thing a message cannot lie about, so check it before trusting what it asked for. It is 0 anywhere else.
zh_CN: 在消息内部，发出该消息的对等端 id - 这是消息唯一无法伪造的东西，所以在相信它的要求之前先核对它。在其他地方它是 0。

keys: The id of the peer that owns an object - the one allowed to move it. It is 1 until somebody gives it away, because the host owns everything to begin with.
zh_CN: 拥有某个对象的对等端 id - 也就是可以移动它的那一端。在有人转交之前它是 1，因为一开始一切都属于主机。

keys: The node to ask about. Its owner is the peer allowed to move and change it.
zh_CN: 要询问的节点。它的所有者就是可以移动和改动它的那一端。

keys: Runs when another peer connects - on the host, and on every peer already in the game. The host is the one that hands out what a new player needs.
zh_CN: 当另一个对等端连上时运行 - 在主机上，也在每个已经在游戏里的对等端上。由主机来发放新玩家所需要的东西。

keys: The id of the peer that just joined. Whatever a new player needs is sent to this id.
zh_CN: 刚刚加入的对等端 id。新玩家需要的东西就发给这个 id。

keys: Runs when a peer disconnects, however it went - quit, crash or lost connection. Clean up whatever belonged to that player here.
zh_CN: 当某个对等端断开时运行，无论是退出、崩溃还是掉线。属于那位玩家的东西在这里清理。

keys: The id of the peer that just left. It is already gone, so nothing can be sent to it.
zh_CN: 刚刚离开的对等端 id。它已经走了，什么都发不过去。

keys: Runs on the joining peer once the host has accepted it. This is where a lobby screen gives way to the game.
zh_CN: 在加入方的对等端上运行，一旦主机接纳它就触发。大厅界面在这里让位给游戏。

keys: Runs on the joining peer when the host never answered or refused it - the wrong address, the wrong port, or a game that is not accepting players.
zh_CN: 在试图加入的对等端上运行，当主机始终没有回应或拒绝了它 - 地址不对、端口不对，或者这局游戏不再接纳玩家。

keys: Runs on every remaining peer when the host goes away. The game is over for them: send them back to the menu here.
zh_CN: 当主机消失时，在每个仍在线的对等端上运行。对他们来说这局已经结束：在这里把他们送回菜单。

keys: Runs on the host while a peer is still proving who it is - before On player joined. Answer it with Accept player or Reject player; the bytes the peer sent arrive through the auth callback.
zh_CN: 在对等端还在证明自己身份时于主机上运行，早于「玩家加入时」。用「接纳玩家」或「拒绝玩家」来回应；对方发来的字节通过验证回调到达。

keys: The id of the peer that is trying to join. It is not in the game yet.
zh_CN: 正在尝试加入的对等端 id。它还没进入游戏。

keys: Runs when a peer never proved who it was - the wrong answer, or nobody answered in time. The peer is dropped; this is where the reason is shown.
zh_CN: 当某个对等端始终没能证明自己身份时运行 - 答案不对，或者没人及时回应。该端会被断开；在这里显示原因。

keys: The id of the peer whose handshake did not finish.
zh_CN: 握手未能完成的对等端 id。

keys: Makes one copy of a scene on the host and on every peer at once. Only the host may run it, and everybody else receives the copy from the spawner - which is why the scene has to be in that spawner's list.
zh_CN: 在主机和每个对等端上同时生成一份场景副本。只有主机可以执行，其他人从生成器那里收到副本 - 所以这个场景必须在该生成器的列表里。
在 {at} 生成名为 {name} 的 {scene}

keys: The MultiplayerSpawner that watches for the copy: it carries the list of scenes and the path a copy goes under.
zh_CN: 负责盯着这份副本的 MultiplayerSpawner：它带着场景列表，以及副本要挂到的路径。

keys: The scene to make, from the spawner's own list of the scenes it may spawn. One that is not in the list yet is added to it when this row is applied.
zh_CN: 要创建的场景，取自该生成器可生成的场景列表。若还不在列表里，应用这一行时会被加进去。

keys: What to call the copy. Naming it after the player's id is the usual choice, because that is what lets the copy make that player its owner.
zh_CN: 副本要叫什么名字。通常用玩家的 id 来命名，因为副本正是靠它把该玩家设为自己的所有者。

keys: Where to put it - a point for a 2D scene, a Vector3 for a 3D one. It is set before the copy joins the tree, so it never shows up at the origin first.
zh_CN: 放在哪里 - 2D 场景用一个点，3D 场景用 Vector3。它在副本进入树之前就设好，所以副本不会先出现在原点。

keys: Takes this copy out of the game everywhere. Run it on the peer that owns the object: the spawner that made it sees it go and removes it on every other peer, so nothing has to be sent by hand.
zh_CN: 把这份副本从所有地方移出游戏。请在拥有该对象的那一端执行：当初生成它的生成器会看到它离开，并在其他每一端把它移除，无需手工发送任何东西。

keys: Lets one player see what this synchronizer keeps in step. Visibility is decided per peer, so a game can keep a hand of cards, a scouted unit or a room nobody else is in away from everybody but the player it belongs to.
zh_CN: 让某位玩家看到这个同步器所同步的内容。可见性是按对等端决定的，所以游戏可以把一手牌、一支被侦察到的单位，或者没有别人在的房间，只留给它所属的那位玩家。

keys: The peer that may see it from now on. It starts receiving whatever this synchronizer keeps in step.
zh_CN: 从现在起可以看到它的那一端。它开始接收这个同步器所同步的内容。

keys: Stops sending one player anything this synchronizer keeps in step. The node is not deleted on that peer, it simply stops arriving - so a value they were never meant to see cannot be read out of the packets either.
zh_CN: 不再向某位玩家发送这个同步器所同步的内容。该端上的节点不会被删除，只是不再收到 - 这样本不该被看到的值，也无法从数据包里读出来。

keys: The peer that stops seeing it. Nothing is sent to them for this node until it is shown again.
zh_CN: 不再看到它的那一端。在重新显示之前，这个节点的任何内容都不会发给它。

keys: Puts this synchronizer back to being seen by every player, whatever was shown or hidden per peer before. That is the setting it starts on, so this row is how hiding is undone rather than something a game has to say first.
zh_CN: 把这个同步器恢复为所有玩家都能看到，无论之前按端做过什么显示或隐藏。它本来就是这个初始设置，所以这一行是用来撤销隐藏，而不是游戏必须先写的一句。

keys: Ask A Function Who May See It

Hands the who-may-see-it question to a function instead of answering it player by player. It is asked again as players come and go, so a rule like same room or same team keeps itself true with no row saying so.
zh_CN: 把「谁能看到」这个问题交给一个函数，而不是逐个玩家去回答。玩家进出时会被反复询问，所以像同一房间、同一队伍这样的规则会自己保持成立，不需要任何一行去说。

keys: The function that answers. It is handed one player's id and returns true when that player may see this node - a function of this sheet, named without its brackets.
zh_CN: 负责回答的函数。它会收到某位玩家的 id，若该玩家可以看到这个节点就返回 true - 填本事件表里的函数名，不带括号。

keys: Runs on every peer the moment this spawner makes a copy, the host included. It is where a copy is joined up to the rest of the game: a name added to a scoreboard, a camera pointed at it.
zh_CN: 当这个生成器造出一份副本的那一刻，在包括主机在内的每个对等端上运行。这里是把副本接进游戏其余部分的地方：往记分板加个名字，把摄像机对准它。

keys: The copy that has just been made - the same node, on every peer that got it.
zh_CN: 刚刚生成的副本 - 在收到它的每个对等端上都是同一个节点。

keys: Runs on every peer as this spawner takes a copy away, whether its owner despawned it or the player it belonged to left the game. Clean up whatever was pointing at that copy here.
zh_CN: 当这个生成器把一份副本撤走时，在每个对等端上运行 - 无论是所有者主动移除，还是它所属的玩家离开了游戏。指向那份副本的东西在这里清理。

keys: The copy that is going away. It is still in the tree while this runs, so it can still be asked what it was.
zh_CN: 正在离开的副本。这段运行时它仍在树里，所以还能问出它原本是什么。

keys: Runs on a peer that has just been sent new values for the properties this synchronizer keeps in step. Right for anything that has to answer a value that ARRIVED rather than one this peer changed itself.
zh_CN: 当某个对等端刚收到这个同步器所同步属性的新值时运行。凡是要对「收到的」值作出反应，而不是对本端自己改的值作出反应，都放在这里。

keys: How bright the light is, as a fraction: 0.5 is half, 2.0 is double. Writes `Light2D.energy`.
zh_CN: 灯光有多亮，用倍数表示：0.5 是一半，2.0 是两倍。写入 `Light2D.energy`。

keys: How bright the light is, as a fraction: 0.5 is half, 2.0 is double.
zh_CN: 灯光有多亮，用倍数表示：0.5 是一半，2.0 是两倍。

keys: Reads brightness back: `Light2D.energy`. Use it in any value field.
zh_CN: 读回亮度：`Light2D.energy`。可用于任何取值字段。

keys: Walks brightness to a new value over time instead of jumping to it - one tween, no state to keep. Writes `Light2D.energy`.
zh_CN: 让亮度随时间走到新值，而不是一步跳过去 - 一个 tween，不必保存任何状态。写入 `Light2D.energy`。

keys: The light to fade. Leave it as self to fade the light this sheet is on.
zh_CN: 要渐变的灯光。保留 self 就作用于本事件表所挂的那盏灯。

keys: How bright the light is, as a fraction: 0.5 is half, 2.0 is double. Writes `Light3D.light_energy`.
zh_CN: 灯光有多亮，用倍数表示：0.5 是一半，2.0 是两倍。写入 `Light3D.light_energy`。

keys: Reads brightness back: `Light3D.light_energy`. Use it in any value field.
zh_CN: 读回亮度：`Light3D.light_energy`。可用于任何取值字段。

keys: Walks brightness to a new value over time instead of jumping to it - one tween, no state to keep. Writes `Light3D.light_energy`.
zh_CN: 让亮度随时间走到新值，而不是一步跳过去 - 一个 tween，不必保存任何状态。写入 `Light3D.light_energy`。

keys: The colour the light casts. Writes `Light2D.color`.
Reads the light's colour back: `Light2D.color`. Use it in any value field.
zh_CN: 读回灯光的颜色：`Light2D.color`。可用于任何取值字段。

keys: The colour the light casts. Writes `Light3D.light_color`.
Reads the light's colour back: `Light3D.light_color`. Use it in any value field.
zh_CN: 读回灯光的颜色：`Light3D.light_color`。可用于任何取值字段。

keys: How far the light gets: a scale for a 2D light's texture, metres for a 3D one. Writes `PointLight2D.texture_scale`.
zh_CN: 光能照多远：2D 灯光是贴图的缩放，3D 灯光是米。写入 `PointLight2D.texture_scale`。

keys: How far the light gets: a scale for a 2D light's texture, metres for a 3D one.
zh_CN: 光能照多远：2D 灯光是贴图的缩放，3D 灯光是米。

keys: Reads reach back: `PointLight2D.texture_scale`. Use it in any value field.
zh_CN: 读回照射范围：`PointLight2D.texture_scale`。可用于任何取值字段。

keys: How far the light gets: a scale for a 2D light's texture, metres for a 3D one. Writes `OmniLight3D.omni_range`.
zh_CN: 光能照多远：2D 灯光是贴图的缩放，3D 灯光是米。写入 `OmniLight3D.omni_range`。

keys: Reads reach back: `OmniLight3D.omni_range`. Use it in any value field.
zh_CN: 读回照射范围：`OmniLight3D.omni_range`。可用于任何取值字段。

keys: How far the light gets: a scale for a 2D light's texture, metres for a 3D one. Writes `SpotLight3D.spot_range`.
zh_CN: 光能照多远：2D 灯光是贴图的缩放，3D 灯光是米。写入 `SpotLight3D.spot_range`。

keys: Reads reach back: `SpotLight3D.spot_range`. Use it in any value field.
zh_CN: 读回照射范围：`SpotLight3D.spot_range`。可用于任何取值字段。

keys: How wide the spot's cone opens, in degrees from its centre line. Writes `SpotLight3D.spot_angle`.
zh_CN: 聚光灯的锥体张开多大，以中心轴起算的角度（度）。写入 `SpotLight3D.spot_angle`。

keys: How wide the spot's cone opens, in degrees from its centre line.
zh_CN: 聚光灯的锥体张开多大，以中心轴起算的角度（度）。

keys: Reads cone angle back: `SpotLight3D.spot_angle`. Use it in any value field.
zh_CN: 读回锥角：`SpotLight3D.spot_angle`。可用于任何取值字段。

keys: Whether the light is lit. A 2D light switches with `enabled`; a 3D light has no such property, so it switches with `visible`. Writes `Light2D.enabled`.
zh_CN: 灯是否亮着。2D 灯光用 `enabled` 开关；3D 灯光没有这个属性，改用 `visible`。写入 `Light2D.enabled`。

keys: Whether the light is lit. A 2D light switches with `enabled`; a 3D light has no such property, so it switches with `visible`. Writes `Light3D.visible`.
zh_CN: 灯是否亮着。2D 灯光用 `enabled` 开关；3D 灯光没有这个属性，改用 `visible`。写入 `Light3D.visible`。

keys: Whether the light casts shadows - the cheapest lighting switch there is. Writes `Light2D.shadow_enabled`.
zh_CN: 灯光是否投下阴影 - 这是最省开销的一个光照开关。写入 `Light2D.shadow_enabled`。

keys: True while is casting shadows. Reads `Light2D.shadow_enabled`.
zh_CN: 灯光正在投射阴影时为真。读取 `Light2D.shadow_enabled`。

keys: Whether the light casts shadows - the cheapest lighting switch there is. Writes `Light3D.shadow_enabled`.
zh_CN: 灯光是否投下阴影 - 这是最省开销的一个光照开关。写入 `Light3D.shadow_enabled`。

keys: True while is casting shadows. Reads `Light3D.shadow_enabled`.
zh_CN: 灯光正在投射阴影时为真。读取 `Light3D.shadow_enabled`。

keys: Darkens a whole 2D layer at once - the one row that makes a level read as night. Writes `CanvasModulate.color`; the row reads the colour back as how dark it makes the layer.
zh_CN: 一次性把整个 2D 图层调暗 - 让关卡读起来像夜晚的那一行。写入 `CanvasModulate.color`；这一行会把颜色读回成它让图层暗了多少。

keys: How dark the layer goes, and what colour the dark is. The row shows the percentage; the file keeps the colour.
zh_CN: 图层会暗到什么程度，以及这份黑暗是什么颜色。行里显示百分比，文件里保存的是颜色。

keys: Walks the layer's darkness to a new value over time instead of jumping to it - one tween, no state to keep. Dusk, a cave mouth closing, a light going out.
zh_CN: 让图层的黑暗随时间走到新值，而不是一步跳过去 - 一个 tween，不必保存任何状态。黄昏、正在合拢的洞口、一盏渐渐熄灭的灯。
用 {seconds} 秒把黑暗程度渐变到 {value}

keys: The darkness to fade. Leave it as self to fade the CanvasModulate this sheet is on.
zh_CN: 要渐变的黑暗。保留 self 就作用于本事件表所挂的那个 CanvasModulate。
最终要到达的黑暗程度。

keys: Switches the world's fog on - the one row that turns a clear day into a misty one. Writes `Environment.fog_enabled`.
zh_CN: 打开世界的雾 - 一行就能把晴天变成雾天。写入 `Environment.fog_enabled`。

keys: Switches the world's fog off again. Writes `Environment.fog_enabled`.
zh_CN: 把世界的雾重新关掉。写入 `Environment.fog_enabled`。

keys: Switches the world's glow on - what makes neon, fire and magic read as bright. Writes `Environment.glow_enabled`.
zh_CN: 打开世界的辉光 - 霓虹、火焰和魔法之所以显得明亮，靠的就是它。写入 `Environment.glow_enabled`。

keys: Switches the world's glow off again - and gives the frames back. Writes `Environment.glow_enabled`.
zh_CN: 把世界的辉光重新关掉 - 顺便把帧数还回来。写入 `Environment.glow_enabled`。

keys: Sets how thick the world's fog is. Ramp it up over time for a storm rolling in. Writes `Environment.fog_density`.
zh_CN: 设置世界中雾的浓稠程度。随时间逐渐调高，就像风暴正在逼近。写入 `Environment.fog_density`。

keys: Sets how much light the scene has with no light shining on it - the floor under every other light. Writes `Environment.ambient_light_energy`.
zh_CN: 设置在没有任何灯照到时场景本身有多少光 - 它是其他所有光之下的底。写入 `Environment.ambient_light_energy`。

keys: How much light everything gets regardless of the lights, as a fraction.
zh_CN: 不管有没有灯，所有东西都能得到的光，用倍数表示。

keys: Walks the world's glow to a new strength over time - a boss room brightening, a spell fading out. One tween, no state to keep.
zh_CN: 让世界的辉光随时间走到新的强度 - Boss 房间渐亮，法术慢慢消散。一个 tween，不必保存任何状态。

keys: Fade the glow to {value} over {seconds} s
zh_CN: 用 {seconds} 秒把辉光渐变到 {value}

keys: The WorldEnvironment to fade. Leave it as self to fade the one this sheet is on.
zh_CN: 要渐变的 WorldEnvironment。保留 self 就作用于本事件表所挂的那个。

keys: How much bright things bleed by the end. Around 1 is strong.
zh_CN: 最终明亮物体溢出多少光。1 左右算强。

keys: Make The Environment This Scene's Own
zh_CN: 让环境成为这个场景自己的

keys: Gives this scene its own copy of the environment before anything changes it. Without it, every fog or glow row written at run time changes the shared `.tres` file, so the change follows the player into every other scene that loads it.
zh_CN: 在任何东西改动环境之前，先给这个场景一份自己的副本。没有它，运行时写下的每一行雾或辉光都会改动共享的 `.tres` 文件，改动就会跟着玩家进入每一个加载该文件的场景。

keys: The WorldEnvironment to give its own copy. Leave it blank for this node.
zh_CN: 要获得自有副本的 WorldEnvironment。留空表示当前节点。

keys: Sets how bright a 2D light is. The row shows the fraction as a percentage.
zh_CN: 设置 2D 灯光有多亮。行里把倍数显示为百分比。

keys: How bright, as a fraction: 0.5 is half, 2.0 is double.
zh_CN: 有多亮，用倍数表示：0.5 是一半，2.0 是两倍。

keys: Sets the colour a 2D light casts.
zh_CN: 设置 2D 灯光投出的颜色。

keys: Switches a 2D light on or off. Different from hiding the node, which also hides its children.
zh_CN: 打开或关闭 2D 灯光。这和隐藏节点不同，隐藏还会把它的子节点一起藏起来。

keys: Whether the light is lit. Off is different from hiding the node, which also hides its children.
zh_CN: 灯是否亮着。关掉它和隐藏节点不同，隐藏还会把子节点一起藏起来。

keys: Turns a light's shadows on or off - the cheapest lighting switch there is.
zh_CN: 打开或关闭某盏灯的阴影 - 这是最省开销的一个光照开关。

keys: Sets how bright a 3D light is. The row shows the fraction as a percentage.
zh_CN: 设置 3D 灯光有多亮。行里把倍数显示为百分比。

keys: Sets the colour a 3D light casts - the one knob that turns midday into sunset.
zh_CN: 设置 3D 灯光投出的颜色 - 把正午变成日落的那一个旋钮。

keys: Tints a whole 2D layer at once - the one row that makes a level read as night.
zh_CN: 一次性给整个 2D 图层上色 - 让关卡读起来像夜晚的那一行。

keys: The CanvasModulate node that tints the layer.
zh_CN: 为图层上色的 CanvasModulate 节点。

keys: The tint laid over everything on the layer.
zh_CN: 覆在图层上所有内容之上的色调。

keys: Sets how much light a 3D scene has with no light shining on it.
zh_CN: 设置在没有任何灯照到时 3D 场景本身有多少光。

keys: The WorldEnvironment node holding the environment.
zh_CN: 持有该环境的 WorldEnvironment 节点。

keys: %s declares no dial called %s, so this row does nothing when the game runs.
zh_CN: %s 没有声明名为 %s 的调节项，因此这一行在游戏运行时不会有任何效果。
任意材质，手动输入名称

keys: Tab or Enter accepts, Escape keeps what you typed
zh_CN: Tab 或 Enter 采用，Escape 保留已输入内容

keys: Make the effect this node's own
zh_CN: 让这个节点拥有自己的效果

keys: This node has its own material now - the dials stop here.
zh_CN: 这个节点现在有了自己的材质 - 旋钮到此为止。

keys: %s covers the screen with %s and every dial is still at rest - the whole screen redraws through the shader each frame for nothing. Hide it until an effect turns it on.
zh_CN: %s 用 %s 覆盖了整个屏幕，而每个旋钮都还处于静止状态 - 整个屏幕每一帧都在白白地通过着色器重绘。在效果开启之前把它隐藏起来。

keys: %s wears no material in the scene, so setting %s on it reaches through nothing - every effect row aimed at it does nothing. Give it a ShaderMaterial in the Inspector.
zh_CN: %s 在场景里没有材质，所以设置 %s 什么也碰不到 - 每一条指向它的效果行都不起作用。在检查器里给它一个 ShaderMaterial。

keys: %s is worn by %s as well, and a material is one object - every dial this row turns turns for them too. Give this node its own copy first.
zh_CN: %s 也被 %s 使用，而材质是同一个对象 - 这一行拧动的每个旋钮，也会为它们拧动。请先让这个节点拥有自己的副本。

keys: Project Settings > Shader Globals declares no %s, so every shader reading it sees zero however often this row runs. Declare it there.
zh_CN: 项目设置 > Shader Globals 中没有声明 %s，所以无论这一行运行多少次，读取它的每个着色器看到的都是零。请在那里声明它。

keys: Effects: %d scene(s) wearing a material, %d with something that will not show at run time.
zh_CN: 效果：%d 个场景带有材质，其中 %d 个含有运行时不会显示的东西。

keys: kept inside this scene - nothing else wears it
zh_CN: 保存在这个场景里 - 没有别的节点使用它
运行时使用自己的副本
与另外 %d 个节点共用
与另外 %d 个节点共用

keys: Hand-written code was not changed - check these, which call %s by that name: %s
zh_CN: 手写代码未被修改 - 请检查这些以该名称调用 %s 的文件: %s

keys: Interop: %d script(s) of this project, %d measured, and %d%% of what they hold reads as rows. Installing the plugin changed nothing - a script is code until you open it as a sheet. The score gates nothing; it is there to watch the seam move.
zh_CN: Interop: 本项目共 %d 个脚本，已测量 %d 个，其中 %d%% 的内容可读作行。安装插件本身没有改变任何东西 - 在你把脚本作为事件表打开之前，它仍然只是代码。这个分数不决定任何事，它只是让你看见界线的移动。

keys: %s could hand %s to a shipped behaviour - open it and the row says what would change before anything does.
zh_CN: %s 可以把 %s 交给随附的行为 - 打开它，行会在任何改动之前告诉你将会改变什么。

keys: %s is marked to stay code: never offered anything, never counted, opened read-only.
zh_CN: %s 已标记为保持代码：不做任何提议，不计入统计，以只读方式打开。

keys: %s reads as rows: %d%% - %d function(s) opened, %d still code.
zh_CN: %s 可读作行的比例：%d%% - 已打开 %d 个函数，%d 个仍是代码。

keys: %d other script(s) call something it declares.
zh_CN: 另有 %d 个脚本调用了它声明的内容。

keys: %s is marked to stay code - showing it as code, and leaving it alone.
zh_CN: %s 已标记为保持代码 - 以代码显示，并保持原样。

keys: This object has no method called %s. It may be renamed, or reached some other way - pick the one you meant.
zh_CN: 该对象没有名为 %s 的方法。它可能被改名了，或者通过别的方式被调用 - 请选择你想要的那个。

keys: Hosts with the network dials said out loud: how many channels messages travel down, and caps on what this peer receives and sends. ENet only - and the plain Host a game row is the one to reach for until a game needs these.
zh_CN: 以明说的网络参数主持游戏：消息经过多少条通道，以及此对等端收发量的上限。仅限 ENet - 在游戏真正需要这些参数之前，简单的"主持一局游戏"行才是合适的选择。

keys: Host a game on port {port} for up to {max_players} players over {channels} channels
zh_CN: 在端口 {port} 上主持一局游戏，最多 {max_players} 名玩家，经 {channels} 条通道

keys: How many independent lanes messages travel down. A big delivery on one lane no longer delays the quick messages on another; both sides should say the same number.
zh_CN: 消息经过多少条独立车道。一条车道上的大宗传输不再拖慢另一条车道上的快消息；两侧应指定相同的数字。

keys: The most this peer will receive, in bytes per second. 0 means unlimited, which is the usual pick.
zh_CN: 此对等端接收的上限，单位为字节每秒。0 表示不限制，这是通常的选择。

keys: The most this peer will send, in bytes per second. 0 means unlimited; a cap keeps a busy host from flooding a thin connection.
zh_CN: 此对等端发送的上限，单位为字节每秒。0 表示不限制；设置上限可防止繁忙的主机淹没细窄的连接。

keys: Joins with the same dials the host set - the channel count has to match what the host opened. ENet only, and the plain Join a game row is the one to reach for until a game needs these.
zh_CN: 以主机设定的相同参数加入 - 通道数必须与主机打开的一致。仅限 ENet，在游戏需要之前，简单的"加入一局游戏"行才是合适的选择。

keys: Join a game at {address} port {port} over {channels} channels
zh_CN: 加入位于 {address} 端口 {port} 的游戏，经 {channels} 条通道

keys: How many independent lanes messages travel down. Say the same number the host said.
zh_CN: 消息经过多少条独立车道。请指定与主机相同的数字。

keys: The most this peer will send, in bytes per second. 0 means unlimited.
zh_CN: 此对等端发送的上限，单位为字节每秒。0 表示不限制。

keys: Squeezes every packet this connection sends and unpacks what arrives. Both sides must pick the same codec, it only works on an ENet connection, and it is said after hosting or joining.
zh_CN: 压缩此连接发送的每个数据包，并解开到达的数据包。两侧必须选择相同的编解码器，仅在 ENet 连接上有效，且要在主持或加入之后说出。

keys: The ENet connection to compress. The default reaches the one Host a game or Join a game installed.
zh_CN: 要压缩的 ENet 连接。默认值指向"主持一局游戏"或"加入一局游戏"安装的那个连接。

keys: How the packets are squeezed. Both sides of the connection must pick the same one.
zh_CN: 数据包的压缩方式。连接的两侧必须选择相同的一种。

keys: Sends bytes straight through the connection - no message name, no arguments, nothing decoded for you. Messages are the right tool until a game is counting every byte; a game that sends these also has to read them itself.
zh_CN: 将字节直接送入连接 - 没有消息名，没有参数，也不会为你解码任何东西。在游戏开始计较每个字节之前，消息才是正确的工具；发送这些的游戏也得自己去读它们。

keys: The next raw packet waiting on the connection, as bytes. Only a game that sends raw bytes itself has any business reading it - ordinary messages never arrive this way.
zh_CN: 连接上等待的下一个原始数据包，以字节形式。只有自己发送原始字节的游戏才有理由读它 - 普通消息从不经这条路到达。

keys: %s is looked up every frame and never moves. Remember it once, at ready time, and the row reads the same.
zh_CN: %s 每帧都要查找一次，却从不移动。在就绪时记住它一次，这一行读起来完全一样。

keys: This looks at every object in the group, sixty times a second. Ask less often, or ask when something changes.
zh_CN: 这会每秒六十次地查看组里的每个对象。少问几次，或者在有变化时再问。

keys: Measuring a distance takes a square root every frame. Where you are only comparing it to a number, comparing the squared distances answers the same question for less.
zh_CN: 测量距离每帧都要开一次平方根。如果只是拿它跟一个数字比较，比较距离的平方能得出同样的答案，代价更低。

keys: %d turns of this loop happen in one frame. The Time Slicer behaviour spreads that work over several, on a budget you set.
zh_CN: 这个循环在一帧里要转 %d 次。Time Slicer 行为会按你设定的预算把这些工作分摊到多帧。

keys: This makes a new copy every frame while another row frees one. The Object Pool behaviour hands out the same copies again instead.
zh_CN: 这里每帧都在新建一份副本，另一行又把它释放掉。Object Pool 行为会改为反复发放同一批副本。

keys: The text is written every frame, even when it has not changed. Move this under the event that changes the value and it is written once per change.
zh_CN: 即使文本没有变化，也在每帧被写入。把它移到改变该值的事件下面，就只在每次变化时写入一次。

keys: Fixed - run the game with the profiler to see whether it helped.
zh_CN: 已修复 - 带上性能分析器运行游戏，看看有没有效果。

keys: Fixed - the last run never measured this row, so there is nothing to compare.
zh_CN: 已修复 - 上一次运行从未测量过这一行，所以无从比较。

keys: Fixed - it costs %.2f ms a fire now; there was no measurement before it to compare with.
zh_CN: 已修复 - 现在每次触发花费 %.2f 毫秒；此前没有可比较的测量结果。
已修复：每次触发 %.2f -> %.2f 毫秒。

keys: This did not help: %.2f -> %.2f ms a fire. Put it back?
zh_CN: 没有帮助：每次触发 %.2f -> %.2f 毫秒。要还原吗？

keys: This did not help: still %.2f ms a fire. Put it back?
zh_CN: 没有帮助：每次触发仍是 %.2f 毫秒。要还原吗？

keys: %s - run the game with the profiler to see what it saved.
zh_CN: %s - 带上性能分析器运行游戏，看看省下了多少。
应用 %d 项安全的修复

keys: Nothing in this sheet is spending a frame it did not have to. Run the game with the profiler and look again after the game has grown.
zh_CN: 这张表里没有任何东西在白白浪费一帧。带上性能分析器运行游戏，等游戏长大些再来看看。

keys: The optimiser reads the sheet, not the run: a sheet with no per-frame work earns no findings, whether or not a game has ever been run.
zh_CN: 优化器读的是事件表，不是运行记录：没有逐帧工作的表不会产生任何发现，无论游戏是否运行过。

keys: Every ticked fix keeps the game behaving exactly as it does now - only the emitted code changes. They apply as ONE undo step. The ones below change WHEN something happens, so they are opened one at a time.
zh_CN: 每一项勾选的修复都让游戏的行为与现在完全一致，改变的只是生成的代码。它们作为一个撤销步骤一起应用。下面那些会改变事情发生的时机，所以要一个个打开。

keys: %d row(s) optimised, as one undo step.
zh_CN: 已优化 %d 行，作为一个撤销步骤。

keys: No profiled run has measured this row, so there is no number beside it yet.
zh_CN: 还没有任何一次性能分析运行测量过这一行，所以旁边暂时没有数字。

keys: The last profiled run measured %.2f ms a fire here.
zh_CN: 上一次性能分析运行在这里测得每次触发 %.2f 毫秒。

keys: changes how often the row runs
zh_CN: 会改变该行运行的频率

keys: adds a behaviour to the scene
zh_CN: 会往场景里添加一个行为

keys: a decision about the game, not a line to rewrite
zh_CN: 这是关于游戏的决定，不是一行待改写的代码

keys: The game behaves exactly as it does now - only the emitted line changes, and Ctrl+Z puts it back. The row keeps reading the way it reads.
zh_CN: 游戏的行为与现在完全一致 - 改变的只是生成的那一行，Ctrl+Z 就能还原。这一行读起来也不变。

keys: This one changes WHEN the work happens, so it is applied on its own and its effect is measured on the next profiled run.
zh_CN: 这一项会改变工作发生的时机，所以单独应用，效果在下一次性能分析运行时测量。

keys: Why didn't this fire? Run the game first, then ask
zh_CN: 为什么没有触发？先运行游戏，然后再问

keys: There is nothing recorded to put back on this row.
zh_CN: 这一行没有可以还原的记录。

keys: %s is declared and nothing uses it: no group runs in it, and no row goes to it.
zh_CN: %s 已声明但无人使用：没有组在其中运行，也没有行会切换到它。

keys: Rows go to %s and none of them ever leaves it. A player who reaches that mode is stuck in it.
zh_CN: 有行会切换到 %s，却没有任何一行离开它。进入该模式的玩家会被卡住。

keys: %d mode(s) declared - groups can now say which one they run in.
zh_CN: 已声明 %d 个模式 - 现在组可以说明自己在哪个模式中运行。

keys: These events run whatever the game is doing. Right for a pause menu's own rows, and for a game with no modes in it.
zh_CN: 无论游戏在做什么，这些事件都会运行。适合暂停菜单自己的行，也适合没有模式的游戏。

keys: These events run only while the game is in %s. Every row inside stops asking for itself.
zh_CN: 这些事件只在游戏处于 %s 时运行。里面的每一行都不必再自己去问。

keys: The events in this group run only while the game is in this mode - right-click the head to change it.
zh_CN: 这个组里的事件只在游戏处于该模式时运行 - 右键点击组头可以更改。

keys: This scene has no animation called %s. A misspelled name plays nothing and reports nothing - pick the one you meant.
zh_CN: 此场景没有名为 %s 的动画。拼错的名字不会播放任何内容，也不会报错 - 请选择你想要的那个。

keys: %s is not an animation of this scene - the row plays nothing
zh_CN: %s 不是此场景的动画 - 该行不会播放任何内容
%s 是循环的 - 队列永远不会到来

keys: %s is inside %s (scaled %s) - its own 10 is the world's %s
zh_CN: %s 位于 %s 内部（缩放 %s） - 它自己的 10 在世界中是 %s

keys: %s is mirrored by a negative scale - its shapes and raycasts flip with the art; flip the sprite instead
zh_CN: %s 因负缩放而镜像 - 它的碰撞形状和射线也会随图像一起翻转；请改为翻转精灵

keys: %s is scaled (%s, %s) and turned - it will shear; scale the art, not the collider
zh_CN: %s 被缩放为 (%s, %s) 且发生旋转 - 它会被斜切；请缩放图像而不是碰撞体

keys: Copies the picked preset into a new file and opens it. An empty folder gets Low, Medium and High.
zh_CN: 把选中的预设复制成新文件并打开。空文件夹会得到 Low、Medium 和 High。

keys: %s has no binding on any device - nobody can press it. Bind it in Project Settings, or let a Controls page bind it.
zh_CN: %s 在任何设备上都没有绑定 - 没人能按下它。请在项目设置中绑定，或让控制页面来绑定。

keys: %s says nothing about %s, so picking it leaves that where the last preset put it.
zh_CN: %s 没有提到 %s，所以选它会让该项停留在上一个预设留下的值。

keys: Inserts the worked example from %s as real rows, ready to retune.
zh_CN: 将 %s 中的完整示例作为真实行插入，随后可再调整。

keys: A worked example from %s, inserted as real rows - retune the values on the rows themselves.
zh_CN: 来自 %s 的完整示例，已作为真实行插入 - 请直接在行上调整数值。

keys: This entry's fix (%s) is not wired yet.
zh_CN: 该条目的修复(%s)尚未接入。

keys: Can't add a %s here - add the node by hand in the Scene dock.
zh_CN: 这里无法添加 %s - 请在场景面板中手动添加该节点。

keys: Open the scene this sheet drives, then this entry can add the %s for you.
zh_CN: 打开此事件表驱动的场景，该条目就能替你添加 %s。

keys: Added a %s to %s - Ctrl+Z takes it back.
zh_CN: 已将 %s 添加到 %s - Ctrl+Z 可撤销。

keys: Open a sheet first - Tool is a per-sheet setting.
zh_CN: 请先打开一个事件表 - Tool 是按表设置的。

keys: Tool is on - this sheet's rows can run inside the editor now.
zh_CN: Tool 已开启 - 此事件表的行现在可以在编辑器中运行。

keys: Pick Behavior here and the host verbs come off grey.
zh_CN: 在这里选择行为，主体动词就不再置灰。

keys: Attach this sheet's script to a node of your scene (select the node, then the Attach Script button) and its triggers have a source.
zh_CN: 将此事件表的脚本附加到场景中的节点（选中节点，再点附加脚本按钮），它的触发器就有了来源。

keys: %s already has a script - attach %s to a child node instead, from the Scene dock.
zh_CN: %s 已经有脚本了 - 请改为从场景面板将 %s 附加到子节点。

keys: Attached %s to %s - its triggers listen to this scene now.
zh_CN: 已将 %s 附加到 %s - 它的触发器现在监听这个场景。

keys: Inserted "%s" - retune the values on the rows themselves.
zh_CN: 已插入“%s” - 请直接在行上调整数值。

keys: Couldn't insert "%s" here - open its guide page from the Manual instead.
zh_CN: 无法在这里插入“%s” - 请改为在手册中打开它的指南页面。

keys: Runs only on a behavior sheet - it reads the behavior's host.
zh_CN: 只在行为事件表上运行 - 它要读取行为的主体。
把此事件表变成行为事件表…

keys: Runs only inside the editor - this sheet needs Tool switched on.
zh_CN: 只在编辑器内运行 - 此事件表需要开启 Tool。

keys: Switch Tool on for this sheet
Needs a %s in the scene, and there is none yet.
zh_CN: 场景中需要一个 %s，但还没有。

keys: Listens to a %s, and this sheet is not attached to a scene yet.
zh_CN: 监听 %s，但此事件表还没有附加到场景。

keys: Attach this sheet to a scene…
zh_CN: 将此事件表附加到场景…

keys: Tip: a trigger of this sheet has not fired this run - right-click its row and Ask why.
zh_CN: 提示：此事件表有一个触发器在本次运行中从未触发 - 右键它所在的行并使用“问问为什么”。

keys: Tip: that run stuttered - Tools > Row Timings shows which rows the frames went to.
zh_CN: 提示：这次运行出现卡顿 - 工具 > 行耗时可以看到帧都花在了哪些行上。

keys: The game ran, but this sheet never did - its script is not attached to anything in the scene you ran.
zh_CN: 游戏运行了，但此事件表从未运行 - 它的脚本没有附加到你运行的场景中的任何节点。

keys: %s: %s. Each line below drafts a description out of the thing's own rows - accept it, edit it, or write your own.
zh_CN: %s：%s。下面每一行都会根据它自己的行草拟一段说明 - 接受它、修改它，或者自己写。

keys: %s %s has no description, and its rows do not compose one - this is a line only you can write.
zh_CN: %s %s 没有说明，它的行也拼不出一句 - 这一行只有你能写。

keys: %s %s has no description. Draft from its own rows: "%s"
zh_CN: %s %s 没有说明。根据它自己的行草拟："%s"

keys: %s still says "%s", but its rows no longer mention any of that. Fresh draft: "%s"
zh_CN: %s 仍然写着 "%s"，但它的行已经不再提到其中任何一项。新的草稿："%s"

keys: Descriptions: %d sheet(s) read of %d. Open the rest and the page will have them too.
zh_CN: 说明：已读取 %d / %d 个表。打开其余的，这一页也会有它们。
自上次查看以来新增 %d 条。
项目 Doctor：%d 个错误、%d 个警告、%d 条备注。

keys: This project has no export preset, so there is nothing to build a release from. Project > Export > Add makes one for the platform you are shipping to.
zh_CN: 该项目没有任何导出预设，因此没有可用于构建发行版的东西。项目 > 导出 > 添加 可为要发布的平台创建一个。

keys: The game has no name of its own yet, so the window and the built file are both called after the project template. Project Settings > Application > Config > Name.
zh_CN: 游戏还没有自己的名字，所以窗口和构建出的文件都沿用项目模板的名称。项目设置 > 应用 > 配置 > 名称。

keys: The icon is still the engine's own, so the taskbar shows Godot's logo rather than the game's. Project Settings > Application > Config > Icon.
zh_CN: 图标仍是引擎自带的，所以任务栏显示的是 Godot 的标志而不是游戏的。项目设置 > 应用 > 配置 > 图标。

keys: %s writes to the console where an exported release build still runs it - first: %s.
zh_CN: %s 在导出的发行版构建仍会执行的位置写入控制台 - 第一处：%s。

keys: %d more like it in this file.
zh_CN: 该文件中还有 %d 处类似的。

keys: Log (Debug Builds Only) compiles the line out of a release game.
zh_CN: 日志（仅调试构建）会把这一行从发行版游戏中去掉。

keys: %s is missing %d key(s) the game asks for, so a player reading it sees the raw key: %s.
zh_CN: %s 缺少游戏请求的 %d 个键，玩家会看到原始键：%s。

keys: %s costs %.2f ms of a frame in the last measured run - %d%% of the %.1f ms a 60 fps frame has.
zh_CN: %s 在上次测量的运行中每帧耗费 %.2f 毫秒 - 占一帧的 %d%%（60 fps 下一帧为 %.1f 毫秒）。

keys: A save slot of this game holds %d value(s), written from %d script(s): %s. Anything not on this list is back to its starting value when a slot is loaded.
zh_CN: 这个游戏的一个存档槽保存 %d 个值，由 %d 个脚本写入：%s。不在此列表中的内容在加载存档槽时会回到初始值。

keys: Moves the whole game into another mode and says so. Groups that run in a mode start and stop running by themselves; On entering and On leaving rows do the work of the moment itself.
zh_CN: 将整个游戏切换到另一个模式并发出通知。在某个模式中运行的分组会自行启动和停止；进入时与离开时的行负责该瞬间的工作。

keys: Which of this game's declared modes. The Edit modes dialog on the sheet head is where they are declared.
zh_CN: 本游戏已声明的模式之一。它们在事件表头部的“编辑模式”对话框中声明。

keys: True while the game is in this mode. For a whole group of rows, say it once on the group instead - the group's own "runs in" word does this for every row inside it.
zh_CN: 当游戏处于该模式时为真。对于一整组行，请改为在分组上写一次——分组自身的“运行于”一词会为其中每一行做到这一点。

keys: Goes to a mode REMEMBERING the one underneath - a menu opened over a pause that sits over playing. Go back returns to whatever was under this one, which is the escape-key bug solved in the vocabulary.
zh_CN: 进入某个模式并记住其下方的模式——在游玩之上是暂停，暂停之上又打开了菜单。返回会回到其下方的模式，这正是用词汇本身解决的 Esc 键问题。

keys: Returns to the mode under this one - the menu closes onto the pause it opened over. With nothing pushed it does nothing at all, which is what makes it safe to bind to a key.
zh_CN: 返回到位于其下方的模式——菜单会合上，落回它所覆盖的暂停之上。若没有叠加任何内容，它什么也不做，因此可以放心绑定到某个按键。

keys: Runs the moment the game enters this mode. On leaving fires FIRST, always in that order, so the room is emptied before the next one is filled.
zh_CN: 在游戏进入该模式的那一刻运行。离开时总是先触发，顺序始终如此，好让上一个房间先清空，再填满下一个。

keys: Runs the moment the game leaves this mode, before anything answering the mode it is entering. Fade the music down here and bring it back in the other one.
zh_CN: 在游戏离开该模式的那一刻运行，先于任何响应即将进入的模式的内容。在这里把音乐淡出，在另一边再把它带回来。

keys: Holds a value inside a range whatever else does to it - health that cannot pass its maximum, a volume that cannot go negative, a camera zoom with a floor and a ceiling. Written once here instead of two comparisons everywhere the value changes.
zh_CN: 无论其他地方如何改动，都把一个值保持在范围内——不能超过上限的生命值、不能为负的音量、有下限和上限的相机缩放。在这里写一次，而不是在每个改动该值的地方写两个比较。
将 [b]{var_name}[/b] 保持在 [i]{low}[/i] 与 [i]{high}[/i] 之间

keys: The value being kept in range.

Eases a value toward another one - a camera zoom settling, a bar catching up, a colour fading. It closes a share of the gap every tick, so it slows as it arrives and never quite lands. That also means it moves further on a fast machine than a slow one: when the speed has to be the same everywhere, use Move Toward (smooth), which says the same thing per second.
zh_CN: 让一个值平滑地靠近另一个值——逐渐稳定的相机缩放、追赶上来的进度条、渐渐褪去的颜色。它每一帧缩短剩余差距的一部分，因此越接近越慢，且永远不会完全到达。这也意味着在快机器上移动得比慢机器更多：若需要各处速度一致，请改用“平滑靠近”，它以每秒为单位表达同一件事。
每帧将 [b]{var_name}[/b] 向 [i]{target}[/i] 靠近 [i]{weight}[/i]

keys: How much of the remaining gap it closes every tick. 0.1 is a tenth of the way.
zh_CN: 每帧缩短剩余差距的多少。0.1 表示十分之一。

keys: Turns a number measured on one scale into the same number measured on another - health in points into a bar's 0 to 1, a temperature into a colour's position, a slider's percent into a volume. The maths nobody remembers, said as what it is for.
zh_CN: 把在一种标度上测得的数字换算为另一种标度上的同一数字——以点数计的生命值换成进度条的 0 到 1、温度换成颜色上的位置、滑块的百分比换成音量。没人记得住的那个算式，用它的用途来称呼。
将 [i]{amount}[/i] 从 [i]{in_low}[/i]..[i]{in_high}[/i] 映射到 [i]{out_low}[/i]..[i]{out_high}[/i] 并存入 [b]{into}[/b]

keys: Where the rescaled number is put.
zh_CN: 换算后的数字存放的位置。

keys: What counts as empty in the number's own range.
zh_CN: 在该数字自身范围内视为“空”的值。

keys: What counts as full in the number's own range.
zh_CN: 在该数字自身范围内视为“满”的值。

keys: Sends a value round a loop instead of letting it run off the end - a heading that passes 360 and comes back at 0, an index that walks past the last item and back to the first, a clock. The low end is included and the high end is not, which is what makes 360 and 0 the same heading rather than two.
zh_CN: 让一个值绕圈回环，而不是越过末端跑掉——越过 360 后回到 0 的朝向、越过最后一项回到第一项的索引、时钟。下端包含在内、上端不包含，这正是 360 与 0 是同一个朝向而不是两个的原因。
将 [b]{var_name}[/b] 在 [i]{low}[/i]..[i]{high}[/i] 内循环回绕

keys: The low end it comes back to.
The high end it goes past.

Moves a 2D node the way it is FACING, whatever way that happens to be - a ship under thrust, a bullet down its own barrel, a car along its bonnet. Turning the node turns the direction with it, which is what tells this apart from moving the world's way.
zh_CN: 让一个 2D 节点朝它所面向的方向移动，无论那是哪个方向——推进中的飞船、沿着自己枪管飞出的子弹、沿车头方向行驶的汽车。旋转节点会一并旋转方向，这正是它与“按世界方向移动”的区别。

keys: Moves a 2D node the way the SCREEN means, however the node is turned - drifting clouds, falling snow, a platform on rails. Rotating the node changes nothing about where it goes, which is what tells this apart from moving along its own facing.
zh_CN: 无论节点如何旋转，都按屏幕所指的方向移动 2D 节点——飘过的云、落下的雪、轨道上的平台。旋转节点不会改变它前进的方向，这正是它与“沿自身朝向移动”的区别。

keys: Which way the SCREEN means - it does not turn with the node.
zh_CN: 屏幕所指的方向——它不会随节点旋转。

keys: Carries a 2D node round a point at a steady rate, keeping its distance - a moon round a planet, a door on its hinge, a satellite dish sweeping. The orbit everybody writes with sine and cosine, said as what it is. The node's own angle is not touched: turn it as well if it should face the way it travels.
zh_CN: 让一个 2D 节点以恒定速率绕某个点转动并保持距离——绕行星的月亮、装在合页上的门、扫描中的卫星天线。人人都用正弦余弦写出的轨道，用它本来的名字说出来。节点自身的角度不会被改动：若它应朝向前进方向，请一并旋转它。

keys: The place it goes round - a marker, another node's position, a point.
zh_CN: 它绕行的位置——一个标记、另一个节点的位置、或一个点。

keys: Degrees a second, turning clockwise on screen; a negative number goes the other way.
zh_CN: 每秒的角度，在屏幕上为顺时针；负数则反向转动。

keys: Turns a 2D node toward a place at a top speed instead of snapping to it - the turret leading its target, the enemy that has to swing round before it can charge. It never overshoots, and it stops when it is looking the right way.
zh_CN: 让一个 2D 节点以一个最大速度转向某处，而不是瞬间对准——追踪目标的炮塔、必须先转过身才能冲锋的敌人。它绝不会转过头，且在朝向正确时停下。

keys: The place to turn toward - a node's global position, or a point.
zh_CN: 要朝向的位置——某个节点的全局位置，或一个点。

keys: The fastest it may turn. Make it huge to snap.
zh_CN: 它可以转动的最快速度。设得很大即可瞬间对准。

keys: Swings a 2D node round by an amount over a time and leaves it there - a door opening, a lever thrown, a drawbridge. It turns about the node's OWN origin, so where that origin sits is the hinge: move it to the door's edge in the editor and the door swings on its edge.
zh_CN: 让一个 2D 节点在一段时间内摆动一定角度并停在那里——开启的门、扳下的拉杆、吊桥。它绕节点自身的原点旋转，因此原点在哪里，合页就在哪里：在编辑器中把原点移到门的边缘，门就会以边缘为轴摆动。

keys: How far it swings from where it is now.
Lines up an animation to play automatically when the current one ends - combo chains, or dropping back to idle after an attack, without a timer.
zh_CN: 排入一个动画，在当前动画结束时自动播放——连招衔接，或攻击后回到待机，无需计时器。

keys: The clip to play once the current one finishes.
zh_CN: 当前片段结束后要播放的片段。

keys: Switches which clip is current (assigning it starts it) - a direct set when you don't need Play's blend arguments.
zh_CN: 切换当前是哪个片段（赋值即开始播放）——在不需要“播放”的混合参数时的直接设置。

keys: The clip to make current (assigning it also plays it).
zh_CN: 要设为当前的片段（赋值也会播放它）。

keys: True when this player owns a clip by that name - guard a Play so a missing animation never errors.
zh_CN: 当该播放器拥有同名片段时为真——用它守住“播放”，缺失的动画就不会报错。

keys: Plays one animation and lines the next one up behind it - attack then idle, jump then fall. The waiting is the engine's own: the second starts the moment the first finishes, with no timer to keep in step. An animation that LOOPS never finishes, so a chain behind one never comes.
zh_CN: 播放一个动画，并把下一个排在它后面——攻击然后待机、跳跃然后下落。等待由引擎自己完成：第一个结束的瞬间第二个就开始，无需保持同步的计时器。循环播放的动画永远不会结束，因此排在它后面的衔接永远不会到来。

keys: The clip that plays the moment the first one ends.
zh_CN: 第一个片段结束的瞬间播放的片段。

keys: True once a clip's play head has passed a named moment on its timeline - the frame the hit lands on, in the only form a keyframed animation has. Retiming the moment in the Animation panel moves it; the row does not change.
zh_CN: 当某个片段的播放头越过其时间线上一个具名瞬间时为真——命中落点的那一帧，这是关键帧动画唯一能表达它的形式。在动画面板中重新调整该瞬间会一并移动它；而这一行不会改变。

keys: The clip whose timeline the moment lives on.
zh_CN: 该瞬间所在时间线归属的片段。

keys: The named moment on that clip's timeline.
zh_CN: 该片段时间线上的具名瞬间。

keys: Runs when a script error happens while the game is running - in a build a player is holding, not only in the editor. The report says what failed and where. Save it to a file, show a "please send this" dialog, or just skip the broken thing and keep playing.
zh_CN: 当游戏运行时发生脚本错误就会执行——不只是在编辑器里，也包括玩家手中的构建版本。报告会说明什么失败了、在哪里失败。把它保存到文件、弹出一个“请把它发给我们”的对话框，或者干脆跳过出错的部分继续游戏。

keys: What failed and where, as the engine said it - the message, the script and the line. Filled in for you when the trigger fires.
zh_CN: 什么失败了、在哪里失败，用引擎自己的说法给出——消息、脚本和行号。触发时会自动为你填好。

keys: True on the ONE frame where the game has been over budget for the whole run you name, and quiet after that until a frame comes in under budget again. This is where a game turns its own effects down. Needs a per-frame trigger.
zh_CN: 在你指定的整段连续帧中都超出预算的那一帧上为真，之后保持沉默，直到再次出现一帧回到预算之内。这里正是游戏自行调低效果的地方。需要一个逐帧触发器。

keys: On the frame running long [b]{ms}[/b] ms for [b]{frames}[/b] frames
zh_CN: 连续 [b]{frames}[/b] 帧超过 [b]{ms}[/b] 毫秒时

keys: A frame longer than this counts as a long one. 16.6 is one frame at 60 FPS.
zh_CN: 比这更长的帧算作长帧。16.6 是 60 FPS 下的一帧。

keys: How many long frames in a row before this fires. One hitch is not a problem; half a second of them is.
zh_CN: 触发前需要连续多少个长帧。一次卡顿不是问题，持续半秒就是了。

keys: True on the ONE frame where the game has run comfortably for the whole run you name, after having been over budget. This is where the effects go back on. It never fires before a long stretch has happened, so a game that started well hears nothing. Needs a per-frame trigger.
zh_CN: 在此前曾超出预算之后，于你指定的整段连续帧中都跑得从容的那一帧上为真。这里正是把效果重新打开的地方。在出现过一段长帧之前它绝不会触发，因此一开始就顺畅的游戏什么也听不到。需要一个逐帧触发器。

keys: On the frame recovered under [b]{ms}[/b] ms for [b]{frames}[/b] frames
zh_CN: 连续 [b]{frames}[/b] 帧低于 [b]{ms}[/b] 毫秒而恢复时

keys: A frame shorter than this counts as calm. Keep it comfortably under the long threshold - the gap between the two is what stops the game flapping.
zh_CN: 比这更短的帧算作平稳。请把它设得明显低于长帧阈值——两者之间的差距正是防止游戏来回反复的关键。

keys: How many calm frames in a row before this fires. Long enough that a lull in the action is not mistaken for a fix.
zh_CN: 触发前需要连续多少个平稳帧。要足够长，以免把动作上的短暂停歇误认为问题已解决。

keys: Puts this node one step in front of another in the drawing order, whatever that other node's order happens to be. Relative on purpose: move the pair around and they keep their order, where two hand-set numbers drift apart.
zh_CN: 把这个节点在绘制顺序上放到另一个节点前面一格，无论那个节点自身的顺序是多少。刻意采用相对方式：把这一对挪到哪里都会保持顺序，而两个手工设定的数字迟早会走样。

keys: The node to draw over - this one takes its drawing order plus one.
zh_CN: 要覆盖绘制的节点——本节点取它的绘制顺序加一。

keys: Limits which cameras draw this node: a camera only draws what its cull mask and the node's visibility layer share. The layer names are the project's own (Project Settings > Layer Names > 2D Render), which is how a minimap marker gets seen by the minimap and by nothing else.
zh_CN: 限制哪些相机会绘制这个节点：相机只绘制其剔除掩码与节点可见层的交集。层名称取自项目自身（项目设置 > 层名称 > 2D Render），小地图标记之所以只被小地图看到，就是靠这一点。

keys: The visibility layers that may see this node, by their project names.
zh_CN: 可以看到这个节点的可见层，使用它们在项目中的名称。

keys: True while the node is inside what a camera is showing. It works through the engine's own VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D, and adds one to the node the first time the row is asked if the node has none - a plain child you can see in the scene, move, resize and keep.
zh_CN: 当节点处于某个相机所显示的范围内时为真。它通过引擎自带的 VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D 工作；若节点没有，会在首次询问时为它添加一个——一个在场景中可见、可移动、可调整大小并保留下来的普通子节点。

keys: The child that was just added under this node. Filled in for you when the trigger fires.
zh_CN: 刚刚添加到该节点下的子节点。触发时会自动为你填好。

keys: The child that is leaving this node. Filled in for you when the trigger fires.
zh_CN: 正在离开该节点的子节点。触发时会自动为你填好。

keys: A name, a node, an animation, a mode…
A name is not one thing: written, read and compared are different facts about it, and the facet says which one you are hunting.
zh_CN: 名称不是一件事：写入、读取和比较是关于它的不同事实，分面决定你在找哪一个。

keys: Your Game: the selected sheet's own page
zh_CN: 你的游戏：所选事件表自己的页面

keys: This page is composed from the sheet every time you select it, so it cannot be out of date. Select a sheet above to read it.
zh_CN: 每次选择事件表时都会重新生成该页面，因此它不会过时。在上方选择一个事件表即可阅读。

keys: Interop: %d script(s) of this project, and none of them could be opened to measure. Installing the plugin changed nothing - a script is code until you open it as a sheet.
zh_CN: Interop: 本项目共 %d 个脚本，但没有一个能被打开以进行测量。安装插件本身没有改变任何东西 - 在你把脚本作为事件表打开之前，它仍然只是代码。

keys: %d more node(s) mirrored by a negative scale
zh_CN: 另有 %d 个节点因负缩放而被镜像

keys: %d more node(s) scaled unevenly and turned
zh_CN: 另有 %d 个节点被不均匀缩放并旋转

keys: Not used anywhere in this project yet.
zh_CN: 本项目中尚未在任何地方使用。

keys: Used once in your project - open it.
zh_CN: 在你的项目中使用了 1 次 - 打开它。

keys: Used %d times in your project - open one.
zh_CN: 在你的项目中使用了 %d 次 - 打开其中一个。

keys: Used %d times across %d sheets in your project - open one.
zh_CN: 在你的项目中使用了 %d 次，分布在 %d 个表中 - 打开其中一个。

keys: Opens the guide section that teaches this, at the heading itself.
zh_CN: 打开讲解这一点的指南章节，直接定位到标题。

keys: Opens that sheet and selects the event.
zh_CN: 打开该表并选中该事件。

keys: Opened %s at the event that uses it.
zh_CN: 已打开 %s，并定位到使用它的事件。

keys: Your rows already use %d verb(s) this page teaches: %s (%s)
zh_CN: 你的行已经用到本页讲解的 %d 个动词：%s (%s)

keys: Guides you already have, in the order that teaches them. Tick a page off as you read it - the ticks stay on this machine, in this project, and are never written into your game.
zh_CN: 你已经拥有的指南，按讲授的顺序排列。读完一页就打上勾 - 勾只留在这台机器的这个项目里，绝不会写进你的游戏。

keys: No paths are declared. A path is a list in a documentation index - add a Learning paths section to your project's own index and it appears here.
zh_CN: 没有声明任何路径。路径就是文档索引里的一个列表 - 在你项目自己的索引中加入 "Learning paths" 一节，它就会出现在这里。

keys: Ticks this page off, or takes the tick back. Kept on this machine only.
zh_CN: 给这一页打勾，或撤销勾选。只保存在这台机器上。

keys: Opens the page your rows point at.
zh_CN: 打开你的行所指向的那一页。
%d 个没有动词对应的名称
%d 个更新日志从未提到的动词

keys: %d verb(s) the guide does not list
zh_CN: %d 个指南没有列出的动词

keys: %d verb(s) undocumented, %d name(s) no verb answers to, %d description(s) that say nothing, %d verb(s) the changelog never mentions.
zh_CN: %d 个未记录的动词、%d 个没有动词对应的名称、%d 条什么都没说的描述、%d 个更新日志从未提到的动词。

keys: %s publishes %s and the guide never names it. A reader who searched the guide concluded it does not exist.
zh_CN: %s 提供了 %s，而指南从未提及。在指南里搜索过的人会以为它不存在。

keys: %s shipped, but nothing in the changelog ever mentions %s. Write the line while you still remember what changed.
zh_CN: %s 已发布，但更新日志从未提到 %s。趁还记得改了什么，把这一行写下来。

keys: Docs: %d of %d guide(s) read, %d out of step.
zh_CN: 文档：已读 %d/%d 篇指南，%d 篇已脱节。

keys: Docs: guides are checked in the editor, where the vocabulary is already loaded. Outside it the help bundle build prints the same report.
zh_CN: 文档：指南在编辑器内检查，那里已经加载了词汇表。在编辑器之外，帮助包构建会打印同样的报告。
下面列出最严重的 %d 篇。

keys: %s documents "%s" and no verb answers to it. Nearest that do: %s.
zh_CN: %s 记录了“%s”，但没有动词叫这个名字。最接近的是：%s。

keys: %s documents "%s" and no verb answers to it, nor anything near it.
zh_CN: %s 记录了“%s”，但没有动词叫这个名字，也没有相近的。

keys: %s lists %s with nothing under "what it does". Draft: "%s"
zh_CN: %s 列出了 %s，“做什么”一栏是空的。草稿：“%s”

keys: Rewrite the project manual and refresh the search
zh_CN: 重写项目手册并刷新搜索

keys: Writes the page each sheet writes about itself, then re-reads the Manual so the new pages are searchable.
zh_CN: 写出每张表格关于自身的页面，然后重新读取手册，让新页面可被搜索。

keys: Only when this version of Godot has not been harvested yet. Nothing is downloaded: the engine writes out every class and member it has, without their descriptions.
zh_CN: 仅当尚未采集此版本的 Godot 时运行。不会下载任何内容：引擎会写出它拥有的每个类和成员，但不包含它们的描述。

keys: The descriptions the harvest cannot write, because the engine keeps them inside the editor rather than in a file. This is the one chore that downloads anything: the class reference for this exact version of Godot, once, kept on this machine. It never runs on its own.
zh_CN: 采集无法写出的描述文本，因为引擎把它们放在编辑器内部而不是文件里。这是这里唯一会下载内容的事项：只获取一次与当前 Godot 版本对应的类参考，并保存在本机。它绝不会自行运行。

keys: Draft the descriptions nothing has written yet
zh_CN: 为尚无人书写的描述起草

keys: Collected into one drafts file. Nothing is applied to a sheet or a guide - a draft stays a draft until you move it.
zh_CN: 汇总到一个草稿文件中。不会写入任何表格或指南 - 草稿始终是草稿，直到你亲自采用。

keys: Reports what the guides do not answer and where a shipped copy has drifted from the page it was copied from.
zh_CN: 报告指南未回答的内容，以及随附副本与其来源页面的偏离之处。

keys: Export the Manual as a site
The whole Manual as plain HTML files, with its search, that open in a browser with no server.
zh_CN: 整本手册导出为带搜索的纯 HTML 文件，无需服务器即可在浏览器中打开。

keys: Write out the translator's missing keys
One spreadsheet of every key your game asks for that a catalog does not answer yet.
zh_CN: 一张表，列出你的游戏需要但目前没有任何目录能回答的所有键。

keys: Makes one copy of a scene, adds it under a parent and puts it where you say. The copy gets the name you choose, and every following row in this event can say that name - it is a real variable in the emitted code, not a lookup. Leave At as global_position to spawn where this node is, and Under as self to keep the copy under this one.
zh_CN: 复制一份场景，把它添加到指定的父节点下并放到你说的位置。副本会得到你选的名字，本事件中后面的每一行都可以说出这个名字 - 它是生成代码里真正的变量，而不是一次查找。把位置保持为 global_position 就会在本节点处生成，把父节点保持为 self 就会把副本放在本节点下。

keys: Spawn a copy of [b]{scene}[/b] as [b]{name}[/b] at {at}, under [i]{parent}[/i]
zh_CN: 在 {at} 生成 [b]{scene}[/b] 的副本，命名为 [b]{name}[/b]，放在 [i]{parent}[/i] 下

keys: The scene to copy - one of this sheet's declared scenes by name, or a load() of a scene path.
zh_CN: 要复制的场景 - 本表已声明的场景名称，或者对场景路径的 load()。

keys: What to call the new copy. Following rows in this event say this name, and it is the variable name the emitted code uses.
zh_CN: 新副本叫什么。本事件中后面的行会说出这个名字，它也是生成代码使用的变量名。

keys: Where the copy lands, as a position. Leave it as global_position to spawn where this node is.
zh_CN: 副本落在哪里，以位置表示。保持为 global_position 就会在本节点处生成。

keys: The node the copy is added under. Leave it as self to add it under this one, or name a layer to keep spawns together.
zh_CN: 副本被添加在哪个节点下。保持为 self 就会放在本节点下，也可以指定一个图层把生成物集中在一起。

keys: The same spawn, added on the next idle moment instead of right now. Use it inside a collision or body handler: Godot refuses to add a child while the physics server is busy, and this row waits for it to finish rather than erroring. The place is set before the copy is added, so it is a place relative to the parent rather than a world position.
zh_CN: 同样的生成，但改在下一个空闲时刻添加，而不是立刻。请在碰撞或刚体回调里使用：Godot 在物理服务器忙碌时会拒绝添加子节点，而这一行会等它完成而不是报错。位置在添加之前设定，所以它是相对父节点的位置，而不是世界坐标。

keys: Spawn a copy of [b]{scene}[/b] as [b]{name}[/b] at {at}, under [i]{parent}[/i], added on the next idle moment
zh_CN: 在 {at} 生成 [b]{scene}[/b] 的副本，命名为 [b]{name}[/b]，放在 [i]{parent}[/i] 下，在下一个空闲时刻添加

keys: Makes one copy of a scene and gives it a name, without adding it to the scene tree yet. Following rows in this event can say the name to set the copy up, and an Add Child row puts it in the world when it is ready.
zh_CN: 复制一份场景并给它一个名字，但暂不加入场景树。本事件中后面的行可以用这个名字来布置副本，准备好后由一行“添加子节点”把它放入世界。
做一个 [b]{scene}[/b] 的副本，命名为 [b]{name}[/b]

keys: Gives a node's own place in the world. Drop a Marker2D where things should appear and this reads it, so moving the marker moves the spawn without touching the sheet.
zh_CN: 给出节点自己在世界中的位置。把 Marker2D 放在东西应该出现的地方，这一行就会读它 - 移动标记就能移动生成点，无需改表。

keys: The node to read the place of - a Marker2D you dropped in the scene, a spawn point, the player.
zh_CN: 要读取位置的节点 - 你在场景里放的 Marker2D、一个出生点、玩家。

keys: Gives a random point somewhere along a Path2D's curve. The point is picked by distance travelled rather than by curve segment, so a long straight stretch is exactly as likely as a tight corner. A curve is drawn in the path's own space, so the point is handed back through to_global and comes out where the curve really is, even under a rotated or scaled parent.
zh_CN: 在 Path2D 曲线上的某处给出一个随机点。这个点是按走过的距离来选的，而不是按曲线分段，所以一段长直线和一个急弯的概率完全一样。曲线是画在路径自己的空间里的，所以这个点会经由 to_global 返回，即使父节点被旋转或缩放，它也会落在曲线真正所在的位置。

keys: The Path2D whose curve to pick a point on. Draw the curve first: an empty one has no length, and Godot prints an error every time the line is evaluated.
zh_CN: 要在其曲线上取点的 Path2D。请先画好曲线：空曲线没有长度，而且每次求值这一行时 Godot 都会打印一条错误。

keys: Gives a random point inside a collision shape - the Area2D you drew around a spawn zone. Rectangles and circles are measured directly and scattered evenly in one step, with no rejection sampling and no retries; every other shape gives its own centre instead of a guess. The measurement is in the shape's own space and is handed back through to_global, so a rotated or scaled shape scatters inside the box you drew rather than inside an upright one of the same size.
zh_CN: 在一个碰撞形状内部给出一个随机点 - 也就是你围着生成区域画的那个 Area2D。矩形和圆形直接按自身尺寸一步算出均匀的散布，没有拒绝采样，也没有重试；其他形状则给出自己的中心，而不是一个猜测。测量是在形状自己的空间里做的，点会经由 to_global 返回，所以旋转或缩放过的形状会散布在你真正画出的那个框里，而不是一个同样大小的正框里。

keys: The CollisionShape2D to scatter inside - the one on the Area2D marking the spawn zone.
zh_CN: 要在其内撒点的 CollisionShape2D - 即标记生成区的那个 Area2D 上的那一个。
屏幕边缘外的随机位置

keys: Gives a random point just outside one of the four screen edges, in world coordinates - where a wave arrives from. The edge is picked fresh each time the line runs, and the margin keeps the copy out of sight until it moves in.
zh_CN: 给出四个屏幕边缘之一的外侧一个随机点，以世界坐标表示 - 一波敌人就是从那里来的。每次执行这一行都会重新挑边，而边距让副本在进入画面前不被看到。

keys: random place off a screen edge (+{margin})
zh_CN: 屏幕边缘外的随机位置 (+{margin})

keys: How far outside the screen edge the point sits, in pixels.
zh_CN: 点在屏幕边缘外多远，以像素计。

keys: Destroys the object, taking it out of the game. Godot deletes it at the END of this frame, not on this line, so the rows after this one in the same event still run and the object is still there while they do. Use it for anything the game is finished with: a collected pickup, a defeated enemy, a spent effect.
zh_CN: 销毁对象，把它从游戏中去掉。Godot 会在本帧结束时删除它，而不是在这一行，所以同一事件中后面的行仍会执行，期间对象依然存在。用于游戏已经用完的东西：捡起的道具、被击败的敌人、播放完的特效。

keys: Destroys the object a number of seconds from now, and gets on with the event in the meantime. The wait is a scene-tree timer, so nothing about this line blocks. It is safe if something else destroys the object first: Godot drops the timer's connection along with the object, and the wait ends up firing at nothing at all.
zh_CN: 在若干秒后销毁对象，期间事件继续往下走。等待用的是场景树计时器，所以这一行不会阻塞任何东西。即使别的地方先销毁了对象也很安全：Godot 会连同对象一起丢掉计时器的连接，等待最后什么也不会触发。

keys: Fades the object's transparency to nothing over a number of seconds and then destroys it. The event WAITS here, so the rows after this one run once the fade has finished. Because that wait is a real gap in game time, the row asks whether the object is still there before destroying it, and the line that asks is written into the sheet rather than added quietly.
zh_CN: 用若干秒把对象的透明度降到零，然后销毁它。事件会在这里等待，所以后面的行要等淡出结束才执行。因为这个等待是游戏时间里真实的空档，这一行会在销毁前先问对象是否还在，而发问的那一行就写在表里，不是被悄悄加上去的。

keys: True while the object has not been destroyed. Ask it before touching anything a sheet held on to across frames: a node stored in a variable, or a copy a spawn row made in an earlier event. A node that wants to hear about its OWN destruction uses the On Exit Tree trigger instead, which fires as it leaves.
zh_CN: 只要对象还没有被销毁就为真。在触碰任何跨帧保存下来的东西之前先问一句：存在变量里的节点，或者更早的事件里生成行做出的副本。想知道自己被销毁的节点，请改用 On Exit Tree 触发器，它会在节点离开时触发。

keys: fade [i]{object}[/i] out over {seconds}s, then destroy it
zh_CN: 用 {seconds} 秒淡出 [i]{object}[/i]，然后销毁

keys: The object to destroy, as an expression - the name a spawn row gave a copy, a variable holding a node, or a node path. Leave it as self for this node.
zh_CN: 要销毁的对象，写成表达式 - 生成行给副本起的名字、保存着节点的变量，或者节点路径。留作 self 表示这个节点自己。

keys: How many seconds to wait before destroying the object. The event carries on immediately; only the destroying waits.
zh_CN: 在销毁对象之前等待多少秒。事件会立刻继续，只有销毁在等。

keys: How many seconds the fade takes. The event waits for it, so the rows after this one run when the fade is done.
zh_CN: 淡出要花多少秒。事件会等它，所以后面的行在淡出结束后才执行。

keys: Taking a thing out of the world: right now, after a wait, or after a fade. Each row is a plain queue_free, and each says when the call happens.
zh_CN: 把一样东西从世界里拿走：马上、等一会儿，或者淡出之后。每一行都是普通的 queue_free，并且都说明调用发生在什么时候。

keys: This name may already be gone, so the compiler writes this line above the row. Click to open it in the code panel.
zh_CN: 这个名字可能已经不存在了，所以编译器会在这一行上方写下这行代码。点击可在代码面板中打开。

keys: Spawn A Copy Into The Crowd
zh_CN: 在群体中生成一个副本

keys: Spawns a copy the way Spawn A Copy does, and puts it in a group named after the scene, so the rows below can count them, cap them and hear when the last one goes. The group is joined with Godot's persistent flag, which is what keeps it there if the branch is ever packed back into a scene file.
zh_CN: 像"生成一个副本"那样生成一个副本，并把它放进以场景命名的分组里，这样下面的行就能数它们、给它们设上限，并在最后一个消失时收到通知。加入分组时使用了 Godot 的持久分组标志，正是它让这个分组在该分支被重新打包回场景文件后依然存在。

keys: Spawn a copy of [b]{scene}[/b] as [b]{name}[/b] at {at}, under [i]{parent}[/i], into the crowd [b]{crowd}[/b]
zh_CN: 在 {at} 处、[i]{parent}[/i] 之下生成 [b]{scene}[/b] 的副本 [b]{name}[/b]，加入群体 [b]{crowd}[/b]

keys: The group the copies belong to, named after the scene they are copies of. It is an ordinary Godot group, so anything else in the project that uses groups can see these too.
zh_CN: 这些副本所属的分组，以它们所复制的场景命名。它是一个普通的 Godot 分组，所以项目里其他使用分组的东西也能看到它们。

keys: Spawn A Copy, The First Makes Room
zh_CN: 生成一个副本，最前面的让出位置

keys: Spawns a copy into the crowd, and when the crowd is already full destroys members to make room, so the count never climbs past the cap - not even when the same event spawns several times in one frame. The ones destroyed are taken from the front of the crowd, which is the order Godot lists a group in: under a parent that spawns by adding children that is the earliest one still alive, and after a move_child or a second parent it is the tree's order rather than the spawn's. Members already on their way out are skipped, so no member is ever freed twice and the new copy always appears - which is what a bullet or a footstep wants.
zh_CN: 在群体中生成一个副本；如果群体已经满了，就销毁足够多的成员来腾出位置，所以数量永远不会超过上限 - 即使同一个事件在一帧里生成好几次也一样。被销毁的是群体最前面的，也就是 Godot 列出分组的顺序：在一个靠添加子节点来生成的父节点下，那就是仍然活着的最旧的一个；发生过 move_child 或者有第二个父节点之后，那就是节点树的顺序而不是生成的顺序。已经在离场途中的成员会被跳过，所以没有谁会被释放两次，新副本也总会出现 - 这正是子弹或脚印想要的。

keys: Spawn a copy of [b]{scene}[/b] as [b]{name}[/b] at {at}, under [i]{parent}[/i], at most [b]{cap}[/b] alive in [b]{crowd}[/b] - the first in the crowd makes room
zh_CN: 在 {at} 处、[i]{parent}[/i] 之下生成 [b]{scene}[/b] 的副本 [b]{name}[/b]，[b]{crowd}[/b] 中最多 [b]{cap}[/b] 个存活 - 群体中最前面的让出位置

keys: How many of this crowd may be alive at once. What happens when that many already are is the rest of the row's sentence, not a setting.
zh_CN: 这个群体最多能同时存活多少个。达到这个数量时会发生什么，写在这一行句子的后半段里，而不是某个设置里。

keys: Spawn A Copy Unless The Crowd Is Full
zh_CN: 若群体未满则生成一个副本

keys: Spawns a copy into the crowd only while there is room, and does nothing at all when the crowd is full - the answer an enemy wave wants, where a spawn that arrives by pushing another one out is worse than no spawn. A member already on its way out has stopped counting against the cap, so a spawn in the same frame something died in still happens. The name is still there for the rows below, holding nothing when the spawn was skipped, so an Is Still Here row can tell the two apart.
zh_CN: 只在还有空位时才在群体中生成副本，群体已满时什么也不做 - 这正是敌人波次想要的答案：一个靠挤走别人才出现的生成，比不生成更糟。已经在离场途中的成员不再计入上限，所以在有东西死掉的同一帧里，生成照样会发生。名字仍然留给下面的行使用，生成被跳过时它什么也不含，所以一行"仍然在此"就能分辨这两种情况。

keys: Spawn a copy of [b]{scene}[/b] as [b]{name}[/b] at {at}, under [i]{parent}[/i], at most [b]{cap}[/b] alive in [b]{crowd}[/b] - skip spawning when full
zh_CN: 在 {at} 处、[i]{parent}[/i] 之下生成 [b]{scene}[/b] 的副本 [b]{name}[/b]，[b]{crowd}[/b] 中最多 [b]{cap}[/b] 个存活 - 已满时不生成

keys: How many of a crowd are alive right now - the size of its group. Nothing counts them for you: a member that is freed leaves the group as it leaves the tree, so the number can never drift out of step with the world. A member destroyed this frame is still counted until the end of it, which is what queue_free means everywhere else too.
zh_CN: 一个群体现在有多少个还活着 - 也就是它的分组大小。没有谁替你计数：被释放的成员在离开节点树的同时就离开了分组，所以这个数字永远不会和世界脱节。这一帧里被销毁的成员，到这一帧结束前仍然计入其中，这也正是 queue_free 在别处的含义。

keys: Runs the moment the last member of a crowd is destroyed, once per emptying - the wave being cleared, the last crate broken. It listens to the scene tree's own node-removed signal and adds the question below as a condition you can see and edit, so nothing about it happens off the row. That question also asks whether the member is really going, because moving a node to another parent leaves the tree too and is not the crowd emptying. A member taken out some other way - its whole branch freed at once - is not seen here; the On Group Emptied condition asks the same thing a different way, on a per-frame trigger, by remembering last tick's count.
zh_CN: 在一个群体的最后一个成员被销毁的那一刻运行，每清空一次只运行一次 - 一波敌人被清完、最后一个箱子被打碎。它监听场景树自己的 node-removed 信号，并把下面那个问题作为一条你能看见、能编辑的条件加进来，所以没有任何事情发生在这一行之外。那个问题还会确认这个成员是不是真的要走，因为把节点挪到别的父节点下同样是离开节点树，但那并不是群体被清空。以别的方式离开世界的成员 - 例如整根分枝被一次性释放 - 在这里看不到；"分组已清空"这个条件会用另一种方式问同一件事，它挂在每帧的触发器上，靠记住上一帧的数量。
当 [b]{crowd}[/b] 的最后一个被销毁时

keys: Crowd Is Down To This One

The gate under On The Last One Destroyed: true when the node that is leaving belongs to the crowd, is really being destroyed rather than moved to another parent, and is the only member left in it. A leaving node is still listed in its groups at that moment, so a crowd of just that one is a crowd that is about to be empty.
zh_CN: "当最后一个被销毁时"下面的那个条件：当正在离开的节点属于这个群体、是真的在被销毁而不是被挪到别的父节点下、并且是群体里剩下的唯一成员时为真。正在离开的节点在那一刻仍然列在它的分组里，所以只剩它一个的群体，就是马上要空掉的群体。

keys: [b]{crowd}[/b] is down to [i]{node}[/i], which is being destroyed
The node that is leaving - the one the trigger handed this event. On The Last One Destroyed fills this in for you.
zh_CN: 正在离开的那个节点 - 触发器交给这个事件的那一个。"当最后一个被销毁时"会替你填好。

keys: The copies a sheet spawned, held as a Godot group: joined on the way in, counted, capped with the policy said out loud, and answered when the last one goes.
zh_CN: 一张表生成的副本，以 Godot 分组的形式保存：进来时加入分组、被计数、按明说出来的策略设上限，并在最后一个离开时得到回应。
另外还生成 %d 个场景

keys: This one is named by an expression the sheet works out as it runs, so there is no file to show.
zh_CN: 这一项由表在运行时算出的表达式指定，因此没有文件可以显示。
%s - 已在文件系统面板中显示。

keys: This adds a node to the tree while the physics server is busy, and Godot refuses it. Add it on the next idle moment instead.
zh_CN: 这会在物理服务器忙碌时把节点加入场景树，Godot 会拒绝。请改在下一个空闲时刻添加。

keys: Add it on the next idle moment
zh_CN: 在下一个空闲时刻添加

keys: %s is kept between frames, and anything could have destroyed it by now. Ask whether it is still here before reaching into it.
zh_CN: %s 会跨帧保留，此刻可能已被别处销毁。使用它之前先问一句它是否还在。

keys: This spawns the scene it is already running in, every time a copy is created, with nothing in the way. Each copy makes another one.
zh_CN: 这会在每次创建副本时、且没有任何条件阻挡地生成它自己所在的那个场景。每个副本又会再生成一个。

keys: %s is destroyed earlier in this event, and this row books a wait against it. Move the destroy below this row, or destroy it after a delay instead.
zh_CN: %s 在本事件更靠上的地方被销毁，而这一行又为它预约了一段等待。请把销毁移到这一行下面，或者改为延迟销毁。

keys: Spawning: %d script(s) that add or destroy nodes, %d read, %d with something that will go wrong at run time.
zh_CN: 生成：有 %d 个脚本会添加或销毁节点，已读取 %d 个，其中 %d 个存在运行时会出错的地方。

keys: This row is already added on the next idle moment.
zh_CN: 这一行已经是在下一个空闲时刻添加的。

keys: This event already asks whether %s is still here.
zh_CN: 这个事件已经在问 %s 是否还在了。

keys: The destroy is already the last row of this event.
zh_CN: 销毁已经是这个事件的最后一行了。

keys: The destroy runs last now, after everything that reads it.
zh_CN: 销毁现在排在最后，在所有读取它的行之后运行。

keys: Is Set To Collide With Layer
Is Set To Collide With Layer (3D)
Starts noticing one named collision layer, so this object bumps into (and detects) whatever sits on it. The layers this object is ON are a separate question - use Be On Layer for that.
zh_CN: 开始关注一个命名的碰撞层，于是该对象会撞上（并检测到）该层上的一切。该对象自己位于哪些层是另一个问题 - 那是「位于层上」的事。

keys: Stops noticing one named collision layer, so this object passes straight through whatever sits on it - the drop-through-a-platform move, and the moment a dash turns intangible.
zh_CN: 不再关注一个命名的碰撞层，于是该对象会直接穿过该层上的一切 - 从平台上落下的动作，以及冲刺变得无实体的那一刻。

keys: Puts this object on one named collision layer, so everything watching that layer starts noticing it.
zh_CN: 把该对象放到一个命名的碰撞层上，于是所有关注该层的东西都会开始注意到它。

keys: Takes this object off one named collision layer, so everything watching that layer stops noticing it - the invulnerable frames after a hit, said as the layer it leaves.
zh_CN: 把该对象从一个命名的碰撞层上移开，于是所有关注该层的东西都不再注意到它 - 受击后的无敌帧，用它离开的层来表述。

keys: True when this object is currently watching one named collision layer. It asks about the SETTING, not about a touch happening now.
zh_CN: 当该对象当前正在关注某个命名的碰撞层时为真。它问的是设置，而不是此刻正在发生的接触。

keys: Give this layer a name in Project Settings ▸ Layer Names, so every row about it can say it.
zh_CN: 在项目设置 ▸ 层名称中给这个层起个名字，这样每一行关于它的句子都能说出它。

keys: Type the layer's name first, then Name it…
zh_CN: 请先输入层的名称，再点「命名…」。

keys: %s addresses collision layer %d, and Godot has layers 1 to 32 - that call does nothing.
zh_CN: %s 指向碰撞层 %d，而 Godot 只有 1 到 32 层 - 这次调用什么也不做。

keys: %s is about collision layer %d, which this project does not name - the row reads as the number while every other row reads as a word. Name it in Project Settings ▸ Layer Names, or point the row at the layer that was renamed.
zh_CN: %s 说的是碰撞层 %d，而本项目没有给它命名 - 于是这一行读作数字，而其他每一行都读作一个词。请在项目设置 ▸ 层名称中给它命名，或把这一行指向那个被改名的层。

keys: The layer to watch for, by the name this project gave it in Project Settings ▸ Layer Names ▸ 2D Physics. A layer the project never named shows as its number, and can be named from here.
zh_CN: 要关注的层，用本项目在项目设置 ▸ 层名称 ▸ 2D 物理中给它起的名字。项目没有命名的层显示为它的编号，并可以在这里命名。

keys: The layer to watch for, by the name this project gave it in Project Settings ▸ Layer Names ▸ 3D Physics. A layer the project never named shows as its number, and can be named from here.
zh_CN: 要关注的层，用本项目在项目设置 ▸ 层名称 ▸ 3D 物理中给它起的名字。项目没有命名的层显示为它的编号，并可以在这里命名。

keys: The layer to sit on, by the name this project gave it in Project Settings ▸ Layer Names ▸ 2D Physics. A layer the project never named shows as its number, and can be named from here.
zh_CN: 要位于的层，用本项目在项目设置 ▸ 层名称 ▸ 2D 物理中给它起的名字。项目没有命名的层显示为它的编号，并可以在这里命名。

keys: The layer to sit on, by the name this project gave it in Project Settings ▸ Layer Names ▸ 3D Physics. A layer the project never named shows as its number, and can be named from here.
zh_CN: 要位于的层，用本项目在项目设置 ▸ 层名称 ▸ 3D 物理中给它起的名字。项目没有命名的层显示为它的编号，并可以在这里命名。

keys: %s has monitoring switched off in the scene, so it reports no touches at all - every row waiting on one here is unreachable.
zh_CN: %s 在场景中关闭了监测，因此完全不会报告任何接触 - 这里等待接触的每一行都无法到达。

keys: %s has no shape, so it cannot collide or interact with anything. Add a CollisionShape or a CollisionPolygon under it in the scene.
zh_CN: %s 没有形状，因此无法与任何东西碰撞或交互。请在场景中于其下方添加 CollisionShape 或 CollisionPolygon。

keys: %s is one-way and turned over, so bodies fall through it from above and are stopped from below. The rows here are waiting for the landing it blocks.
zh_CN: %s 是单向的且被翻转过来，因此物体会从上方穿过、从下方被挡住。这里的行正在等待它挡住的那次落地。

keys: %s watches %s, and everything in this project that can collide sits on %s - so nothing can reach this trigger. This reads every layer in use, because the trigger names no group.
zh_CN: %s 监视 %s，而本项目中所有能发生碰撞的东西都位于 %s - 因此没有任何东西能触及这个触发器。由于触发器未指定分组，这里读取的是所有在用的层。

keys: %s watches %s, and the members of "%s" sit on %s - so this trigger never fires.
zh_CN: %s 监视 %s，而 "%s" 的成员位于 %s - 因此这个触发器永远不会触发。

keys: Collisions: %d script(s) waiting on a touch, %d read, %d whose trigger cannot fire as the scene stands.
zh_CN: 碰撞：%d 个脚本在等待接触，已读取 %d 个，其中 %d 个的触发器在当前场景下无法触发。
Godot 的碰撞层为 1 到 32。

keys: Open %s to change what it collides with.
zh_CN: 打开 %s 以更改它与什么发生碰撞。

keys: %s is not in the project any more.

Runs when something from one group hits this body. The group is the filter: the handler's first line leaves at once for anything else, and what did hit rides into the rows underneath. This body BLOCKS what it hits - it needs Contact Monitor switched on and its Max Contacts Reported above zero before Godot will report the hit at all.
zh_CN: 当某个分组中的东西撞到这个物体时运行。分组就是过滤器：处理函数的第一行会让其他一切立刻返回，撞上来的那个会传给下面的行。这个物体会挡住撞上来的东西 - 需要打开 Contact Monitor 并把 Max Contacts Reported 设为大于零，Godot 才会报告这次碰撞。

keys: Only react when the thing that arrived is in this group. Any node joins a group from the Node dock, and the emitted handler leaves immediately when it is not in it.
zh_CN: 只在到来的东西属于这个分组时才响应。任何节点都可以在 Node 面板里加入分组，不属于时生成的处理函数会立刻返回。

keys: The body that arrived, already known to be in the group. Filled in for you when the trigger fires - use it in the rows underneath.
zh_CN: 到来的物体，已经确认属于该分组。触发时会自动填好 - 在下面的行里使用它。
当与分组的碰撞结束时

keys: Runs when something from one group stops touching this body - the other half of the collision, for ending a push, a grind or a stand-on. Needs the same Contact Monitor setting the starting half does.
zh_CN: 当某个分组中的东西不再接触这个物体时运行 - 碰撞的另一半，用来结束推挤、摩擦或站立其上。需要和开始那一半相同的 Contact Monitor 设置。
当与 {group} 的碰撞结束时

keys: The body that left, already known to be in the group. Filled in for you when the trigger fires - use it in the rows underneath.
zh_CN: 离开的物体，已经确认属于该分组。触发时会自动填好 - 在下面的行里使用它。
当与分组的碰撞结束时 (3D)

keys: Runs when something from one group moves into this area. An area DETECTS and does not block, so the thing keeps going - this is the trigger a checkpoint, a pickup zone or a damage field is written from. What arrived rides into the rows underneath.
zh_CN: 当某个分组中的东西进入这个区域时运行。区域只负责发现，不会挡住，所以东西会继续前进 - 存档点、拾取区、伤害区都从这个触发器写起。进来的那个会传给下面的行。
当与分组的重叠结束时

keys: Runs when something from one group leaves this area - the moment a player walks out of a safe zone, or the last enemy clears a trap.
zh_CN: 当某个分组中的东西离开这个区域时运行 - 玩家走出安全区，或最后一个敌人离开陷阱的那一刻。
当与 {group} 的重叠结束时
当与分组的重叠结束时 (3D)

keys: True while at least one body from this group is inside this area. The standing question beside the two arrival triggers - ask it when what matters is the state now, not the moment it changed.
zh_CN: 只要该分组中至少有一个物体在这个区域内就为真。它是两个到达触发器旁边的常驻问题 - 当你关心的是此刻的状态而不是改变的瞬间时用它。

keys: The group to look for among the bodies inside this area right now.
zh_CN: 要在此刻位于该区域内的物体中查找的分组。

keys: This node is an area: it notices what arrives and lets it through. Blocking is a body's job, so pair this with a body if the thing should also be stopped.
zh_CN: 这个节点是区域：它只发现到来的东西，并让它通过。挡住是物体的工作，如果还要把它停下来，就再配一个物体。

keys: This node is a body: what it hits stops, and the hit is reported only while Contact Monitor is on and Max Contacts Reported is above zero. An area would notice the same arrival without stopping anything.
zh_CN: 这个节点是物体：撞上它的东西会停下，而且只有在 Contact Monitor 打开且 Max Contacts Reported 大于零时才会报告这次碰撞。区域会发现同样的到来，但不会挡住任何东西。

keys: Runs on the step this character's feet arrive on the floor - the landing itself, not the standing that follows it. Landing is where the dust, the thud and the squash go. It is a moment of the physics step rather than a signal, so the question underneath says which step.
zh_CN: 在这个角色的双脚落到地面的那一步运行 - 落地本身，而不是随后的站立。灰尘、闷响和挤压都放在这里。它是物理步的一个瞬间而不是信号，所以下面的条件说明是哪一步。

keys: Runs on the step this character's feet leave the floor, whichever way they left it: a jump and a walked-off ledge are the same moment to this row. The half that starts coyote time, and the half a fall animation begins on.
zh_CN: 在这个角色的双脚离开地面的那一步运行，无论是怎么离开的：跳起和走出平台边缘对这一行来说是同一个瞬间。土狼时间从这里开始，下落动画也从这里开始。

keys: True on the one step the feet arrive on the floor: on the floor now, and not on it last step. It keeps last step's footing in a variable of its own and updates it AFTER asking - a memory updated before the question is asked would always agree with the present, and the row could never be true.
zh_CN: 只在双脚落到地面的那一步为真：现在在地面上，上一步不在。它把上一步的着地状态记在自己的变量里，并在提问之后才更新 - 若先更新，记忆就永远与当下一致，这一行也就永远不会为真。

keys: True on the one step the feet leave the floor: not on it now, and on it last step. The same memory the landing question keeps, read the other way round.
zh_CN: 只在双脚离开地面的那一步为真：现在不在地面上，上一步在。与落地问题所保存的是同一份记忆，只是反过来读。

keys: Runs when something moves into this area and the area was empty until then - the pressure plate going down, the room waking up. Later arrivals do not run it again; the question underneath is what says so, and it is an ordinary condition you can read and edit.
zh_CN: 当有东西进入这个区域、而在此之前区域是空的时运行 - 压力板落下、房间苏醒。之后再进来的不会再次触发；说明这一点的是下面那个条件，它是一个可以读也可以改的普通条件。

keys: Runs when something leaves this area and nothing is left inside - the plate coming back up, the room going quiet. The other half of the first arrival, and the pair a door or a lift is written from.
zh_CN: 当有东西离开这个区域、并且里面什么都不剩时运行 - 压力板弹回、房间安静下来。它是首次进入的另一半，门或升降台就是用这一对写出来的。

keys: True when exactly one body is inside this area. Asked in an arrival, that is the arrival which filled an empty area: what just came in is already listed by then, so a list of one held nothing a moment ago.
zh_CN: 当这个区域内恰好有一个物体时为真。在进入事件中问，它就是填满空区域的那次进入：刚进来的东西此时已经在名单上，所以只有一个的名单在片刻前是空的。

keys: True when nothing is inside this area. Asked in a departure, that is the departure which emptied it: what just left is already off the list by then, so an empty list means it was the last one.
zh_CN: 当这个区域内什么都没有时为真。在离开事件中问，它就是把区域清空的那次离开：刚离开的东西此时已经不在名单上，所以空名单意味着它就是最后一个。

keys: The body that arrived. Filled in for you when the trigger fires - use it in the rows underneath.
zh_CN: 到达的物体。触发器触发时会自动填入 - 在下面的行里使用它。

keys: The body that left. Filled in for you when the trigger fires - use it in the rows underneath.
zh_CN: 离开的物体。触发器触发时会自动填入 - 在下面的行里使用它。

keys: This node is a character body: your own rows drive it, one move at a time, and it stops when it runs into something. What it hit comes back from its own move rather than from a signal.
zh_CN: 这个节点是角色体：由你自己的行来驱动，一次移动一步，撞到东西就停下。撞到了什么是从这次移动本身返回的，而不是通过信号。

keys: This node is a rigid body: physics throws it around and it stops what it hits. The hit is reported only while Contact Monitor is on and Max Contacts Reported is above zero.
zh_CN: 这个节点是刚体：物理把它抛来抛去，它会挡住撞上的东西。只有在 Contact Monitor 打开且 Max Contacts Reported 大于零时，碰撞才会被报告。

keys: This node is a static body: it stands still and things stop against it. It never moves itself, so the news of a touch usually belongs on whatever ran into it.
zh_CN: 这个节点是静态体：它站着不动，东西撞上就停下。它自己从不移动，所以接触的消息通常属于撞上来的那一方。

keys: Nothing in this scene can touch anything yet - this row needs one: %s.
zh_CN: 这个场景里还没有任何东西能碰到别的东西 - 这一行需要一个 %s。

keys: %d claimed by an entry · %d nothing claims · %d%% renders as rows rather than blocks
zh_CN: %d 行由条目认领 · %d 行无人认领 · %d%% 画作行而非代码块
第 %d 行回来时不一样。

keys: Mark each value span as [[name: text]], then check it.
zh_CN: 把每个值的跨度标为 [[name: text]]，然后检查。
这个示例可以推导出一条条目。

keys: Lift Workbench - what claims each line
zh_CN: 提升工作台 - 每行由什么认领

keys: Take the selected unclaimed line to the by-example form and derive an entry from it.
zh_CN: 把选中的无人认领行带进“举例”表单，由它推导出一条条目。

keys: The line, with its value spans marked
zh_CN: 标出了值跨度的那一行

keys: A value span is [[name: text]], or [[name|fragment: text]] to say which fragment it is. Everything outside a span is matched literally.
zh_CN: 值跨度写作 [[name: text]]，或用 [[name|fragment: text]] 说明它是哪种片段。跨度以外的部分按字面匹配。

keys: These are asked before every shipped spelling, in this window only. They are gone when it closes, and nothing on disk is written.
zh_CN: 仅在此窗口中，先于任何随附的写法被询问。关闭窗口后即消失，不会向磁盘写入任何内容。

keys: Empties the drafts this window keeps, so every line they were claiming goes back to whatever claimed it before.
zh_CN: 清空此窗口保存的草稿，使它们所认领的每一行回到此前的读法。

keys: Read the first %d script(s) of %d, in path order. The ledger below is a sample of this project, not the whole of it - the same scripts are read every time.
zh_CN: 已按路径顺序读取前 %d 个脚本（共 %d 个）。下面的清单只是本项目的一个样本，并非全部 - 每次读取的都是同样的脚本。

keys: %d%% of what was read draws as rows, and every line of it has a name on it. Nothing here stays code.
zh_CN: 读取内容的 %d%% 绘制为行，且每一行都有名字。这里没有任何内容仍是代码。

keys: %d%% of what was read draws as rows - that is the drawing question. The naming question is below it: %d line(s) stay honest code, because no vocabulary claims them yet. Both are true, and they are not the same number.
zh_CN: 读取内容的 %d%% 绘制为行 - 这是绘制的问题。命名的问题在下面：%d 行仍是诚实的代码，因为还没有词汇认领它们。两者都为真，且不是同一个数字。

keys: %d more shape(s) are said more than once here, over %d line(s). The ledger names the commonest and counts the rest.
zh_CN: 这里还有 %d 种形状出现不止一次，共 %d 行。清单列出最常见的，其余只作计数。

keys: ... and %d more line(s) of the same shape.
zh_CN: ... 还有 %d 行是同一种形状。

keys: %d line(s) are shapes nothing else here repeats. Counted rather than listed: a line said once is nobody's table, and it is meant to stay code.
zh_CN: %d 行的形状在这里没有别的内容重复。只作计数而不逐条列出：只说过一次的行不属于任何表格，它本就该留作代码。

keys: %d line(s) inside those runs hold no statement to shape - a note, or the inside of a text block.
zh_CN: 这些片段中有 %d 行不含可归纳形态的语句 - 是注释，或是文本块的内部。

keys: True when the event this handler was handed is the named action going down. The press half of the event the handler is holding - not a question about how things stand now, which is what Is Action Pressed answers.
zh_CN: 当这个处理函数收到的事件是指定动作被按下时为真。这是处理函数手上那个事件的按下一半，而不是在问此刻的状态 - 那是「动作被按下」回答的问题。

keys: The action this event has to be, from the Input Map.
zh_CN: 此事件必须对应的动作，取自输入映射。

keys: Event Is Action Pressed Or Repeating
zh_CN: 事件是动作按下或重复

keys: The same press, widened to include the auto-repeats a held key sends - what a menu that scrolls while you hold the stick wants, and what a jump does not.
zh_CN: 同样的按下，但包含按住按键时发出的自动重复 - 适合按住摇杆时持续滚动的菜单，不适合跳跃。

keys: this event is {action} going down, or repeating
zh_CN: 此事件是 {action} 按下，或重复触发

keys: True when the event this handler was handed is the named action coming back up, for charge-and-release moves and for letting go of a held control.
zh_CN: 当这个处理函数收到的事件是指定动作被松开时为真，用于蓄力后释放的招式，以及松开一直按住的操作。

keys: True when the event belongs to the named action at all, whichever way it is going. The row to ask before reading how hard it is held, since a strength is only meaningful once you know which control it came from.
zh_CN: 无论方向如何，只要该事件属于指定动作就为真。在读取按压力度之前先问这一行，因为只有知道力度来自哪个控制，力度才有意义。
